import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

// Các thư mục/file không cần thiết để đưa cho AI đọc
const IGNORE_LIST = ['node_modules', 'dist', 'build', '.git', 'package-lock.json', 'assets', '.svg', '.png', '.jpg'];
const OUTPUT_FILE = 'project-context.txt';

function getAllFiles(dirPath, arrayOfFiles) {
    const files = fs.readdirSync(dirPath);

    arrayOfFiles = arrayOfFiles || [];

    files.forEach(function(file) {
        if (IGNORE_LIST.some(ignore => file.includes(ignore))) return;

        const fullPath = path.join(dirPath, file);
        if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {
            arrayOfFiles = getAllFiles(fullPath, arrayOfFiles);
        } else {
            // Chỉ lấy các file code
            if (fullPath.match(/\.(js|jsx|css|html|json|md)$/)) {
                arrayOfFiles.push(fullPath);
            }
        }
    });

    return arrayOfFiles;
}

function bundleFiles() {
    const currentDir = process.cwd();
    const allFiles = getAllFiles(currentDir);
    let outputContent = 'CẤU TRÚC VÀ MÃ NGUỒN DỰ ÁN:\n\n';

    allFiles.forEach(file => {
        const relativePath = path.relative(currentDir, file);
        const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
        
        outputContent += `\n\n=========================================\n`;
        outputContent += `FILE: ${relativePath}\n`;
        outputContent += `=========================================\n\n`;
        outputContent += content;
    });

    fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, outputContent);
    console.log(`Đã gộp thành công ${allFiles.length} files vào ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);
    console.log('Bạn có thể upload file này lên Gemini!');
}

bundleFiles();

# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the Oxlint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and Oxlint's TypeScript related rules in your project.

            {state.toast.type === 'error' ? <Icons.X size={18} /> : state.toast.type === 'warning' ? <Icons.AlertCircle size={18} /> : <Icons.Check size={18} />}
            {state.toast.text}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/components/common/Controls.jsx
 * @description Các component điều khiển dùng chung (Switch, Toggle, Selectors).
 * @origin Tầng 3 - Block 3.1 & 3.2 (Shared UI Components)
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Icons } from './Icons';
import { IoeDataEngine } from '@/engines/pedagogyEngine';

export const AiModeSwitch = ({ isAiMode, setAiMode, t, onMissingKey, isLoading, className }) => (
  <div
    className={`flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50/80 transition-colors ${className || ''}`}
    onClick={(e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!isAiMode && !localStorage.getItem('fc_gemini_api_key') && !localStorage.getItem('fc_apikey')) onMissingKey();
      else setAiMode(!isAiMode);
    }}
    title={isLoading ? "AI đang xử lý..." : (isAiMode ? "Chế độ AI: Tự động điền (Đang BẬT)" : "Chế độ AI: Tự động điền (Đang TẮT)")}
  >
    <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center p-1">
      <Icons.Sparkles size={20} className={isLoading ? "text-purple-600 animate-spin" : (isAiMode ? "text-purple-600 fill-purple-100" : "text-gray-300")} />
    </div>
    <div className={`w-8 h-4 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors duration-300 flex-none border shadow-sm ${isAiMode ? 'bg-purple-500 border-purple-500' : 'bg-gray-200 border-gray-300'}`}>
      <div className={`w-3 h-3 bg-white rounded-full shadow-md transform transition-transform duration-300 ${isAiMode ? 'translate-x-4' : 'translate-x-0'}`} />
    </div>
  </div>
);

// [VÁ LỖI TẦNG 3] Bảo vệ thuộc tính 'icon' không bị undefined
export const MenuToggle = ({ active, setActive, icon: Icon, color, title, subtitle, extra, disabled }) => {
  const activeClass = active ? "bg-" + color + "-50 border-" + color + "-200" : "bg-white border-gray-200";
  const disabledClass = disabled ? "opacity-50 grayscale cursor-not-allowed" : "";
  
  return (
    <div className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border transition-all ${activeClass} ${disabledClass}`}>
      <div className={`flex items-center justify-between ${!disabled ? 'cursor-pointer' : ''}`} onClick={() => !disabled && setActive(!active)}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {Icon && (
            <div className={`p-2 rounded-full ${active ? "bg-" + color + "-100 text-" + color + "-600" : "bg-gray-100 text-gray-400"}`}>
              <Icon size={18} />
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-left">
            <div className={`text-sm font-bold ${active ? "text-" + color + "-800" : "text-gray-600"}`}>{title}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">{subtitle}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={`w-10 h-5 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors duration-300 flex-none ${active ? "bg-" + color + "-500" : "bg-gray-300"}`}>
          <div className={`bg-white w-4 h-4 rounded-full shadow-md transform duration-300 ${active ? 'translate-x-5' : ''}`}></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {active && extra && !disabled && extra}
    </div>
  );
};

// [CẬP NHẬT V2.0] Bộ chọn Cấp độ (Level Selector) - MULTI-SELECT
export const LevelSelector = ({ lang, currentLevel, onSelectLevel, mainColor = 'blue' }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  
  const enLevels = [
    { id: 'en_level_1', label: 'Kiddie', sub: 'Lớp 1-2' },
    { id: 'en_level_2', label: 'Junior', sub: 'Lớp 3-4' },
    { id: 'en_level_3', label: 'Junior+', sub: 'Lớp 5' },
    { id: 'en_level_4', label: 'Discovery', sub: 'Lớp 6-7' },
    { id: 'en_level_5', label: 'Discovery+', sub: 'Lớp 8-9' },
    { id: 'en_level_6', label: 'Pre-IELTS', sub: 'IELTS 4.0' },
    { id: 'en_level_7', label: 'Breakthrough', sub: 'IELTS 5.0' },
    { id: 'en_level_8', label: 'Academic', sub: 'IELTS 6.5' },
    { id: 'en_level_9', label: 'Expert', sub: 'IELTS 7.5+' }
  ];
  
  const zhLevels = [
    { id: 'zh_level_1', label: 'HSK 1', sub: 'Sơ cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_2', label: 'HSK 2', sub: 'Sơ cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_3', label: 'HSK 3', sub: 'Sơ cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_4', label: 'HSK 4', sub: 'Trung cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_5', label: 'HSK 5', sub: 'Trung cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_6', label: 'HSK 6', sub: 'Trung cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_7', label: 'HSK 7', sub: 'Cao cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_8', label: 'HSK 8', sub: 'Cao cấp' },
    { id: 'zh_level_9', label: 'HSK 9', sub: 'Cao cấp' }
  ];
  
  const levels = lang === 'zh' ? zhLevels : enLevels;
  
  // Tự động chuyển đổi String (legacy) sang Array
  const currentArr = Array.isArray(currentLevel) ? currentLevel : (currentLevel ? [currentLevel] : []);
  
  const handleToggle = (id) => {
    if (currentArr.includes(id)) {
      onSelectLevel(currentArr.filter(x => x !== id));
    } else {
      onSelectLevel([...currentArr, id]);
    }
  };
  
  // Logic tính toán nhãn hiển thị bên ngoài Dropdown
  let displayMain = "Tất cả";
  let displaySub = "Cấp độ";
  if (currentArr.length === 1) {
    const obj = levels.find(l => l.id === currentArr[0]);
    if (obj) { displayMain = obj.label; displaySub = obj.sub; }
  } else if (currentArr.length > 1) {
    displayMain = `Đã chọn ${currentArr.length}`;
    displaySub = "Nhiều cấp độ";
  }
  
  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left w-full h-full">
      <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)} className={`flex items-center justify-between w-full h-full px-2 py-1.5 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors`}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start overflow-hidden">
          <span className={`text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold text-${mainColor}-700 leading-none truncate`}>{displayMain}</span>
          <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-medium leading-none mt-1 truncate">{displaySub}</span>
        </div>
        <Icons.ChevronDown size={14} className={`text-gray-400 transition-transform duration-200 shrink-0 ml-1 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}></div>
      )}
      
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 left-0 mt-1 min-w-[160px] bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-xl shadow-lg z-50 py-1 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {/* Nút Reset chọn tất cả */}
          <button onClick={() => { onSelectLevel([]); setIsOpen(false); }} className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100 transition-colors ${currentArr.length === 0 ? "bg-" + mainColor + "-50 text-" + mainColor + "-700" : "text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm">Tất cả cấp độ</span>
            {currentArr.length === 0 && <Icons.Check size={16} className={`text-${mainColor}-500`} />}
          </button>
          
          {/* Danh sách các Cấp độ với Checkbox */}
          {levels.map(lv => {
            const isSelected = currentArr.includes(lv.id);
            return (
              <button key={lv.id} onClick={() => handleToggle(lv.id)} className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-3 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50`}>
                <div className={`w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 transition-colors ${isSelected ? "bg-" + mainColor + "-500 border-" + mainColor + "-500 text-white" : "border-gray-300 bg-white"}`}>
                  {isSelected && <Icons.Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />}
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col flex-1">
                  <span className={`font-bold text-sm ${isSelected ? "text-" + mainColor + "-700" : "text-gray-700"}`}>{lv.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{lv.sub}</span>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// [CẬP NHẬT V2.01] Bộ chọn Chủ đề (Topic Selector) - MULTI-SELECT (Bulletproof String Handling)
export const TopicSelectorDropdown = ({ currentLevel, currentTopic, onSelectTopic, mainColor = 'blue' }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  
  // Mảng hóa state cho tương thích ngược (chống TypeError)
  const levelArr = Array.isArray(currentLevel) ? currentLevel : (currentLevel ? [currentLevel] : []);
  const topicArr = Array.isArray(currentTopic) ? currentTopic : (currentTopic ? [currentTopic] : []);
  
  const fallbackTopics = ["Self & Body", "Social Connections", "Living Spaces", "The Natural World", "Food & Health", "Daily Life & Leisure", "School & Career", "Travel & Exploration", "Other"];
  
  // Hợp nhất Chủ đề từ nhiều Level
  let topics = fallbackTopics;
  const rawTopics = IoeDataEngine?.TOPICS;
  
  if (Array.isArray(rawTopics) && rawTopics.length > 0) {
    topics = rawTopics;
  } else if (rawTopics && typeof rawTopics === 'object' && !Array.isArray(rawTopics)) {
    let merged = new Set();
    if (levelArr.length > 0) {
      levelArr.forEach(lv => {
        if (rawTopics[lv] && Array.isArray(rawTopics[lv])) {
          rawTopics[lv].forEach(t => merged.add(t));
        }
      });
      if (merged.size > 0) topics = Array.from(merged);
    } else {
      // Nếu không chọn level nào, lấy tất cả chủ đề có thể
      Object.values(rawTopics).forEach(arr => {
        if(Array.isArray(arr)) arr.forEach(t => merged.add(t));
      });
      if (merged.size > 0) topics = Array.from(merged);
    }
  }
  
  const handleToggle = (topic) => {
    if (topicArr.includes(topic)) {
      onSelectTopic(topicArr.filter(x => x !== topic));
    } else {
      onSelectTopic([...topicArr, topic]);
    }
  };
  
  // Logic tính toán nhãn hiển thị an toàn tuyệt đối
  let displayLabel = "Tất cả chủ đề";
  if (topicArr.length === 1) {
    const firstTopic = topicArr[0];
    if (typeof firstTopic === 'string') {
      // Thay thế .split() bằng .indexOf() và .substring() để an toàn bộ nhớ
      const braceIndex = firstTopic.indexOf(' (');
      const cleanTopic = braceIndex !== -1 ? firstTopic.substring(0, braceIndex) : firstTopic;
      displayLabel = cleanTopic.length > 15 ? cleanTopic.substring(0, 15) + '...' : cleanTopic;
    } else {
      displayLabel = "1 chủ đề";
    }
  } else if (topicArr.length > 1) {
    displayLabel = `Đã chọn ${topicArr.length} chủ đề`;
  }
  
  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left w-full h-full">
      <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)} className={`flex items-center justify-between w-full h-full px-2 py-1.5 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors`}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start overflow-hidden w-full">
          <span className={`text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold text-${mainColor}-700 leading-none truncate`}>Chủ đề</span>
          <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-medium leading-none mt-1 truncate w-full text-left">{displayLabel}</span>
        </div>
        <Icons.ChevronDown size={14} className={`text-gray-400 transition-transform duration-200 shrink-0 ml-1 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      
      {isOpen && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}></div>}
      
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 left-0 mt-1 min-w-[200px] bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-xl shadow-lg z-50 py-1 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {/* Nút Reset chọn tất cả */}
          <button onClick={() => { onSelectTopic([]); setIsOpen(false); }} className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100 transition-colors ${topicArr.length === 0 ? "bg-" + mainColor + "-50 text-" + mainColor + "-700" : "text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50"}`}>
            <span className="font-bold text-sm">Tất cả chủ đề</span>
            {topicArr.length === 0 && <Icons.Check size={16} className={`text-${mainColor}-500`} />}
          </button>
          
          {/* Danh sách Chủ đề với Checkbox */}
          {topics.map((topic, idx) => {
            const isSelected = topicArr.includes(topic);
            return (
              <button key={idx} onClick={() => handleToggle(topic)} className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 flex items-start gap-3 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50`}>
                <div className={`w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 rounded border flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 transition-colors ${isSelected ? "bg-" + mainColor + "-500 border-" + mainColor + "-500 text-white" : "border-gray-300 bg-white"}`}>
                  {isSelected && <Icons.Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />}
                </div>
                <span className={`font-bold text-xs w-full leading-snug ${isSelected ? "text-" + mainColor + "-700" : "text-gray-700"}`}>{topic}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const TopicSelector = TopicSelectorDropdown;

/**
 * @file src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.jsx
 * @description Lưới chắn bẫy lỗi giao diện của React. Bắt lỗi render để tránh màn hình trắng (WSOD).
 * @origin Tầng 3 - Block 3.1 (Shared UI Components)
 */

import React, { Component } from 'react';

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.error("Uncaught error:", error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-red-50 p-6 text-center font-sans">
          <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl shadow-xl max-w-md w-full border border-red-100">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-red-100 text-red-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" />
                <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">Đã xảy ra lỗi!</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-600 mb-6 text-sm">Vui lòng tải lại trang để tiếp tục.</p>
            <div className="bg-gray-100 p-3 rounded text-left text-xs font-mono text-red-600 overflow-auto max-h-32 mb-6">
              {this.state.error && this.state.error.toString()}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
              className="w-full py-3 px-4 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-red-200"
            >
              Tải lại ứng dụng
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

/**
 * @file src/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen.jsx
 * @description Màn hình chờ vạn năng, hiển thị tiến trình nạp đạn AI và đếm ngược thời gian.
 * @origin Tầng 3 - Block 3.2 (Shared UI Components)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from './Icons';

export const GlobalLoadingScreen = ({ 
  duration = 0, 
  onComplete, 
  onCancel, 
  queueLength = 0, 
  text = "Hệ thống đang đúc dữ liệu...", 
  subText = "Vui lòng đợi trong giây lát", 
  mainColor = "blue", 
  levelStr = "", 
  engine = null 
}) => {
  const getSafeDuration = () => {
    try {
      const cfg = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('fc_ai_config'));
      if (cfg && cfg.loadingTime) return Number(cfg.loadingTime);
    } catch(e) {}
    if (duration > 0) return Number(duration);
    return 22; // Mặc định 22 giây
  };

  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(getSafeDuration);
  const [localQueueLength, setLocalQueueLength] = useState(queueLength);

  // Theo dõi Hàng đợi động (nếu truyền engine)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (engine && typeof engine.length === 'function') {
      const id = setInterval(() => setLocalQueueLength(engine.length()), 500);
      return () => clearInterval(id);
    } else {
      setLocalQueueLength(queueLength);
    }
  }, [engine, queueLength]);

  // Bộ đếm ngược thời gian
  useEffect(() => {
    if (timeLeft <= 0) {
      if (onComplete) onComplete();
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setTimeLeft(prev => prev - 1), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [timeLeft, onComplete]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col border-2 border-gray-200 items-center justify-center animate-in fade-in p-6 text-center absolute inset-0 z-50">
      
      {/* Vòng tròn đếm ngược */}
      <div className="relative mb-6 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className={`absolute w-24 h-24 border-4 border-${mainColor}-100 rounded-full`}></div>
        <div className={`absolute w-24 h-24 border-4 border-${mainColor}-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin`}></div>
        <div className={`relative z-10 font-black text-3xl text-${mainColor}-600 drop-shadow-sm`}>
          {timeLeft}
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Thông điệp chính */}
      <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-gray-800 mb-2 tracking-wide uppercase">{text}</h2>
      <p className={`text-${mainColor}-600 text-sm font-bold animate-pulse mb-6`}>{subText}</p>
      
      {/* Huy hiệu hiển thị Băng đạn */}
      {localQueueLength > 0 && (
        <div className={`px-5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-${mainColor}-200 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2.5 shadow-sm animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4`}>
          <Icons.Database size={18} className={`text-${mainColor}-500 animate-bounce`} />
          <span className={`text-sm font-black text-${mainColor}-700 uppercase tracking-widest`}>
            Đã nạp sẵn: {localQueueLength} câu AI
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Hiển thị Cấp độ */}
      {levelStr && <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs mt-4 italic">(Cấp độ: {levelStr})</p>}
      
      {/* Nút Hủy */}
      {onCancel && (
        <button 
          onClick={onCancel} 
          className="mt-8 text-sm text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 font-bold border px-6 py-3 rounded-xl transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 bg-white shadow-sm"
        >
          Hủy bỏ
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/components/layout/AppHeader.jsx
 * @description Thanh tiêu đề chính chứa Logo, Nút Chọn Ngôn ngữ, và Các nút bật Modals.
 * @origin Tầng 3 - Block 3.2 (Layout & Control Components)
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { LevelSelector, TopicSelectorDropdown } from '@/components/common/Controls';

export const AppHeader = ({ 
  lang, setLang, notebookCount, masteredCount, incorrectCount, 
  onOpenNotebook, onOpenMastered, onOpenIncorrect, onOpenLinkManager, 
  onOpenManual, onOpenHelp, onReload, t, studySourceName, 
  onExitStudyMode, onOpenSaveLoad, dataMode, setDataMode, 
  currentLevel, setCurrentLevel, currentTopic, setCurrentTopic 
}) => {
  const colorMap = { zh: 'red', en: 'sky' };
  const mainColor = colorMap[lang] || 'sky';
  const safeDataMode = dataMode || 'vocab';
  const safeLevel = currentLevel || (lang === 'zh' ? 'zh_level_1' : 'en_level_4');
  const safeTopic = currentTopic || '';

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-2 mb-3 relative z-10 shrink-0">
      {studySourceName && (
        <div className="w-full bg-orange-100 border-l-4 border-orange-500 text-orange-700 p-2 rounded shadow-sm flex justify-between items-center animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Icons.BookOpen size={16} />
            <span className="font-bold text-xs">Đang ôn: {studySourceName}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onExitStudyMode} className="bg-white text-orange-600 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-orange-200 text-[10px] font-bold hover:bg-orange-50 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors shadow-sm"><Icons.RotateCcw size={12} /> Thoát</button>
        </div>
      )}
      
      {/* Hàng 1: Tiêu đề & Công cụ & Nút Ngôn ngữ */}
      <div className="w-full flex justify-between items-center">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
          <h1 className={`text-lg sm:text-xl font-black truncate text-${mainColor}-700 flex items-center gap-1`}><Icons.Layers size={20} className="hidden sm:block"/> Flashcard Lite</h1>
          {/* [NÂNG CẤP UI] Nút Ngôn Ngữ được dời lên đây, thu gọn kích thước */}
          <button onClick={() => setLang(l => l === 'zh' ? 'en' : 'zh')} className={`h-[32px] px-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm text-${mainColor}-700 hover:bg-${mainColor}-50 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap`}>
            <Icons.Globe size={14} /> {lang === 'zh' ? 'CN' : 'EN'}
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 flex-wrap justify-end">
          <button onClick={onOpenNotebook} className="relative p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-orange-500 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-orange-50"><Icons.BookOpen size={16} />{notebookCount > 0 && <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-red-500 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full font-bold">{notebookCount}</span>}</button>
          <button onClick={onOpenIncorrect} className="relative p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-red-500 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-red-50"><Icons.Brain size={16} />{incorrectCount > 0 && <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-red-600 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full font-bold">{incorrectCount}</span>}</button>
          {masteredCount > 0 && (<button onClick={onOpenMastered} className="relative p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-green-600 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-green-50"><Icons.CheckCircle size={16} /><span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-green-500 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full font-bold">{masteredCount}</span></button>)}
          <button onClick={onReload} className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-blue-500 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-blue-50 hover:rotate-180 transition-all duration-500"><Icons.RefreshCw size={16} /></button>
          <button onClick={onOpenLinkManager} className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-green-600 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-green-50"><Icons.Link size={16} /></button>
          <button onClick={onOpenManual} className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-green-600 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-green-50"><Icons.Upload size={16} /></button>
          <button onClick={onOpenSaveLoad} className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-blue-600 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-blue-50"><Icons.Save size={16} /></button>
          <button onClick={onOpenHelp} className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white text-purple-600 rounded-full shadow border hover:bg-purple-50"><Icons.HelpCircle size={16} /></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Hàng 2: Filter Bar - Seamless Floating Layout */}
      {!studySourceName && (
        <div className="w-full flex flex-wrap justify-center items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 mt-1 animate-in slide-in-from-top-2">
          {/* Nhóm Chế độ Data */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start w-full sm:w-auto">
            {setDataMode && (
              <div className="h-[42px] flex bg-white p-1 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm shrink-0">
                <button onClick={() => setDataMode('vocab')} className={`h-full px-4 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center ${safeDataMode === 'vocab' ? `bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-700 shadow-sm` : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'}`}>Từ Vựng</button>
                <button onClick={() => setDataMode('sentence')} className={`h-full px-4 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center ${safeDataMode === 'sentence' ? `bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-700 shadow-sm` : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'}`}>Câu Văn</button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {/* Nhóm Level & Topic */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            {setCurrentLevel && (
              <div className="w-[calc(50%-4px)] sm:w-[140px] h-[42px]">
                <LevelSelector lang={lang} currentLevel={safeLevel} onSelectLevel={setCurrentLevel} mainColor={mainColor} />
              </div>
            )}
            {setCurrentTopic && (
              <div className="w-[calc(50%-4px)] sm:w-[180px] h-[42px]">
                <TopicSelectorDropdown currentLevel={safeLevel} currentTopic={safeTopic} onSelectTopic={setCurrentTopic} mainColor={mainColor} />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/components/layout/ControlBar.jsx
 * @description Thanh điều khiển phát nằm ở đáy thẻ Flashcard (Play, Pause, Lock, Shuffle, Bookmark).
 * @origin Tầng 3 - Block 3.2 (Layout & Control Components)
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';

export const ControlBar = ({ 
  isShuffle, setIsShuffle, handlePrev, handleNext, isAutoPlaying, 
  toggleAutoPlay, isAutoMode, handleStopAutoPlay, isFlipLocked, 
  setIsFlipLocked, handleOpenWordSelector, handleMarkMastered, 
  t, mainColor, isCurrentCardInNotebook, onToggleBatterySaver 
}) => {
  const btnClass = "w-9 h-9 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow transition-all active:scale-95";
  
  return (
    <div className="py-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-3 shrink-0">
      <button 
        onClick={() => setIsShuffle(!isShuffle)} 
        className={`${btnClass} ${isShuffle ? 'bg-' + mainColor + '-100 text-' + mainColor + '-600' : 'bg-white text-gray-400 border border-gray-200 hover:text-gray-600'}`} 
        title={t('ttShuffle')}
      >
        <Icons.Shuffle size={18} className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
      </button>
      
      <button 
        onClick={handlePrev} 
        className={`${btnClass} bg-white text-gray-400 border border-gray-200 hover:text-gray-600`} 
        title={t('ttPrev')}
      >
        <Icons.ChevronLeft size={18} className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
      </button>
      
      <button 
        onClick={toggleAutoPlay} 
        className={`w-11 h-11 sm:w-14 sm:h-14 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-lg border-2 transition-all transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 ${isAutoPlaying ? 'bg-orange-100 border-orange-400 text-orange-600 animate-pulse' : 'bg-white border-' + mainColor + '-100 text-' + mainColor + '-600'}`} 
        title={t('ttAutoPlay')}
      >
        {isAutoPlaying ? <Icons.Pause size={24} fill="currentColor" className="sm:w-7 sm:h-7" /> : <Icons.Play size={24} fill="currentColor" className="sm:w-7 sm:h-7" />}
      </button>
      
      {isAutoMode && (
        <button 
          onClick={() => setIsFlipLocked(!isFlipLocked)} 
          className={`${btnClass} ${isFlipLocked ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-600 border-red-400' : 'bg-white text-gray-400 border border-gray-200 hover:text-red-400'}`} 
          title={t('ttFlipLock')}
        >
          {isFlipLocked ? <Icons.Lock size={18} className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" /> : <Icons.Unlock size={18} className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />}
        </button>
      )}
      
      {isAutoMode && (
        <button 
          onClick={onToggleBatterySaver} 
          className={`${btnClass} bg-gray-800 text-yellow-400 border border-gray-600 hover:bg-black hover:text-yellow-300`} 
          title="Chế độ Rảnh tay (Giữ màn hình sáng + Tiết kiệm pin)"
        >
          <Icons.Moon size={18} fill="currentColor" className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
        </button>
      )}
      
      {isAutoMode && (
        <button 
          onClick={handleStopAutoPlay} 
          className={`${btnClass} bg-white border border-gray-200 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700`} 
          title={t('ttStop')}
        >
          <Icons.Square size={18} fill="currentColor" className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
        </button>
      )}
      
      <button 
        onClick={handleOpenWordSelector} 
        className={`${btnClass} ${isCurrentCardInNotebook ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-600 border-yellow-400 scale-110 hover:scale-100' : 'bg-white text-gray-400 border border-gray-200 hover:text-yellow-400'}`} 
        data-tooltip={t('ttBookmark')}
      >
        <Icons.Bookmark size={18} fill={isCurrentCardInNotebook ? "currentColor" : "none"} className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
      </button>
      
      <button 
        onClick={handleNext} 
        className={`${btnClass} bg-white text-gray-400 border border-gray-200 hover:text-gray-600`} 
        title={t('ttNext')}
      >
        <Icons.ChevronRight size={18} className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
      </button>
      
      <button 
        onClick={handleMarkMastered} 
        className={`${btnClass} bg-white border border-gray-200 text-green-500 hover:bg-green-50 hover:text-green-700`} 
        data-tooltip="Đánh dấu đã thuộc"
      >
        <Icons.CheckCircle size={18} className="sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

=========================================
FILE: src\components\layout\FlashcardDisplay.jsx
=========================================

/**
   * @file src/components/layout/FlashcardDisplay.jsx
   * @description Giao diện hiển thị Thẻ từ vựng 3D khổng lồ, bao gồm input gõ từ, nhảy thẻ nhanh và các nút chức năng.
   * @origin Tầng 3 - Block 3.2 (Layout & Control Components)
   */

  import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
  import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
  import { AiModeSwitch } from '@/components/common/Controls';
  import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';

  export const FlashcardDisplay = ({ 
    isFlipped, setIsFlipped, isAutoPlaying, currentCardIndex, cards, settings, 
    mainColor, speak, getCardStyle, isAiMode, setAiMode, t, onMissingKey, 
    isLoading, onEnrichCard, onNext, onPrev, onExplainGrammar, onSrsGrade, 
    onResetSrs, isContentHidden, isMuted, onToggleMute, lang, onOpenHanzi, 
    onJumpToCard 
  }) => {
    const currentCard = cards[currentCardIndex];
    const hasImage = currentCard?.image && currentCard.image.trim() !== "";
    const isDefFirst = settings.startSide === 'def';
    const scale = settings.cardSize || 1;
    const isSentence = currentCard ? Utils.detectSentence(currentCard.term) : false;
    
    const [typingInput, setTypingInput] = useState('');
    const [typingStatus, setTypingStatus] = useState('idle');
    const typingInputRef = useRef(null);
    const [jumpInput, setJumpInput] = useState('');
    
    // [V1.09] State ẩn/hiện trường Analysis
    const [showAnalysis, setShowAnalysis] = useState(false);
    
    useEffect(() => {
      setTypingInput('');
      setTypingStatus('idle');
      setJumpInput('');
      setShowAnalysis(false); // Reset state analysis khi đổi thẻ
    }, [currentCardIndex]);
    
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!isFlipped) {
        setShowAnalysis(false); // Tự động ẩn analysis khi lật về mặt trước
      }
    }, [isFlipped]);
    
    useEffect(() => {
      const handleGlobalKeyDown = (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Delete') {
          if (e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' && e.target !== typingInputRef.current)) {
            return;
          }
          e.preventDefault();
          setTypingInput('');
          setTypingStatus('idle');
          setTimeout(() => {
            typingInputRef.current?.focus();
          }, 10);
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleGlobalKeyDown);
      return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleGlobalKeyDown);
    }, []);
    
    const [delayedHidden, setDelayedHidden] = useState(isContentHidden);
    useEffect(() => {
      if (isContentHidden) {
        setDelayedHidden(true);
      } else {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          setDelayedHidden(false);
        }, 200);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    }, [isContentHidden, currentCardIndex]);
    
    const [touchStart, setTouchStart] = useState(null);
    const [touchEnd, setTouchEnd] = useState(null);
    const minSwipeDistance = 50;
    
    const onTouchStart = (e) => {
      setTouchEnd(null);
      setTouchStart({ x: e.targetTouches[0].clientX, y: e.targetTouches[0].clientY });
    };
    
    const onTouchMove = (e) => {
      setTouchEnd({ x: e.targetTouches[0].clientX, y: e.targetTouches[0].clientY });
    };
    
    const onTouchEnd = () => {
      if (!touchStart || !touchEnd) return;
      const distanceX = touchStart.x - touchEnd.x;
      const distanceY = touchStart.y - touchEnd.y;
      if (Math.abs(distanceY) > Math.abs(distanceX)) return;
      if (distanceX > minSwipeDistance && onNext) onNext();
      if (distanceX < -minSwipeDistance && onPrev) onPrev();
    };
    
    const getSrsLabel = (grade) => {
      if (!currentCard || !Utils?.calculateSRS) return "";
      const result = Utils.calculateSRS(currentCard, grade, settings);
      return Utils.getSrsTimeLabel(result.srs_interval);
    };
    
    const getFontFamily = () => {
      const font = settings?.fontFamily || 'sans';
      switch (font) {
        case 'serif': return '"Noto Serif SC", serif';
        case 'kaiti': return '"KaiTi", "STKaiti", "楷体", "LXGW WenKai Lite", serif';
        case 'callig': return '"Long Cang", cursive';
        case 'cn_kaiti': return '"KaiTi", "STKaiti", "楷体", serif';
        default: return 'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';
      }
    };
    
    const handleCheckTyping = () => {
      if (!currentCard) return;
      const clean = (str) => str.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, "").trim();
      const inputClean = clean(typingInput);
      const targetClean = clean(currentCard.term);
      if (inputClean === targetClean) {
        setTypingStatus('correct');
        if (speak && !isAutoPlaying) speak(currentCard.term);
      } else {
        setTypingStatus('wrong');
      }
    };
    
    const handleJumpSubmit = () => {
      if (!jumpInput) return;
      let target = parseInt(jumpInput, 10);
      if (isNaN(target)) { setJumpInput(''); return; }
      if (target < 1) target = 1;
      if (target > cards.length) target = cards.length;
      if (onJumpToCard && target !== currentCardIndex + 1) { onJumpToCard(target); }
      setJumpInput('');
      if (document.activeElement) document.activeElement.blur();
    };
    
    const isSrsEnabled = settings.srsEnabled !== false;
    const sinoVietLabel = mainColor === 'sky' ? "Dịch chi tiết" : t('sinoVietLabel');
    const cardStyle = { '--fc-scale': scale, transform: isFlipped ? 'rotateY(180deg)' : 'rotateY(0deg)' };
    const inputGroupStyle = { '--fc-scale': scale };

    return (
      <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center shrink-0 my-auto py-2">
        <style>{`
          /* [VÁ LỖI GIẬT MÀN HÌNH] Giữ chỗ thanh cuộn cho khung App chính, chống layout shift khi lật thẻ 3D */
          div.max-w-7xl.custom-scrollbar {
            scrollbar-gutter: stable;
          }
          .fc-card {
            display: grid;
            width: calc(100% * var(--fc-scale));
            max-width: 100%;
            margin: 0 auto;
            height: calc(360px * var(--fc-scale));
            will-change: transform;
            transform-style: preserve-3d;
            transition: transform 0.7s;
          }
          .fc-face {
            grid-area: 1 / 1;
            backface-visibility: hidden;
            -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
            border-radius: 1rem;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
            background-color: white;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
          }
          .fc-back {
            transform: rotateY(180deg);
          }
          .fc-input-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            width: calc(100% * var(--fc-scale));
            max-width: 100%;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
            box-sizing: border-box;
          }
          .fc-card-image {
            position: relative;
            height: calc(120px * var(--fc-scale));
            width: auto;
            aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
          }
          @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .fc-card { width: calc(600px * var(--fc-scale)); }
            .fc-input-group { width: calc(600px * var(--fc-scale)); }
            .fc-card-image {
              position: absolute;
              right: 1rem;
              top: 50%;
              transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(6deg);
              height: 8rem;
              width: 8rem;
              margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            .fc-card-image:hover {
              transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(0deg) scale(1.1);
              z-index: 50;
            }
          }
        `}</style>
        
        <div className="fc-input-group" style={inputGroupStyle}>
          <input
            ref={typingInputRef}
            value={typingInput}
            onChange={(e) => { setTypingInput(e.target.value); setTypingStatus('idle'); }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                handleCheckTyping();
                e.target.blur();
              }
            }}
            className={`flex-1 min-w-0 p-3 rounded-xl border-2 outline-none transition-all font-medium shadow-sm ${typingStatus === 'correct' ? 'border-green-500 bg-green-50 text-green-700' : typingStatus === 'wrong' ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-50 text-red-700' : 'border-white focus:border-blue-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100'}`}
            placeholder={t('modeScramble').replace('Ghép Câu', 'Gõ lại từ vựng... (Phím Delete để xóa nhanh)')}
            style={{ fontFamily: getFontFamily() }}
            autoComplete="off"
            autoCapitalize="off"
          />
          <button
            onClick={handleCheckTyping}
            className={`px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-white shadow transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 ${typingStatus === 'correct' ? 'bg-green-500' : typingStatus === 'wrong' ? 'bg-red-500' : `bg-${mainColor}-500 hover:bg-${mainColor}-600`}`}
          >
            {typingStatus === 'correct' ? <Icons.Check size={20} /> : (typingStatus === 'wrong' ? <Icons.X size={20} /> : <Icons.CheckCircle size={20} />)}
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="w-full flex justify-center perspective-1000" onTouchStart={onTouchStart} onTouchMove={onTouchMove} onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}>
          <div key={currentCardIndex} className="fc-card cursor-pointer" style={cardStyle} onClick={() => !isAutoPlaying && setIsFlipped(!isFlipped)}>
            <div className="fc-face fc-front flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-6 border-2 border-gray-100">
              {!isFlipped && (
                <AiModeSwitch isAiMode={isAiMode} setAiMode={setAiMode} t={t} onMissingKey={onMissingKey} isLoading={isLoading} className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-50" />
              )}
              
              {/* TÍNH NĂNG NHẢY THẺ (QUICK JUMP) */}
              <div className="self-start flex items-center text-xs text-gray-400 relative z-[60]" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
                <input
                  type="text" inputMode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*"
                  value={jumpInput !== '' ? jumpInput : (currentCardIndex + 1)}
                  onChange={(e) => setJumpInput(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleJumpSubmit(); }}
                  disabled={isAutoPlaying}
                  className={`w-8 sm:w-10 text-center bg-transparent outline-none transition-all py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${isAutoPlaying ? 'cursor-default' : 'hover:bg-gray-100 focus:bg-blue-50 focus:text-blue-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-300 cursor-text'}`}
                  title={isAutoPlaying ? "Đang chạy tự động" : "Nhập số để chuyển thẻ"}
                />
                <span className="mx-0.5">/</span>
                <span>{cards.length}</span>
                {jumpInput !== '' && parseInt(jumpInput, 10) !== currentCardIndex + 1 && (
                  <button onClick={handleJumpSubmit} className="ml-1.5 p-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded hover:bg-blue-200 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm">
                    <Icons.Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              
              <div className={`flex-1 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-center w-full relative min-h-[150px]`}>
                {!delayedHidden ? (
                  <>
                    <div
                      className={`text-center break-words w-full order-2 md:order-1 ${hasImage ? 'md:pr-40' : 'px-4'} flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar`}
                      style={{ ...getCardStyle(false), fontWeight: settings?.fontWeight || 'bold', fontFamily: isDefFirst ? 'inherit' : getFontFamily() }}
                    >
                      {isDefFirst ? currentCard?.definition : currentCard?.term}
                    </div>
                    {hasImage && (
                      <div className="fc-card-image order-1 md:order-2 p-1 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-gray-100">
                        <img src={currentCard.image} alt="minh họa" className="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-lg" onError={(e) => { e.target.parentElement.style.display = 'none' }} />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 animate-pulse text-gray-300 w-full justify-center">
                    <Icons.Eye size={64} className="opacity-20" />
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] opacity-40">Kiểm tra trí nhớ</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] italic opacity-30 mt-1">Vui lòng tự nhớ mặt chữ...</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              
              <div className="flex justify-center mt-2 gap-3 shrink-0">
                <button
                  onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); speak(cards[currentCardIndex]?.term); }}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-full bg-white text-${mainColor}-500 shadow border-2 border-${mainColor}-100 hover:scale-105 disabled:opacity-20`}
                  disabled={isContentHidden}
                >
                  <Icons.Volume2 size={24} />
                </button>
                {lang === 'zh' && (
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (onOpenHanzi) onOpenHanzi(cards[currentCardIndex]?.term); }}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-full bg-white text-red-600 shadow border-2 border-red-100 hover:scale-105 transition-transform`}
                    disabled={isContentHidden}
                    title="Tập viết chữ Hán"
                  >
                    <Icons.Brush size={24} />
                  </button>
                )}
                {isAutoPlaying && (
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (onToggleMute) onToggleMute(); }}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-full shadow border-2 hover:scale-105 transition-all ${isMuted ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-500 border-red-100' : 'bg-white text-gray-400 border-gray-200'}`}
                    title={isMuted ? "Bật tiếng" : "Tắt tiếng (Giữ thời gian đọc)"}
                  >
                    {isMuted ? <Icons.VolumeX size={24} /> : <Icons.Volume2 size={24} className="opacity-50" />}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className={`fc-face fc-back bg-${mainColor}-50 border-${mainColor}-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-between pt-6 px-6 pb-2 border-2`}>
              {isSrsEnabled && (
                <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
                  {currentCard?.srs_interval ? (
                    <>
                      <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full border bg-white shadow-sm ${currentCard.srs_interval > 3 ? 'text-green-600 border-green-200' : 'text-orange-600 border-orange-200'}`}>
                        Ôn tập: {Utils?.getSrsTimeLabel ? Utils.getSrsTimeLabel(currentCard.srs_interval) : `${currentCard.srs_interval}d`}
                      </span>
                      <button
                        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (onResetSrs) onResetSrs(); }}
                        className="p-1 bg-white text-gray-400 rounded-full border border-gray-200 hover:text-red-500 hover:border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50 hover:rotate-180 transition-all shadow-sm"
                        title="Reset về trạng thái Mới"
                      >
                        <Icons.RotateCcw size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full border bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 border-gray-200">
                      Mới
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
              
              <div
                className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar w-full flex-1 justify-start mt-6 min-h-[150px]"
                style={{ ...getCardStyle(true), fontFamily: 'inherit' }}
              >
                {/* [V1.12] TÍCH HỢP HIỂN THỊ TỪ LOẠI NGAY SAU PHIÊN ÂM (Dictionary Style + Parentheses) */}
                <div className={`text-${mainColor}-600 font-medium flex items-center justify-center flex-wrap gap-3`} style={{ fontSize: '1.1em' }}>
                  <span>{currentCard?.pronunciation}</span>
                  {currentCard?.partOfSpeech && !isSentence && (
                    <span className="italic text-[0.75em] opacity-80 lowercase">
                      ({currentCard.partOfSpeech})
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="text-gray-800 text-center my-1" style={{ fontSize: '1em', marginTop: '8px', fontWeight: settings?.fontWeight || 'bold', fontFamily: isDefFirst ? getFontFamily() : 'inherit' }}>
                  {isDefFirst ? currentCard?.term : currentCard?.definition}
                </div>
                
                {/* [V1.09] Hệ thống Tiết lộ Lũy tiến (Progressive Disclosure) cho trường Analysis */}
                {currentCard?.analysis && (
                  <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center mt-2 mb-1 animate-in fade-in">
                    <button
                      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setShowAnalysis(!showAnalysis); }}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border shadow-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 font-bold ${showAnalysis ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border-purple-300' : 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 border-purple-200 hover:bg-purple-100'}`}
                      style={{ fontSize: '0.75em' }}
                    >
                      <Icons.Sparkles size={12} /> {showAnalysis ? "Ẩn giải thích" : (isSentence ? "Xem phân tích ngữ pháp" : "Xem phân tích chi tiết")}
                    </button>
                    {showAnalysis && (
                      <div
                        className="w-full text-left bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-purple-100 shadow-inner mt-2 text-gray-700 leading-relaxed overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar animate-in slide-in-from-top-2"
                        style={{ fontSize: '0.85em', maxHeight: '150px' }}
                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                      >
                        <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{currentCard.analysis}</div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
                
                {currentCard?.sinoViet && (
                  <div className="text-gray-500 italic bg-white/50 px-2 py-1 rounded text-center mt-1" style={{ fontSize: '0.85em' }}>
                    <span className="font-bold uppercase opacity-70 mr-1" style={{ fontSize: '0.9em' }}>{sinoVietLabel}:</span>
                    {currentCard?.sinoViet}
                  </div>
                )}
                
                {/* [V1.13 DEFENSIVE RENDERING] Thuật toán Bẻ dòng thông minh nhận diện marker "- " */}
                {currentCard?.example && (
                  <div className="text-gray-600 text-left italic w-full border-t border-gray-200 pt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap mt-2" style={{ fontSize: '0.85em' }}>
                    {currentCard.example.includes('- ')
                      ? currentCard.example.split('- ').filter(p => p.trim() !== '').map(p => '- ' + p.trim()).join('\n')
                      : currentCard.example}
                  </div>
                )}
                
                {!currentCard?.analysis && (
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onExplainGrammar(); }}
                    className="mt-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 font-bold border border-purple-200 rounded-full shadow-sm hover:bg-purple-100 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0"
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.75em' }}
                  >
                    <Icons.Sparkles size={12} /> {isSentence ? "Tạo phân tích ngữ pháp" : "Tạo phân tích chi tiết"}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              
              {onSrsGrade && isSrsEnabled && (
                <div className="w-full mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-gray-200/30 grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 z-20 shrink-0">
                  <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onSrsGrade('again'); }} className="flex flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1 py-2 px-0.5 bg-red-100 text-red-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-200 active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">{t('srsAgain')}</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] opacity-70 font-mono">{getSrsLabel('again')}</span>
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onSrsGrade('hard'); }} className="flex flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1 py-2 px-0.5 bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-orange-200 active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">{t('srsHard')}</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] opacity-70 font-mono">{getSrsLabel('hard')}</span>
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onSrsGrade('good'); }} className="flex flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1 py-2 px-0.5 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-200 active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">{t('srsGood')}</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] opacity-70 font-mono">{getSrsLabel('good')}</span>
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onSrsGrade('easy'); }} className="flex flex-row items-center justify-center gap-1 py-2 px-0.5 bg-green-100 text-green-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-200 active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">{t('srsEasy')}</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] opacity-70 font-mono">{getSrsLabel('easy')}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/AiChatModal.jsx
 * @description Khung Chat đa nhiệm tự do với AI Gemini. Hỗ trợ hỏi đáp ngữ pháp, Windows Controls, Drag & Resize.
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.5 (AI Chat Assistant Modal)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';

export const AiChatModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, apiKey, lang, t, mainColor }) => {
  // --- 1. STATE & REFS ---
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('fc_ai_chat_history');
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [{
      id: 'init',
      role: 'model',
      text: "Xin chào! Tôi là trợ lý AI của Flashcard Lite. Tôi có thể giúp gì cho việc học của bạn hôm nay?"
    }];
  });
  
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
  
  // State cho Kích thước Cửa sổ
  const [size, setSize] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const savedSize = localStorage.getItem('fc_aichat_size');
      return savedSize ? JSON.parse(savedSize) : { width: 450, height: 600 };
    } catch { return { width: 450, height: 600 }; }
  });
  
  // State cho Bộ điều khiển Cửa sổ (Windows Controls)
  const [isMaximized, setIsMaximized] = useState(false);
  const [isMinimized, setIsMinimized] = useState(false);
  const [preMaxGeometry, setPreMaxGeometry] = useState(null);
  
  // Refs cho UI
  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);
  
  // Ref cho Drag & Resize
  const [position, setPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const dragRef = useRef({ isDragging: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, initialX: 0, initialY: 0 });
  const resizeRef = useRef({ isResizing: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, startWidth: 0, startHeight: 0 });

  // --- 2. EFFECTS ---
  // Auto scroll xuống cuối khi có tin nhắn mới
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMinimized) {
      messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
    localStorage.setItem('fc_ai_chat_history', JSON.stringify(messages));
  }, [messages, isMinimized]);
  
  // Lưu kích thước cửa sổ (chỉ lưu khi không ở chế độ Maximize/Minimize)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMaximized && !isMinimized) {
      localStorage.setItem('fc_aichat_size', JSON.stringify(size));
    }
  }, [size, isMaximized, isMinimized]);
  
  // Focus vào input khi mở
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && !isMinimized) setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 100);
  }, [isOpen, isMinimized]);

  // --- 3. LOGIC XỬ LÝ CHAT ---
  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!input.trim() || isSending) return;
    
    if (!apiKey) {
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Vui lòng nhập API Key trong Cài đặt trước!", "warning");
      else alert("Vui lòng nhập API Key trong Cài đặt trước!");
      return;
    }
    
    const userText = input.trim();
    const newMessage = { id: Date.now(), role: 'user', text: userText };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, newMessage]);
    setInput("");
    setIsSending(true);
    
    try {
      // Xây dựng ngữ cảnh hội thoại (Context)
      const historyContext = messages.slice(-10).map(m =>
        `${m.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Model'}: ${m.text}`
      ).join('\n');
      
      const systemPrompt = `Bạn là trợ lý ảo hữu ích cho ứng dụng học từ vựng Flashcard Lite.
Ngôn ngữ học tập hiện tại của người dùng là: ${lang === 'zh' ? 'Tiếng Trung' : (lang === 'en' ? 'Tiếng Anh' : 'Tiếng Việt')}.
QUY TẮC GIAO TIẾP QUAN TRỌNG:
1. LUÔN LUÔN trả lời và giải thích bằng TIẾNG VIỆT (Vietnamese), trừ khi người dùng yêu cầu dịch sang ngôn ngữ khác hoặc yêu cầu cụ thể khác.
2. Nếu người dùng hỏi về từ vựng, hãy giải thích nghĩa, cách dùng và ví dụ.
3. Trả lời ngắn gọn, súc tích, thân thiện.
Hỗ trợ định dạng Markdown nhẹ (Bold, Italic, List).`;
      
      const fullPrompt = `${systemPrompt}\n\nLịch sử chat:\n${historyContext}\n\nUser: ${userText}\nModel:`;
      
      // Gọi API trực tiếp qua module
      const result = await Utils.callGeminiApi(fullPrompt, null, apiKey);
      
      const aiMessage = {
        id: Date.now() + 1,
        role: 'model',
        text: result.text || "Xin lỗi, tôi không thể trả lời lúc này."
      };
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, aiMessage]);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Chat Error:", error);
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
        id: Date.now(),
        role: 'model',
        text: `⚠️ Lỗi: ${error.message || "Không thể kết nối đến AI."}`
      }]);
    } finally {
      setIsSending(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleClearHistory = () => {
    if (window.confirm("Xóa toàn bộ lịch sử trò chuyện?")) {
      setMessages([{
        id: Date.now(),
        role: 'model',
        text: "Lịch sử đã được xóa. Chúng bắt đầu lại nhé!"
      }]);
    }
  };

  // --- 4. LOGIC CỬA SỔ (WINDOWS CONTROLS) ---
  const handleMaximizeToggle = () => {
    if (isMinimized) setIsMinimized(false); // Đánh thức nếu đang thu nhỏ
    if (!isMaximized) {
      // Lưu trữ hình học trước khi phóng to
      setPreMaxGeometry({ position: { ...position }, size: { ...size } });
      setPosition({ x: 0, y: 0 }); // Ép về góc trên cùng bên trái
      setIsMaximized(true);
    } else {
      // Phục hồi hình học cũ
      if (preMaxGeometry) {
        setPosition(preMaxGeometry.position);
        setSize(preMaxGeometry.size);
      }
      setIsMaximized(false);
    }
  };
  
  const handleMinimizeToggle = () => {
    setIsMinimized(!isMinimized);
    if (isMaximized && !isMinimized) {
      // Nếu đang phóng to mà bấm thu nhỏ, thoát chế độ phóng to luôn
      setIsMaximized(false);
      if (preMaxGeometry) {
        setPosition(preMaxGeometry.position);
        setSize(preMaxGeometry.size);
      }
    }
  };

  // --- 5. LOGIC KÉO THẢ (DRAG) ---
  const handleMouseDown = (e) => {
    if (isMaximized) return; // Hóa đá kéo thả khi Full-screen
    if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('input') || e.target.closest('.no-drag')) return;
    
    const clientX = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientX : e.touches[0].clientX;
    const clientY = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientY : e.touches[0].clientY;
    
    dragRef.current = { isDragging: true, startX: clientX, startY: clientY, initialX: position.x, initialY: position.y };
    
    const move = (e) => {
      if (!dragRef.current.isDragging) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const cx = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientX : e.touches[0].clientX;
      const cy = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientY : e.touches[0].clientY;
      const dx = cx - dragRef.current.startX;
      const dy = cy - dragRef.current.startY;
      setPosition({ x: dragRef.current.initialX + dx, y: dragRef.current.initialY + dy });
    };
    
    const up = () => {
      dragRef.current.isDragging = false;
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', up);
      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('touchend', up);
    };
    
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', move, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', up);
  };

  // --- 6. LOGIC KÉO GIÃN (RESIZE) ---
  const handleResizeMouseDown = (e) => {
    if (isMaximized || isMinimized) return; // Hóa đá co giãn khi Full-screen hoặc Minimized
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    const clientX = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientX : e.touches[0].clientX;
    const clientY = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientY : e.touches[0].clientY;
    
    resizeRef.current = {
      isResizing: true,
      startX: clientX,
      startY: clientY,
      startWidth: size.width,
      startHeight: size.height
    };
    
    const move = (e) => {
      if (!resizeRef.current.isResizing) return;
      if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
      
      const cx = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientX : e.touches[0].clientX;
      const cy = e.type.includes('mouse') ? e.clientY : e.touches[0].clientY;
      const dx = cx - resizeRef.current.startX;
      const dy = cy - resizeRef.current.startY;
      
      // Giới hạn chiều rộng và chiều cao tối thiểu
      setSize({
        width: Math.max(300, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 40, resizeRef.current.startWidth + dx)),
        height: Math.max(400, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 40, resizeRef.current.startHeight + dy))
      });
    };
    
    const up = () => {
      resizeRef.current.isResizing = false;
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', up);
      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('touchend', up);
    };
    
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', move, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', up);
  };

  // --- 7. RENDER HELPER ---
  const renderMarkdown = (text) => {
    let html = text
      .replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>') // Bold
      .replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>') // Italic
      .replace(/`(.*?)`/g, '<code class="bg-gray-200 px-1 rounded font-mono text-xs">$1</code>') // Code
      .replace(/\n/g, '<br/>'); // Newline
    return <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }} />;
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[200] flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
      {/* Overlay click to close */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-transparent pointer-events-auto" onClick={onClose}></div>
      
      <div
        className={`bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md shadow-2xl flex flex-col z-10 overflow-hidden pointer-events-auto border border-gray-200 transition-all duration-200 ease-out relative ${isMaximized ? 'rounded-none' : 'rounded-2xl'}`}
        style={{
          transform: `translate(${position.x}px, ${position.y}px)`,
          width: isMaximized ? '100vw' : `${size.width}px`,
          height: isMinimized ? 'auto' : (isMaximized ? '100vh' : `${size.height}px`),
          maxWidth: '100vw',
          maxHeight: '100vh',
          top: isMaximized ? 0 : 'auto',
          left: isMaximized ? 0 : 'auto',
          position: isMaximized ? 'fixed' : 'relative'
        }}
      >
        {/* Header (Draggable & Windows Controls) */}
        <div
          className={`flex justify-between items-center p-3 border-b bg-${mainColor}-50 select-none transition-colors ${isMaximized ? 'cursor-default' : 'cursor-move active:bg-gray-100'}`}
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown} onTouchStart={handleMouseDown}
          onDoubleClick={handleMaximizeToggle}
        >
          <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-${mainColor}-700 font-bold pointer-events-none`}>
            <Icons.Sparkles size={20} /> AI Chat Assistant
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 items-center no-drag">
            <button onClick={handleClearHistory} className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-lg transition-colors mr-1" title="Xóa lịch sử">
              <Icons.Trash2 size={16} />
            </button>
            <div className="w-px h-4 bg-gray-300 mx-1"></div>
            {/* Nút Minimize */}
            <button onClick={handleMinimizeToggle} className="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Thu nhỏ">
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"></line></svg>
            </button>
            {/* Nút Maximize / Restore */}
            <button onClick={handleMaximizeToggle} className="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-lg transition-colors" title={isMaximized ? "Phục hồi" : "Phóng to"}>
              {isMaximized ? (
                <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M9 4v16"></path></svg>
              ) : (
                <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect></svg>
              )}
            </button>
            {/* Nút Close */}
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-white hover:bg-red-500 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Đóng">
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line></svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {/* Thân Chat & Input (Bị ẩn khi Minimized, Thêm class select-text) */}
        {!isMinimized && (
          <>
            {/* Messages Area */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-4 space-y-3 bg-gray-50 no-drag select-text cursor-text">
              {messages.map((msg) => (
                <div key={msg.id} className={`flex ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}>
                  <div
                    className={`
                      max-w-[85%] p-3 rounded-2xl text-sm shadow-sm leading-relaxed select-text cursor-text
                      ${msg.role === 'user'
                        ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white rounded-br-none`
                        : 'bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-800 rounded-bl-none'}
                    `}
                  >
                    {renderMarkdown(msg.text)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
              
              {isSending && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 p-3 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-none shadow-sm flex gap-1 items-center">
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-gray-400 rounded-full animate-bounce"></div>
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-gray-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{animationDelay: '0.1s'}}></div>
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-gray-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{animationDelay: '0.2s'}}></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
            </div>
            
            {/* Input Area */}
            <div className="p-3 border-t bg-white no-drag pb-4 select-text">
              <div className="flex gap-2 items-end">
                <textarea
                  ref={inputRef}
                  value={input}
                  onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      handleSend();
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Hỏi tôi bất cứ điều gì..."
                  className="flex-1 p-3 border rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none resize-none bg-gray-50 text-sm max-h-24 custom-scrollbar select-text cursor-text"
                  rows="1"
                  style={{minHeight: '44px'}}
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleSend}
                  disabled={!input.trim() || isSending}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white shadow-lg hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition-all active:scale-95 flex-shrink-0 h-[44px] w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center`}
                >
                  {isSending ? (
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                  ) : (
                    <Icons.Play size={20} className="ml-0.5" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Resize Grip (Chỉ hiển thị khi không phóng to) */}
            {!isMaximized && (
              <div
                className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-6 h-6 cursor-se-resize z-[100] flex items-end justify-end p-1 opacity-40 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity no-drag"
                onMouseDown={handleResizeMouseDown}
                onTouchStart={handleResizeMouseDown}
                title="Kéo để đổi kích thước"
              >
                <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="text-gray-500">
                  <path d="M11 1L1 11M11 5L5 11M11 9L9 11" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                </svg>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src\components\modals\AiConfigModal.jsx

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/AiConfigModal.jsx
 * @description Bảng điều khiển thông số Lõi AI (Độ trễ chờ mạng, Băng đạn tải trước, v.v.).
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.6 (Sync & Import Modals)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';

export const AiConfigModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, aiConfig, setAiConfig, mainColor = 'purple' }) => {
  // Khởi tạo localConfig. Cooldown 429 đã dời sang Radar, nhưng vẫn giữ trong State để tương thích hàm Lưu
  const [localConfig, setLocalConfig] = useState(aiConfig || { loadingTime: 22, delayMs: 2500, maxAmmo: 4, uiCooldown: 9, cooldown429: 120 });
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setLocalConfig(aiConfig || { loadingTime: 22, delayMs: 2500, maxAmmo: 4, uiCooldown: 9, cooldown429: 120 });
    }
  }, [isOpen, aiConfig]);
  
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  
  const handleChange = (key, val) => {
    setLocalConfig(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: Number(val) }));
  };
  
  const handleSave = () => {
    setAiConfig(localConfig);
    if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Đã lưu cấu hình Lõi AI!", "success");
    onClose();
  };
  
  const handleReset = () => {
    const def = { loadingTime: 22, delayMs: 2500, maxAmmo: 4, uiCooldown: 9, cooldown429: 120 };
    setLocalConfig(def);
  };
  
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[250] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md flex flex-col overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh]">
        <div className={`p-4 border-b bg-${mainColor}-50 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0`}>
          <h3 className={`font-bold text-${mainColor}-700 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg`}>
            <Icons.Sparkles size={24} /> Bảng Điều Khiển Lõi AI
          </h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 transition-colors">
            <Icons.X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex-1 space-y-6 bg-gray-50/50">
          <div className="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 p-3 rounded-lg text-xs text-yellow-800 font-medium">
            Cảnh báo: Thay đổi các thông số này có thể ảnh hưởng đến trải nghiệm game hoặc gây lỗi giới hạn API (Rate Limit).
          </div>
          
          {/* Loading Time */}
          <div className="space-y-2 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">Thời gian đếm ngược (Loading)</label>
              <span className={`text-sm font-mono font-bold text-${mainColor}-600`}>{localConfig.loadingTime}s</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Đồng hồ đếm lùi giả lập trong lúc chờ nạp đạn AI (Mặc định: 22s).</p>
            <input type="range" min="5" max="60" step="1" value={localConfig.loadingTime} onChange={(e) => handleChange('loadingTime', e.target.value)} className={`w-full h-1.5 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-${mainColor}-500`} />
          </div>
          
          {/* Delay Ms */}
          <div className="space-y-2 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">Thời gian tản nhiệt (Delay)</label>
              <span className={`text-sm font-mono font-bold text-${mainColor}-600`}>{localConfig.delayMs}ms</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Khoảng nghỉ giữa 2 lần gọi API để tránh lỗi Spam 429 (Mặc định: 2500ms).</p>
            <input type="range" min="1500" max="10000" step="500" value={localConfig.delayMs} onChange={(e) => handleChange('delayMs', e.target.value)} className={`w-full h-1.5 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-${mainColor}-500`} />
          </div>
          
          {/* Max Ammo */}
          <div className="space-y-2 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">Băng đạn tối đa (Max Ammo)</label>
              <span className={`text-sm font-mono font-bold text-${mainColor}-600`}>{localConfig.maxAmmo} viên</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Số lượng câu hỏi được AI tải sẵn dưới nền (Mặc định: 4 viên).</p>
            <input type="range" min="2" max="6" step="1" value={localConfig.maxAmmo} onChange={(e) => handleChange('maxAmmo', e.target.value)} className={`w-full h-1.5 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-${mainColor}-500`} />
          </div>
          
          {/* UI Cooldown */}
          <div className="space-y-2 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">Thời gian làm nguội (UI Cooldown)</label>
              <span className={`text-sm font-mono font-bold text-${mainColor}-600`}>{localConfig.uiCooldown || 9}s</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Thời gian khóa nút chuyển câu để chống spam, bảo vệ băng đạn (Mặc định: 9s).</p>
            <input type="range" min="1" max="15" step="1" value={localConfig.uiCooldown || 9} onChange={(e) => handleChange('uiCooldown', e.target.value)} className={`w-full h-1.5 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-${mainColor}-500`} />
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 border-t bg-white shrink-0 rounded-b-xl flex justify-between gap-3">
          <button onClick={handleReset} className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors">
            Mặc định
          </button>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2 text-gray-600 font-bold hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors">
              Hủy
            </button>
            <button onClick={handleSave} className={`px-6 py-2 bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold shadow-md hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-2`}>
              <Icons.Check size={18} /> Lưu
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src\components\modals\ApiKeyModal.jsx
