/**
 * @file src/components/modals/ApiKeyModal.jsx
 * @description Quản lý Kho đạn API Key (Radar & RPD Matrix). Tích hợp Auto Cascade, Premium Mode, thay đổi AI Model.
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.6 (Sync & Import Modals)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { STORAGE_KEYS, AI_MODELS } from '@/config/constants';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { pingGeminiKey, getCooldown429Ms, setKeyCooldown, triggerGlobalPause, RPDTracker } from '@/services/geminiApi';

export const ApiKeyModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, apiKey, setApiKey, aiModel, setAiModel, t }) => {
  const [keyPool, setKeyPool] = useState([]);
  const [isTesting, setIsTesting] = useState(false);
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState({});
  const [newKeyInput, setNewKeyInput] = useState('');
  
  // Local State cho Cooldown Slider
  const [localCooldown, setLocalCooldown] = useState(120);
  // Local State cho Model Selector
  const [localAiModel, setLocalAiModel] = useState('gemini-3.5-flash-lite');
  // Local State cho Premium Mode
  const [isPremium, setIsPremium] = useState(false);
  // Local State cho Auto Cascade
  const [isAutoCascade, setIsAutoCascade] = useState(true);
  
  const abortTestRef = useRef(false);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      abortTestRef.current = false;
      const pool = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_apikey_pool', []);
      const currentKey = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.API_KEY || 'fc_gemini_api_key') || '';
      let initialPool = [...pool];
      if (currentKey && !initialPool.includes(currentKey)) {
        initialPool.unshift(currentKey);
      } else if (currentKey) {
        initialPool = [currentKey, ...initialPool.filter(k => k !== currentKey)];
      }
      
      setKeyPool(initialPool);
      setNewKeyInput('');
      setTestResults({});
      
      // Khởi tạo giá trị Cooldown từ Storage
      const config = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_ai_config', {});
      setLocalCooldown(config.cooldown429 || 120);
      
      // Khởi tạo giá trị Model từ State hoặc Storage
      const currentAiModel = aiModel || localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.AI_MODEL || 'fc_ai_model') || 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite';
      setLocalAiModel(currentAiModel);
      
      // Khởi tạo trạng thái Premium & Auto Cascade
      setIsPremium(localStorage.getItem('fc_is_premium_key') === 'true');
      setIsAutoCascade(localStorage.getItem('fc_is_auto_cascade') !== 'false');
    }
    return () => {
      abortTestRef.current = true;
    };
  }, [isOpen, aiModel]);
  
  const handleAddKey = () => {
    const k = newKeyInput.trim();
    if (k && k.length > 20 && !keyPool.includes(k)) {
      const newPool = [k, ...keyPool];
      setKeyPool(newPool);
      Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_apikey_pool', newPool);
      setApiKey(k);
      setNewKeyInput('');
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Đã thêm API Key mới!", "success");
    }
  };
  
  const handleRemoveKey = (keyToRemove) => {
    const newPool = keyPool.filter(k => k !== keyToRemove);
    setKeyPool(newPool);
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_apikey_pool', newPool);
    if (apiKey === keyToRemove) {
      const nextKey = newPool.length > 0 ? newPool[0] : '';
      setApiKey(nextKey);
    }
  };
  
  const handleSetPrimary = (k) => {
    const newPool = [k, ...keyPool.filter(item => item !== k)];
    setKeyPool(newPool);
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_apikey_pool', newPool);
    setApiKey(k);
    if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Đã đổi Key ưu tiên!", "success");
  };
  
  // Xử lý kéo Slider và lưu thẳng xuống Storage (Decoupled I/O)
  const handleCooldownChange = (val) => {
    const newVal = Number(val);
    setLocalCooldown(newVal);
    const config = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_ai_config', {});
    config.cooldown429 = newVal;
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_ai_config', config);
  };
  
  // Áp dụng Mô hình AI
  const handleApplyModel = () => {
    if (setAiModel) setAiModel(localAiModel);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.AI_MODEL || 'fc_ai_model', localAiModel);
    if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Đã kích hoạt Mô hình AI ưu tiên!", "success");
  };
  
  // Toggle Premium Mode
  const handleTogglePremium = () => {
    const newVal = !isPremium;
    setIsPremium(newVal);
    localStorage.setItem('fc_is_premium_key', newVal.toString());
    if (window.globalShowToast) {
      if (newVal) window.globalShowToast("Đã KÍCH HOẠT chế độ Key Trả Phí!", "success");
      else window.globalShowToast("Đã TẮT chế độ Key Trả Phí!", "info");
    }
  };
  
  // Toggle Auto Cascade Mode
  const handleToggleAutoCascade = () => {
    const newVal = !isAutoCascade;
    setIsAutoCascade(newVal);
    localStorage.setItem('fc_is_auto_cascade', newVal.toString());
    if (window.globalShowToast) {
      if (newVal) window.globalShowToast("Đã BẬT Tự động hạ cấp mô hình (Cascade)!", "success");
      else window.globalShowToast("Đã TẮT Tự động hạ cấp (Khóa cứng mô hình)!", "warning");
    }
  };
  
  // QUÉT RADAR KHO ĐẠN
  const handleTestKeys = async () => {
    if (isTesting) {
      abortTestRef.current = true;
      setIsTesting(false);
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Đã dừng kiểm tra!", "warning");
      return;
    }
    
    if (keyPool.length === 0) return;
    setIsTesting(true);
    abortTestRef.current = false;
    const results = { ...testResults };
    
    for (const k of keyPool) {
      if (abortTestRef.current) break;
      
      const cooldowns = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_api_cooldowns', {});
      const cleanK = k.replace(/["'\s]/g, "");
      const cdData = cooldowns[cleanK];
      
      // Nếu Key đang thụ án -> Bỏ qua, không cống nạp Request
      if (cdData && cdData.expireAt > Date.now()) {
        results[k] = 'cooldown';
        setTestResults({ ...results });
        continue;
      }
      
      results[k] = 'testing';
      setTestResults({ ...results });
      
      if (pingGeminiKey) {
        const res = await pingGeminiKey(k);
        if (abortTestRef.current) break;
        results[k] = res.status;
      } else {
        results[k] = 0;
      }
      
      setTestResults({ ...results });
      
      // Delay 8 giây để chống Spam 429
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 8000));
    }
    
    if (!abortTestRef.current) {
      setIsTesting(false);
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Đã hoàn tất kiểm tra kho đạn!", "info");
    }
  };
  
  // Phân giải Huy hiệu thông minh có đọc án phạt
  const getStatusBadge = (status, keyStr) => {
    const cooldowns = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_api_cooldowns', {});
    const cleanK = keyStr.replace(/["'\s]/g, "");
    const cdData = cooldowns[cleanK];
    const now = Date.now();
    
    if (cdData && cdData.expireAt > now) {
      const startedAt = new Date(cdData.startedAt);
      const hours = startedAt.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
      const minutes = startedAt.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
      const remainMin = Math.ceil((cdData.expireAt - now) / 60000);
      return <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800 border border-cyan-200" title="API Key bị tạm khóa để tránh spam">❄️ Khóa lúc {hours}:{minutes} (Còn {remainMin}p)</span>;
    }
    if (status === 'testing') return <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 animate-pulse">Đang thử...</span>;
    if (status === 200) return <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200">🟢 Sẵn sàng</span>;
    if (status === 429) return <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border border-orange-200">🟠 Quá tải</span>;
    if (status === 400 || status === 403) return <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200">🔴 Hỏng</span>;
    if (status === 408) return <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200">⏳ Mạng yếu</span>;
    if (status === 0) return <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-gray-100 text-gray-500">Lỗi mạng</span>;
    return null;
  };
  
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[220] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-4 border-b bg-purple-50 shrink-0 rounded-t-xl">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2 text-purple-700">
            <Icons.Key /> Quản lý API Key (Radar)
          </h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700"><Icons.X /></button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-5 space-y-5 bg-gray-50/50">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Thêm Key thủ công</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="password"
                value={newKeyInput}
                onChange={(e) => setNewKeyInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAddKey()}
                className="flex-1 p-2.5 border rounded-lg text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-200 outline-none font-mono"
                placeholder={t('apiKeyPlace')}
              />
              <button onClick={handleAddKey} disabled={!newKeyInput.trim()} className="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold shadow hover:bg-purple-700 disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95">
                <Icons.Plus size={18} /> Thêm
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Cấu hình Mô hình Ưu tiên và Switch Toggles */}
          <div className="space-y-2 bg-blue-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-blue-100 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-800 uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1">
                <Icons.Layers size={12}/> Mô hình ưu tiên (Cascade)
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <select
                value={localAiModel}
                onChange={(e) => setLocalAiModel(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 p-2 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300 outline-none font-medium text-gray-700"
              >
                {(AI_MODELS || [
                  { id: 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite', name: 'Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite', rpdLimit: 500 },
                  { id: 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite', name: 'Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite', rpdLimit: 500 },
                  { id: 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite', name: 'Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite', rpdLimit: 20 },
                  { id: 'gemini-3.0-flash', name: 'Gemini 3.0 Flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                  { id: 'gemini-3.5-flash', name: 'Gemini 3.5 Flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                  { id: 'gemini-3.6-flash', name: 'Gemini 3.6 Flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                  { id: 'gemini-3.7-flash', name: 'Gemini 3.7 Flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                  { id: 'gemini-2.5-flash', name: 'Gemini 2.5 Flash', rpdLimit: 20 }
                ]).map(m => (
                  <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <button
                onClick={handleApplyModel}
                disabled={localAiModel === aiModel}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 transition-all active:scale-95 text-sm"
              >
                Áp dụng
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Toggles Auto Cascade & Premium */}
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-blue-200/50">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-800 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer select-none" onClick={handleToggleAutoCascade}>
                  <span className="text-sm">🌊</span> Tự động hạ cấp mô hình (Auto Cascade)
                </label>
                <div className={`w-8 h-4 rounded-full flex items-center p-0.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors ${isAutoCascade ? 'bg-blue-500' : 'bg-gray-300'}`} onClick={handleToggleAutoCascade}>
                  <div className={`w-3 h-3 bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm transition-transform ${isAutoCascade ? 'translate-x-4' : ''}`}></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-yellow-600 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer select-none" onClick={handleTogglePremium}>
                  <span className="text-sm">🌟</span> Bỏ qua giới hạn RPD (Cho Key Trả phí)
                </label>
                <div className={`w-8 h-4 rounded-full flex items-center p-0.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors ${isPremium ? 'bg-yellow-400' : 'bg-gray-300'}`} onClick={handleTogglePremium}>
                  <div className={`w-3 h-3 bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm transition-transform ${isPremium ? 'translate-x-4' : ''}`}></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Khối cài đặt Thời gian phạt 429 */}
          <div className="space-y-2 bg-orange-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-orange-100 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-orange-800 uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1"><Icons.Clock size={12}/> Thời gian phạt 429</label>
              <span className="text-sm font-mono font-bold text-orange-600 bg-orange-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">{localCooldown} phút</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-orange-700/80 mb-2 leading-tight">Thời gian đóng băng API Key khi bị lỗi Quá tải (Mặc định: 120p). Áp dụng ngay khi kéo.</p>
            <input type="range" min="10" max="1440" step="10" value={localCooldown} onChange={(e) => handleCooldownChange(e.target.value)} className="w-full h-1.5 bg-orange-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-orange-500" />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] text-orange-400 mt-1 font-bold">
              <span>10p</span>
              <span>24h</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="space-y-3 border-t pt-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Kho đạn dự phòng ({keyPool.length})</label>
              <button onClick={handleTestKeys} disabled={keyPool.length === 0} className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 ${isTesting ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 border-red-200 hover:bg-red-200' : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-200 disabled:opacity-50'}`}>
                {isTesting ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="w-3 h-3 border-2 border-red-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                    Dừng kiểm tra
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Icons.Search size={14} />
                    Kiểm tra sức khỏe
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {keyPool.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center text-sm text-gray-400 italic p-4 bg-white rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200">
                Kho đạn đang trống. Vui lòng thêm Key!
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {keyPool.map((k, index) => {
                  const isPrimary = apiKey === k;
                  const displayKey = k.length > 15 ? `${k.substring(0, 8)}...${k.substring(k.length - 4)}` : k;
                  const status = testResults[k];
                  const cleanK = k.replace(/["'\s]/g, "");
                  
                  const currentModels = AI_MODELS || [
                    { id: 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite', rpdLimit: 500 },
                    { id: 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite', rpdLimit: 500 },
                    { id: 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite', rpdLimit: 20 },
                    { id: 'gemini-3.0-flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                    { id: 'gemini-3.5-flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                    { id: 'gemini-3.6-flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                    { id: 'gemini-3.7-flash', rpdLimit: 20 },
                    { id: 'gemini-2.5-flash', rpdLimit: 20 }
                  ];
                  
                  const selectedModelObj = currentModels.find(m => m.id === localAiModel) || { rpdLimit: 0 };
                  const maxRpd = selectedModelObj.rpdLimit;
                  const currentUsage = RPDTracker ? RPDTracker.getUsage(cleanK, localAiModel) : 0;
                  const isDanger = currentUsage >= maxRpd;
                  
                  return (
                    <div key={index} className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all shadow-sm ${isPrimary ? 'bg-purple-50 border-purple-200' : 'bg-white border-gray-100'}`}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {isPrimary ? (
                          <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-purple-200 text-purple-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0" title="Key đang dùng chính"><Icons.Check size={14} strokeWidth={3}/></div>
                        ) : (
                          <button onClick={() => handleSetPrimary(k)} className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-200 hover:border-purple-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-colors" title="Đặt làm Key chính"></button>
                        )}
                        <div className="flex flex-col">
                          <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">{displayKey}</span>
                          <div className="mt-0.5">{getStatusBadge(status, k)}</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase leading-none mb-0.5">Đã dùng</div>
                          <div className={`text-[11px] font-mono font-black leading-none ${isPremium ? 'text-yellow-500' : (isDanger ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-blue-600')}`} title={`Hạn mức theo mô hình: ${localAiModel}`}>
                            {isPremium ? '∞' : `${currentUsage}/${maxRpd}`}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-px h-8 bg-gray-200"></div>
                        <button onClick={() => handleRemoveKey(k)} className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Xóa Key">
                          <Icons.Trash2 size={16} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 border-t bg-white shrink-0 rounded-b-xl flex justify-between items-center">
          <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 italic">* Các key hỏng (400) bạn có thể tự xóa bằng tay.</p>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="px-6 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold shadow hover:bg-purple-700 transition-all active:scale-95">
            Đóng
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: src\components\modals\ExamPoolManagerModal.jsx

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/ExamPoolManagerModal.jsx
 * @description Quản trị Ngân hàng Đề thi. Hiển thị Dashboard, điều chỉnh Tỉ lệ Lai, và Quản lý I/O.
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.9 (Exam Pool Manager)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';

// Cục bộ hóa Icon để độc lập hoàn toàn khỏi Icons chung (Chống crash khi thiếu thư viện)
const LocalIcon = ({ name, size = 24, className = "" }) => {
  const paths = {
    Database: '<ellipse cx="12" cy="5" rx="9" ry="3"></ellipse><path d="M21 12c0 1.66-4 3-9 3s-9-1.34-9-3"></path><path d="M3 5v14c0 1.66 4 3 9 3s9-1.34 9-3V5"></path>',
    X: '<line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>',
    Layers: '<polygon points="12 2 2 7 12 12 22 7 12 2"></polygon><polyline points="2 12 12 17 22 12"></polyline><polyline points="2 17 12 22 22 17"></polyline>',
    Settings: '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"></path>',
    RefreshCw: '<polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10"></polyline><polyline points="1 20 1 14 7 14"></polyline><path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"></path>',
    Upload: '<path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path><polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"></line>',
    Download: '<path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line>',
    Trash2: '<polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"></polyline><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path><line x1="10" y1="11" x2="10" y2="17"></line><line x1="14" y1="11" x2="14" y2="17"></line>',
    Eye: '<path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"></path><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle>',
    ChevronDown: '<polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>'
  };
  
  const svgPath = paths[name] || '';
  if (!svgPath) return <div style={{width: size, height: size}} className={`bg-gray-200 rounded-sm ${className}`}></div>;
  return <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className={className} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svgPath }} />;
};

export const ExamPoolManagerModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, mainColor = 'blue', examPoolData }) => {
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
  const excelInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [showPreview, setShowPreview] = useState(false);
  
  // Rã băng các dữ liệu từ Hook 6.8
  const {
    examPool,
    hybridRatio,
    isPoolLoading,
    handleRatioChange,
    handleClearPool,
    handleImportFromMiniGame,
    handleExportExamPoolToExcel,
    handleImportFromExcel
  } = examPoolData || {};
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setShowPreview(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);
  
  // 1. TÍNH TOÁN THỐNG KÊ (DASHBOARD)
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    let total = 0;
    const byLevel = {};
    if (examPool) {
      Object.keys(examPool).forEach(lang => {
        Object.keys(examPool[lang]).forEach(level => {
          if (!byLevel[level]) byLevel[level] = 0;
          Object.keys(examPool[lang][level]).forEach(topic => {
            Object.keys(examPool[lang][level][topic]).forEach(type => {
              const count = examPool[lang][level][topic][type].length;
              total += count;
              byLevel[level] += count;
            });
          });
        });
      });
    }
    return { total, byLevel };
  }, [examPool]);
  
  // 2. HANDLER CHO FILE UPLOAD (MINI GAME)
  const onFileChange = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file && handleImportFromMiniGame) {
      handleImportFromMiniGame(file);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };
  
  // HANDLER CHO FILE UPLOAD (EXCEL KHO ĐÃ QUA CHỈNH SỬA)
  const onExcelChange = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file && handleImportFromExcel) {
      handleImportFromExcel(file);
      if (excelInputRef.current) excelInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };
  
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[250] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh] border border-gray-200 relative">
        {/* Màn hình Loading khi Import */}
        {isPoolLoading && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center animate-in fade-in">
            <div className={`w-16 h-16 border-4 border-${mainColor}-200 border-t-${mainColor}-600 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4`}></div>
            <p className={`text-${mainColor}-700 font-bold animate-pulse text-lg`}>Đang xử lý dữ liệu...</p>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className={`p-4 border-b bg-${mainColor}-50 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0 shadow-sm`}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner`}>
              <LocalIcon name="Database" size={20} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className={`font-bold text-lg text-${mainColor}-800 leading-tight uppercase tracking-wide`}>Trung Tâm Đề Thi</h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500">Exam Harvest Pool Manager</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-full transition-colors active:scale-95">
            <LocalIcon name="X" size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-6 bg-gray-50/50 space-y-6">
          {/* PHẦN 1: DASHBOARD */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className={`md:col-span-1 bg-gradient-to-br from-${mainColor}-500 to-${mainColor}-700 rounded-2xl p-5 text-white shadow-md relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col items-center justify-center`}>
              <LocalIcon name="Layers" size={64} className="absolute -right-4 -bottom-4 opacity-10" />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider opacity-80 mb-1">Tổng Số Câu</span>
              <span className="text-5xl font-black tracking-tight">{stats.total}</span>
            </div>
            
            <div className="md:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 flex flex-col justify-center">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3 border-b pb-2">Phân bổ theo Cấp độ</span>
              {Object.keys(stats.byLevel).length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic text-center py-2">Kho dữ liệu đang trống.</div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {Object.entries(stats.byLevel).map(([lvl, count]) => (
                    <div key={lvl} className={`px-3 py-1.5 bg-${mainColor}-50 border border-${mainColor}-100 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2`}>
                      <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold text-${mainColor}-600 uppercase`}>{lvl.replace('level_', '').replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
                      <span className="text-sm font-black text-gray-700 bg-white px-2 rounded shadow-sm">{count}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* PHẦN 2: RATIO CONTROLLER */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <LocalIcon name="Settings" size={20} className={`text-${mainColor}-500`} />
                <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-lg">Cấu hình Thuật toán Lai</h4>
              </div>
              <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-black bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-700 shadow-sm`}>
                AI: {hybridRatio}% / Kho: {100 - hybridRatio}%
              </span>
            </div>
            
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-6 max-w-lg">
              Điều chỉnh tỉ lệ bốc câu hỏi giữa Kho Dữ liệu Offline và Máy chủ AI. Tỉ lệ AI càng cao, kho dữ liệu của bạn sẽ càng nhanh chóng phình to.
            </p>
            
            <div className="w-full px-2 mb-8">
              <input type="range" min="0" max="100" step="10" value={hybridRatio} onChange={(e) => handleRatioChange(e.target.value)} className={`w-full h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-${mainColor}-600`} />
              <div className="flex justify-between mt-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center"><span>0%</span><span className="text-gray-500">Offline 100%</span></div>
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center"><span>50%</span><span className="text-blue-500">Cân bằng</span></div>
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center"><span>100%</span><span className="text-purple-500">Cày AI</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* PHẦN 3: I/O MANAGER */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
            <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-lg mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              <LocalIcon name="RefreshCw" size={20} className="text-green-500" /> Quản lý Luồng Dữ liệu
            </h4>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
              <div>
                <input type="file" ref={fileInputRef} onChange={onFileChange} accept=".xlsx, .xls, .csv" className="hidden" />
                <button onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} className="w-full h-full py-3 px-2 bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-green-100 transition-all font-bold text-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm active:scale-95" title="Chuyển đổi dữ liệu đã chơi từ Mini Game thành câu hỏi Khảo thí">
                  <LocalIcon name="Upload" size={24} /> Thu mua từ Game
                </button>
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <input type="file" ref={excelInputRef} onChange={onExcelChange} accept=".xlsx, .xls, .csv" className="hidden" />
                <button onClick={() => excelInputRef.current?.click()} className="w-full h-full py-3 px-2 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-all font-bold text-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm active:scale-95" title="Nhập lại file Excel Kho sau khi con người đã chỉnh sửa">
                  <LocalIcon name="Database" size={24} /> Nhập Excel Kho
                </button>
              </div>
              
              <button onClick={handleExportExamPoolToExcel} disabled={stats.total === 0} className="w-full py-3 px-2 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-blue-100 transition-all font-bold text-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50 active:scale-95" title="Trích xuất cấu trúc chuẩn ra Excel">
                <LocalIcon name="Download" size={24} /> Xuất Excel Kho
              </button>
              
              <button onClick={handleClearPool} disabled={stats.total === 0} className="w-full py-3 px-2 bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-red-100 transition-all font-bold text-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50 active:scale-95">
                <LocalIcon name="Trash2" size={24} /> Reset Toàn bộ
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* PHẦN 4: PREVIEW KHO DỮ LIỆU */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300">
            <button onClick={() => setShowPreview(!showPreview)} className="w-full p-4 flex justify-between items-center hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors">
              <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                <LocalIcon name="Eye" size={20} className="text-gray-400" /> Xem trước nội dung kho
              </h4>
              <LocalIcon name="ChevronDown" size={20} className={`text-gray-400 transition-transform ${showPreview ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
            </button>
            
            {showPreview && (
              <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/50 max-h-[300px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
                {stats.total === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center text-sm text-gray-400 py-4 italic">Kho hiện tại đang trống rỗng.</div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    {Object.keys(examPool).map(langKey => (
                      Object.keys(examPool[langKey]).map(lvlKey => {
                        const lvlData = examPool[langKey][lvlKey];
                        let flatItems = [];
                        Object.values(lvlData).forEach(topicObj => {
                          Object.values(topicObj).forEach(typeArr => {
                            flatItems = flatItems.concat(typeArr);
                          });
                        });
                        
                        return (
                          <div key={`${langKey}-${lvlKey}`} className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm">
                            <div className={`text-xs font-black text-${mainColor}-600 uppercase tracking-widest border-b pb-2 mb-2`}>
                              [{langKey.toUpperCase()}] {lvlKey.replace('level_', '').replace(/_/g, ' ')} ({flatItems.length} câu)
                            </div>
                            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[150px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-2">
                              {flatItems.map(item => {
                                const c = item.content;
                                // Trích xuất Text an toàn
                                let qText = c.term || c.displaySentence || c.wrongSentence || (Array.isArray(c.words) ? c.words.join(' • ') : "") || c.audioScript || c.passage || "Lỗi hiển thị";
                                let aText = c.definition || c.targetWord || c.correction || c.oddWord || c.correctAnswer || "";
                                
                                // Quét mảng Options để tìm đáp án đúng
                                if (c.options && Array.isArray(c.options)) {
                                  const correctOpt = c.options.find(o => o.isCorrect === true || String(o.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true');
                                  if (correctOpt) {
                                    aText = correctOpt.text;
                                  }
                                }
                                
                                // Nếu là Tổ kén (Đoạn văn) không chứa câu hỏi con
                                if (!aText && c.passage && !c.term) {
                                  aText = "Đoạn văn gốc (Reference)";
                                }
                                
                                if (!aText) aText = "Lỗi đáp án";
                                
                                return (
                                  <div key={item.id} className="text-[11px] bg-gray-50 p-2 rounded border border-gray-100">
                                    <div className="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-0.5 line-clamp-2">{qText}</div>
                                    <div className="text-green-600 font-medium line-clamp-1">➔ {aText}</div>
                                  </div>
                                );
                              })}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/HanziWriterModal.jsx
 * @description Chứa tính năng Tập viết chữ Hán (Hanzi Writer Modal). Đóng gói trọn vẹn UI và logic cục bộ của một tính năng cụ thể.
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.1 (Feature Modals - Hanzi Writer)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import HanziWriter from 'hanzi-writer';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';

export const HanziWriterModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, char, t, mainColor }) => {
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [charData, setCharData] = useState(null); // Lưu dữ liệu chữ Hán
  const [quizStatus, setQuizStatus] = useState("Vẽ nét đầu tiên vào ô trên!");
  const [statusColor, setStatusColor] = useState("text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200");
  
  // Refs
  const writerRef = useRef(null);
  const quizWriterRef = useRef(null);
  const fanContainerRef = useRef(null);
  const demoDivRef = useRef(null);
  const quizDivRef = useRef(null);

  // EFFECT 1: Tải dữ liệu khi mở Modal
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && char) {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setCharData(null);
      
      HanziWriter.loadCharacterData(char)
        .then(data => {
          setCharData(data); // Lưu dữ liệu
          setIsLoading(false); // Kích hoạt render giao diện chính
        })
        .catch(e => {
          console.error("Load Hanzi Data Failed:", e);
          setQuizStatus("Lỗi tải dữ liệu. Vui lòng kiểm tra mạng.");
          setIsLoading(false);
        });
    }
  }, [isOpen, char]);

  // EFFECT 2: Khởi tạo Writer khi DOM đã sẵn sàng (!isLoading)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && charData && demoDivRef.current && quizDivRef.current) {
      // Dọn dẹp cũ
      demoDivRef.current.innerHTML = '';
      quizDivRef.current.innerHTML = '';
      if (fanContainerRef.current) fanContainerRef.current.innerHTML = '';
      
      const commonOptions = {
        width: 300,
        height: 300,
        padding: 20,
        strokeColor: '#1e293b',
        outlineColor: '#e2e8f0',
        drawingColor: '#2563eb',
        strokeAnimationSpeed: 1,
        delayBetweenStrokes: 500,
        charDataLoader: (char, onComplete) => onComplete(charData) // Dùng luôn data đã tải
      };
      
      try {
        // 1. Writer Demo
        writerRef.current = HanziWriter.create(demoDivRef.current, char, {
          ...commonOptions,
          showOutline: true
        });
        writerRef.current.showCharacter();
        
        // 2. Writer Quiz
        quizWriterRef.current = HanziWriter.create(quizDivRef.current, char, {
          ...commonOptions,
          showOutline: true,
          showHintAfterMisses: 1,
          highlightOnComplete: true
        });
        quizWriterRef.current.showOutline();
        
        // Thiết lập Quiz Logic
        quizWriterRef.current.quiz({
          onMistake: () => {
            setQuizStatus("Sai rồi! Hãy thử lại.");
            setStatusColor("text-red-500 bg-red-50 border-red-200 animate-pulse");
          },
          onCorrectStroke: () => {
            setQuizStatus("Đúng! Tiếp tục nào.");
            setStatusColor("text-blue-500 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200");
          },
          onComplete: () => {
            setQuizStatus("Xuất sắc! Bạn đã thuộc bài.");
            setStatusColor("text-green-600 bg-green-100 border-green-200 font-bold");
          }
        });
        
        // 3. Tạo Stroke Fan (Tách nét)
        if (fanContainerRef.current) {
          for (let i = 0; i < charData.strokes.length; i++) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = "w-16 h-16 border border-red-100 bg-white rounded-lg relative mb-2 mr-2 shrink-0 hanzi-grid-bg";
            div.style.width = '64px';
            div.style.height = '64px';
            fanContainerRef.current.appendChild(div);
            
            const smallWriter = HanziWriter.create(div, char, {
              width: 64, height: 64, padding: 5,
              strokeColor: '#334155', outlineColor: '#cbd5e1', showOutline: true,
              charDataLoader: (c, cb) => cb(charData)
            });
            // Vẽ tĩnh (không animation) cho nhanh
            smallWriter.hideCharacter();
            for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
              // Dùng animateStroke nhưng speed cực nhanh để hiện nét
              smallWriter.animateStroke(j, { speed: 100 });
            }
          }
        }
        
        // Chạy demo sau 1s
        setTimeout(() => writerRef.current?.animateCharacter(), 1000);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Init Writer Error:", e);
      }
    }
  }, [isLoading, charData, char]); // Chạy khi loading xong và có data

  // Các hàm điều khiển
  const handleAnimate = () => writerRef.current?.animateCharacter();
  const handleSlowAnimate = () => writerRef.current?.animateCharacter({ strokeAnimationSpeed: 0.2 });
  const handleHint = () => quizWriterRef.current?.animateStroke(quizWriterRef.current?._quiz?.currentStrokeIndex || 0);
  const handleResetQuiz = () => {
    if (quizWriterRef.current) {
      quizWriterRef.current.cancelQuiz();
      quizWriterRef.current.hideCharacter();
      quizWriterRef.current.showOutline();
      quizWriterRef.current.quiz({
        onMistake: () => { setQuizStatus("Sai rồi!"); setStatusColor("text-red-500 bg-red-50 border-red-200"); },
        onCorrectStroke: () => { setQuizStatus("Đúng!"); setStatusColor("text-blue-500 bg-blue-50 border-blue-200"); },
        onComplete: () => { setQuizStatus("Hoàn thành!"); setStatusColor("text-green-600 bg-green-100 border-green-200 font-bold"); }
      });
      setQuizStatus("Vẽ nét đầu tiên vào ô trên!");
      setStatusColor("text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200");
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[250] bg-white flex flex-col animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-10">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className={`p-4 bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white flex justify-between items-center shadow-md shrink-0`}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 hover:bg-white/20 rounded-full transition-colors">
            <Icons.ChevronLeft size={28} />
          </button>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <h1 className="text-4xl font-serif leading-none">{char}</h1>
              <span className="text-sm opacity-80 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold">Tập Viết</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-right hidden sm:block">
          <p className="text-[10px] opacity-60 uppercase">Powered by HanziWriter</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Content Scrollable */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-4 md:p-8 bg-gray-50">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-gray-400">
            <div className={`w-10 h-10 border-4 border-${mainColor}-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-3`}></div>
            <p>Đang tải dữ liệu bút thuận...</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto">
            {/* Khu vực Chính: Demo & Quiz */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 mb-8">
              {/* Cột Trái: Demo */}
              <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 flex flex-col items-center">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-2 h-6 bg-blue-500 rounded-full"></span>
                  Mô phỏng nét bút
                </h3>
                <div className="relative mb-6">
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 border-2 border-red-200 rounded-xl pointer-events-none hanzi-grid-bg"></div>
                  <div ref={demoDivRef} className="cursor-pointer" style={{ width: '300px', height: '300px' }} onClick={handleAnimate}></div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2 w-full max-w-[300px]">
                  <button onClick={handleAnimate} className="flex-1 py-3 bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-blue-100 transition-colors">
                    <Icons.Play size={18} className="inline mr-1"/> Xem lại
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={handleSlowAnimate} className="flex-1 py-3 bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors">
                    <Icons.Clock size={18} className="inline mr-1"/> Xem chậm
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Cột Phải: Quiz */}
              <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 flex flex-col items-center">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-2 h-6 bg-green-500 rounded-full"></span>
                  Thực hành
                </h3>
                <div className="relative mb-6">
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 border-2 border-red-200 rounded-xl pointer-events-none hanzi-grid-bg"></div>
                  <div ref={quizDivRef} className="cursor-crosshair" style={{ width: '300px', height: '300px' }}></div>
                </div>
                <div className={`w-full max-w-[300px] py-2 px-4 rounded-lg text-center text-sm font-bold border mb-4 transition-colors ${statusColor}`}>
                  {quizStatus}
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2 w-full max-w-[300px]">
                  <button onClick={handleHint} className="flex-1 py-3 bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-purple-100 transition-colors">
                    <Icons.Sparkles size={18} className="inline mr-1"/> Gợi ý
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={handleResetQuiz} className="flex-1 py-3 bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors">
                    <Icons.RotateCcw size={18} className="inline mr-1"/> Làm lại
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Khu vực Dưới: Stroke Fan */}
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-2 h-6 bg-orange-500 rounded-full"></span>
                Thứ tự từng nét
              </h3>
              <div ref={fanContainerRef} className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/HelperModals.jsx
 * @description Các công cụ phụ trợ bật lên trong quá trình học. Bao gồm: WordSelectorModal (Chọn từ lưu Sổ tay), HanziSelectorModal (Chọn chữ Hán tập viết).
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.7 (In-game Helper Modals)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';

// ==================================================================================
// 1. WORD SELECTOR MODAL (Chọn từ lưu Sổ tay - Tích hợp Auto-capture Highlight)
// ==================================================================================
export const WordSelectorModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onSave, text, currentLang, t, mainColor }) => {
  const [selectedIndices, setSelectedIndices] = useState(new Set());
  const [words, setWords] = useState([]);
  const [customInput, setCustomInput] = useState('');
  
  // Xử lý Dual-Payload
  const isSmartObject = typeof text === 'object' && text !== null && text.isSmartTarget;
  const displayText = isSmartObject ? text.display : (text || "");
  const saveText = isSmartObject ? text.save : (text || "");
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!displayText) { setWords([]); return; }
    
    if (currentLang === 'zh') { 
      setWords([...displayText].filter(c => c.trim().length > 0)); 
    } else { 
      setWords(displayText.split(' ').filter(w => w.length > 0)); 
    }
    
    setSelectedIndices(new Set());
    
    // Auto-capture Highlighted Text (Chộp lấy đoạn text đang bôi đen trên trình duyệt)
    if (isOpen) {
      try {
        const highlighted = window.getSelection().toString().trim();
        if (highlighted) {
          setCustomInput(highlighted);
        } else {
          setCustomInput('');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        setCustomInput('');
      }
    }
  }, [displayText, currentLang, isOpen]);
  
  const toggleWord = (index) => {
    const newSet = new Set(selectedIndices);
    newSet.has(index) ? newSet.delete(index) : newSet.add(index);
    setSelectedIndices(newSet);
  };
  
  const handleCustomSave = () => {
    if (!customInput.trim()) return;
    onSave([customInput.trim()], false);
    setCustomInput('');
  };
  
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  
  const selectedWordsList = words.filter((_, i) => selectedIndices.has(i));
  
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[250] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-sm flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b bg-gray-50 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-700">{t('selectWordsToSave') || 'Lưu Sổ Tay'}</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} data-tooltip={t('ttClose')} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors">
            <Icons.X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh] custom-scrollbar flex flex-col gap-6">
          {/* Phần 1: Các từ có sẵn từ Câu hỏi */}
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 text-center">Chọn từ trong câu</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center">
              {words.map((word, idx) => (
                <button 
                  key={idx} 
                  onClick={() => toggleWord(idx)} 
                  className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border transition-all text-base sm:text-lg font-medium ${selectedIndices.has(idx) ? `bg-orange-100 border-${mainColor}-500 text-${mainColor}-700 shadow-md` : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50'}`}
                >
                  {word}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Phần 2: Nhập từ tùy chọn (Custom Input) */}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-100 pt-5">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 text-center">Hoặc lưu từ tùy chọn</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={customInput}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleCustomSave()}
                placeholder="Gõ hoặc bôi đen từ..."
                className={`flex-1 p-3 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl outline-none focus:border-${mainColor}-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-${mainColor}-100 transition-all font-bold text-gray-700 shadow-inner`}
              />
              <button
                onClick={handleCustomSave}
                disabled={!customInput.trim()}
                className={`px-4 bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold shadow-md hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 disabled:opacity-50 transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center`}
                title="Lưu từ này"
              >
                <Icons.Save size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>
            {customInput && <p className="text-[10px] text-blue-500 mt-2 font-bold italic text-center animate-in fade-in">Hệ thống AI sẽ tự động tra nghĩa cho từ này!</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 border-t bg-gray-50 flex flex-col gap-2 shrink-0 shadow-[0_-4px_6px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] relative z-10">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button 
              onClick={() => onSave(selectedWordsList, false)} 
              disabled={selectedIndices.size === 0} 
              className={`flex-1 py-3 bg-orange-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-orange-600 shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95`}
            >
              {t('saveSelected')} ({selectedIndices.size})
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={() => onSave(selectedWordsList, true)} 
              disabled={selectedIndices.size < 2} 
              className={`flex-1 py-3 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-xl font-bold disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-purple-700 shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-1`} 
              title="Ghép các từ đã chọn thành 1 từ vựng mới"
            >
              <Icons.Link size={18} /> Lưu cụm
            </button>
          </div>
          {/* Bấm nút này sẽ lưu chuỗi "saveText" (có thể chứa đáp án ẩn) */}
          <button 
            onClick={() => onSave([saveText])} 
            className="w-full py-3 bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors"
          >
            {t('saveWholeSentence')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ==================================================================================
// 2. HANZI SELECTOR MODAL (Cửa sổ bật lên chọn chữ Hán tập viết)
// ==================================================================================
export const HanziSelectorModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, text, onSelect, t }) => {
  const [chars, setChars] = useState([]);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && text) {
      const hanziRegex = /[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g;
      const found = text.match(hanziRegex);
      if (found) {
        setChars([...new Set(found)]);
      } else {
        setChars([]);
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, text]);
  
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[240] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-sm flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b bg-gray-50 flex justify-between items-center">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-700">Chọn chữ để tập viết</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors">
            <Icons.X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-6">
          {chars.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-center text-gray-500 italic">Không tìm thấy chữ Hán nào trong thẻ này.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
              {chars.map((char, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  onClick={() => onSelect(char)}
                  className="w-16 h-16 text-3xl font-serif border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl hover:border-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600 transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center"
                >
                  {char}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 border-t bg-gray-50 text-center">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="w-full py-3 bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-bold hover:bg-gray-300 rounded-xl transition-colors">Đóng</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

                  <kbd className="bg-gray-900 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-gray-600 text-gray-400">M</kbd>
                </div>

              <h3 className="font-bold text-white mt-6 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-gray-600 pb-2">

  );

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/LinkManagerModal.jsx
 * @description Quản lý nguồn dữ liệu (Google Sheets) và Kho thu hoạch AI (AI Harvest Pool).
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.6 (Sync & Import Modals)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { STORAGE_KEYS, DEFAULT_SHEETS } from '@/config/constants';

export const LinkManagerModal = ({
  isOpen, onClose, t, defaultUrl, setDefaultUrl, exportUrl, setExportUrl,
  importUrl, setImportUrl, apiKeySheetUrl, setApiKeySheetUrl, onImport,
  onExportLink, onExportExcel, onFileImport, onSaveSettings, onFetchKey,
  onDownloadTemplate, lang, onImportToNotebook,
  aiHarvestPool = {}, onExportHarvestToExcel, onClearHarvestPool
}) => {
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [notebookUrl, setNotebookUrl] = useState('');
  const [showPreview, setShowPreview] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const dragRef = useRef({ isDragging: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, initialX: 0, initialY: 0 });
  
  const defaultVocabKey = STORAGE_KEYS.DEFAULT_URL + '_' + lang + '_vocab';
  const defaultSentenceKey = STORAGE_KEYS.DEFAULT_URL + '_' + lang + '_sentence';
  
  const [vocabUrl, setVocabUrl] = useState('');
  const [sentenceUrl, setSentenceUrl] = useState('');
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setVocabUrl(localStorage.getItem(defaultVocabKey) || DEFAULT_SHEETS?.[lang]?.vocab || '');
      setSentenceUrl(localStorage.getItem(defaultSentenceKey) || DEFAULT_SHEETS?.[lang]?.sentence || '');
      setShowPreview(false);
      setPosition({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    }
  }, [isOpen, lang, defaultVocabKey, defaultSentenceKey]);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
      if (!dragRef.current.isDragging) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - dragRef.current.startX;
      const dy = e.clientY - dragRef.current.startY;
      setPosition({
        x: dragRef.current.initialX + dx,
        y: dragRef.current.initialY + dy
      });
    };
    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      dragRef.current.isDragging = false;
    };
    
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, []);
  
  const handleMouseDown = (e) => {
    if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('input')) return;
    dragRef.current.isDragging = true;
    dragRef.current.startX = e.clientX;
    dragRef.current.startY = e.clientY;
    dragRef.current.initialX = position.x;
    dragRef.current.initialY = position.y;
  };
  
  const totalHarvested = Object.values(aiHarvestPool).reduce((sum, arr) => sum + (arr?.length || 0), 0);
  
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-in fade-in">
      <div
        className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden"
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          transform: `translate(${position.x}px, ${position.y}px)`,
          transition: dragRef.current.isDragging ? 'none' : 'transform 0.1s ease-out'
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="flex justify-between items-center p-4 border-b bg-green-50 shrink-0 rounded-t-xl cursor-move select-none"
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
        >
          <h3 className="font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2 text-green-700 pointer-events-none">
            <Icons.Link /> {t('importTitle')}
          </h3>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            onMouseDown={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            data-tooltip={t('ttClose')}
            className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200 p-1.5 rounded transition-colors"
          >
            <Icons.X />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-6 bg-white">
          {/* Nhập API Key */}
          <div className="mb-4 bg-purple-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-purple-100">
            <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-purple-700 mb-1">{t('apiKeySheetLabel')}</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input type="text" value={apiKeySheetUrl} onChange={(e) => setApiKeySheetUrl(e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2 border rounded text-sm bg-white font-mono text-xs" />
              <button onClick={() => onFetchKey(apiKeySheetUrl)} className="p-2 bg-green-600 text-white rounded" title="Nạp lại API Key"><Icons.RefreshCw size={16} /></button>
              <button onClick={onDownloadTemplate} className="p-2 bg-gray-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-gray-600" title={t('downloadTemplate')}><Icons.Download size={16} /></button>
              <button onClick={() => onSaveSettings(STORAGE_KEYS.API_KEY_SHEET, apiKeySheetUrl)} className="p-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700" title="Lưu làm mặc định"><Icons.Save size={16} /></button>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Nguồn Từ vựng */}
          <div className="mb-4 bg-blue-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-blue-100 shadow-sm">
            <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-blue-800 mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Icons.Layers size={16}/> Nguồn Từ Vựng (Master File)
            </label>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-blue-600 mb-2 italic">1 Link Google Sheet chứa 9 Tab Level (Từ vựng).</p>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <input type="text" value={vocabUrl} onChange={(e) => setVocabUrl(e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2.5 border rounded-lg text-sm bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none" placeholder="Dán link Google Sheet (.xlsx)..." />
              <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end">
                <button onClick={() => onSaveSettings(defaultVocabKey, vocabUrl)} className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-bold rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-1" title="Lưu làm mặc định"><Icons.Save size={14}/> Lưu</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (vocabUrl) window.open(vocabUrl, '_blank'); }} className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 font-bold rounded-lg hover:bg-orange-200 text-xs flex items-center gap-1" title="Mở Link"><Icons.ExternalLink size={14}/> Mở</button>
                <button onClick={() => onImport(vocabUrl, 'vocab')} className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-xs flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md" title="Tải và bóc tách tất cả Tab"><Icons.RefreshCw size={14}/> Áp dụng</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Nguồn Câu văn */}
          <div className="mb-4 bg-teal-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-teal-100 shadow-sm">

              <Icons.BookOpen size={16}/> Nguồn Câu Văn (Master File)

            <p className="text-[11px] text-teal-600 mb-2 italic">1 Link Google Sheet chứa 9 Tab Level (Câu văn).</p>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <input type="text" value={sentenceUrl} onChange={(e) => setSentenceUrl(e.target.value)} className="w-full p-2.5 border rounded-lg text-sm bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-200 outline-none" placeholder="Dán link Google Sheet (.xlsx)..." />
              <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end">
                <button onClick={() => onSaveSettings(defaultSentenceKey, sentenceUrl)} className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-bold rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-1" title="Lưu làm mặc định"><Icons.Save size={14}/> Lưu</button>
                <button onClick={() => { if (sentenceUrl) window.open(sentenceUrl, '_blank'); }} className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 font-bold rounded-lg hover:bg-orange-200 text-xs flex items-center gap-1" title="Mở Link"><Icons.ExternalLink size={14}/> Mở</button>
                <button onClick={() => onImport(sentenceUrl, 'sentence')} className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-teal-600 text-white font-bold rounded-lg hover:bg-teal-700 text-xs flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md" title="Tải và bóc tách tất cả Tab"><Icons.RefreshCw size={14}/> Áp dụng</button>
              </div>
            </div>

              <span className="text-sm font-black text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{totalHarvested}</span>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-2 relative z-10">
              <button onClick={() => setShowPreview(!showPreview)} disabled={totalHarvested === 0} className={`p-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-sm border ${showPreview ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-300' : 'bg-white text-gray-600 border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50'} disabled:opacity-50`}>
                <Icons.Eye size={14}/> {showPreview ? 'Đóng xem trước' : 'Xem trước'}
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => { if(onClearHarvestPool) onClearHarvestPool(); setShowPreview(false); }} disabled={totalHarvested === 0} className="p-2 bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-100 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50">
                <Icons.Trash2 size={14}/> Làm rỗng
              </button>

                    <div key={level} className="mb-3 last:mb-0">

                        {cleanLvl} ({items.length})
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {items.map((item, idx) => {
                          const qText = item.wrongSentence || item.displaySentence || item.term || 'Chưa rõ';
                          const aText = item.correction || item.targetWord || item.oddWord || 'Chưa rõ';
                          const isWordsArray = Array.isArray(item.words);
                          const displayQ = isWordsArray ? item.words.join(' • ') : qText;
                          
                          return (
                            <div key={idx} className="bg-gray-50 p-2 rounded border border-gray-100 text-[10px]">
                              <div className="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-0.5 line-clamp-2">{displayQ}</div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-green-600 font-bold">
                                <Icons.ChevronRight size={10} className="shrink-0" /> <span className="line-clamp-1">{aText}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          
          {/* I/O Khác */}
          <div className="mb-4">
            <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">{t('exportSheetLabel')}</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">

                <Icons.Upload size={16} /> Nhập Excel
              </button>
              <button onClick={onExportExcel} className="flex-1 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2" title={t('ttExport')}>
                <Icons.Download size={16} /> Xuất Excel

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/ManualInputModal.jsx
 * @description Nhập thẻ thủ công & Batch JSON. Cung cấp tính năng gọi AI tự động điền các trường còn thiếu ngay trong Modal.
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.6 (Sync & Import Modals)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';

export const ManualInputModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onImport, onAddCard, onAutoFill, t, mainColor }) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('single');
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [isFilling, setIsFilling] = useState(false);
  const [singleData, setSingleData] = useState({ 
    term: '', pronunciation: '', definition: '', partOfSpeech: '', example: '', sinoViet: '', grammar_type: '' 
  });
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setText('');
      setSingleData({ term: '', pronunciation: '', definition: '', partOfSpeech: '', example: '', sinoViet: '', grammar_type: '' });
      setMode('single');
      setIsFilling(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);
  
  const handleSingleChange = (field, value) => setSingleData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  
  const handleSingleSubmit = () => {
    if (!singleData.term.trim()) return;
    onAddCard(singleData);
    setSingleData({ term: '', pronunciation: '', definition: '', partOfSpeech: '', example: '', sinoViet: '', grammar_type: '' });
  };
  
  const handleAutoFillClick = async () => {
    if (!singleData.term.trim()) return;
    if (!onAutoFill) { alert("Chức năng AI chưa được kết nối!"); return; }
    
    setIsFilling(true);
    try {
      const result = await onAutoFill(singleData.term);
      if (result) {
        if (result._tokenUsage) {
          const used = result._tokenUsage.totalTokenCount || 0;
          const currentTotal = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('fc_total_tokens') || '0', 10);
          localStorage.setItem('fc_total_tokens', currentTotal + used);
        }
        setSingleData(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          pronunciation: result.pronunciation || prev.pronunciation,
          definition: result.definition || prev.definition,
          partOfSpeech: result.partOfSpeech || prev.partOfSpeech,
          example: result.example || prev.example,
          sinoViet: result.sinoViet || prev.sinoViet,
          grammar_type: result.grammar_type ? (Array.isArray(result.grammar_type) ? result.grammar_type.join(', ') : result.grammar_type) : prev.grammar_type
        }));
      }
    }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setIsFilling(false); }
  };
  
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[250] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md flex flex-col overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh]">
        <div className="p-4 border-b bg-gray-50 flex justify-between items-center">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2"><Icons.Upload size={20} /> Thêm dữ liệu</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose}><Icons.X size={20} /></button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex border-b">
          <button className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-bold transition-colors ${mode === 'single' ? `text-${mainColor}-600 border-b-2 border-${mainColor}-600 bg-blue-50/50` : 'text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50'}`} onClick={() => setMode('single')}>Nhập thủ công</button>
          <button className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-bold transition-colors ${mode === 'batch' ? `text-${mainColor}-600 border-b-2 border-${mainColor}-600 bg-blue-50/50` : 'text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50'}`} onClick={() => setMode('batch')}>Nhập JSON (Nâng cao)</button>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex-1">
          {mode === 'single' ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1 uppercase">Từ vựng <span className="text-red-500">*</span></label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input type="text" className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none font-medium" placeholder="Ví dụ: Hello / 你好" value={singleData.term} onChange={(e) => handleSingleChange('term', e.target.value)} autoFocus />
                  <button onClick={handleAutoFillClick} disabled={isFilling || !singleData.term.trim()} className={`p-3 rounded-lg border-2 ${isFilling ? 'bg-gray-100 border-gray-200 cursor-not-allowed' : `bg-purple-50 border-purple-200 text-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-100`}`} title="Tự động điền bằng AI">
                    {isFilling ? <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-purple-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div> : <Icons.Sparkles size={20} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1 uppercase">Từ loại</label>
                  <input type="text" className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none text-gray-600 font-sans text-sm" placeholder="Danh từ..." value={singleData.partOfSpeech || ''} onChange={(e) => handleSingleChange('partOfSpeech', e.target.value)} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1 uppercase">Phiên âm</label>
                  <input type="text" className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none text-gray-600 font-sans text-sm" placeholder="/həˈloʊ/" value={singleData.pronunciation} onChange={(e) => handleSingleChange('pronunciation', e.target.value)} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1 uppercase">Hán Việt</label>
                  <input type="text" className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none text-gray-600 text-sm" placeholder="Nhĩ hảo" value={singleData.sinoViet} onChange={(e) => handleSingleChange('sinoViet', e.target.value)} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1 uppercase">Nhãn ngữ pháp</label>
                  <input type="text" className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none text-gray-600 text-sm" placeholder="ba_sentence, verb..." value={singleData.grammar_type} onChange={(e) => handleSingleChange('grammar_type', e.target.value)} />
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 mb-1 uppercase">Nghĩa ngắn gọn (Cho Game)</label>
                <textarea className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none resize-none" rows="2" placeholder="Ví dụ: Xin chào" value={singleData.definition} onChange={(e) => handleSingleChange('definition', e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1 uppercase">Giải thích chi tiết & Ví dụ</label>
                <textarea className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none resize-none h-24" placeholder="Ví dụ: Lời chào phổ biến...\n\nHello world!" value={singleData.example} onChange={(e) => handleSingleChange('example', e.target.value)} />
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">Dán danh sách từ vựng dạng JSON vào bên dưới:</p>
              <textarea className="w-full p-3 border rounded-lg text-sm font-mono h-60 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200 outline-none resize-none bg-gray-50" placeholder='[{"term":"Hello", "definition":"Xin chào", "pronunciation":"/həˈloʊ/", "partOfSpeech":"Danh từ"}, ...]' value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 border-t bg-gray-50 flex justify-end gap-3">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2 rounded text-gray-600 font-bold hover:bg-gray-200">{t('cancel')}</button>
          {mode === 'single' ? (
            <button onClick={handleSingleSubmit} disabled={!singleData.term.trim()} className={`px-6 py-2 rounded bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white font-bold hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg`}><Icons.Check size={18} /> Lưu thẻ</button>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={() => onImport(text)} disabled={!text.trim()} className={`px-6 py-2 rounded bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white font-bold hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg`}><Icons.Upload size={18} /> Nhập JSON</button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/components/modals/NotebookModal.jsx
 * @description Quản lý Sổ tay từ vựng & Tính năng AI Smart Fill (Điền từ tự động).
 * @origin Tầng 4 - Block 4.3 (Learning Tracking Modals)
