/**
 * @file src/features/exam/ExamUIShell.jsx
 * @description Khung phòng thi tổng hợp (Exam UI Shell). Render động các loại câu hỏi dựa trên metadata.type (Atomic Renderers).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.14 (Exam UI Shell)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';

// ============================================================================
// ATOMIC RENDERER 1: MULTIPLE CHOICE QUESTION (Trắc nghiệm, Đoán hình, Ngữ âm, Nghe, Đọc hiểu)
// ============================================================================
const RenderMCQ = ({ content, metadata, answer, onAnswer, onSpeak, isReview = false, fontFamily }) => {
  const isImageQuiz = metadata.type.includes('image_quiz');
  const isListening = metadata.type.includes('listening');
  const isReading = metadata.type.includes('reading');
  const isPronunciation = metadata.type.includes('pronunciation');

  // Xử lý text câu hỏi
  let questionText = content.term || content.questionText || "Câu hỏi bị lỗi";
  if (isReading && content.passage && !content.term) questionText = "Đọc kỹ đoạn văn bên dưới (Không có câu hỏi con)";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full animate-in fade-in">
      {/* KHU VỰC CÂU HỎI */}
      <div className={`p-4 md:p-6 bg-blue-50/50 border border-blue-100 rounded-2xl mb-4 ${isReading ? 'flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar' : ''}`}>
        
        {/* Nhãn đặc thù cho từng loại */}
        {isListening && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center mb-4">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSpeak && onSpeak(content.audioScript)}
              className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-400 to-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all"
              title="Nghe đoạn băng"
            >
              <Icons.Volume2 size={32} />
            </button>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 mt-2 uppercase">Nghe đoạn băng</span>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {isPronunciation && (
           <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-500 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1 justify-center">
             <Icons.Mic size={14} /> Chọn từ có phát âm khác
           </div>
        )}

        {/* Nội dung câu hỏi chính */}
        {isReading && content.passage && (
          <div className="text-sm md:text-base text-gray-700 leading-relaxed mb-4 whitespace-pre-wrap font-medium p-4 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-inner border border-gray-100">
            {content.passage}
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ fontFamily }} className={`text-lg md:text-2xl font-black text-gray-800 text-center leading-snug break-words ${isImageQuiz ? 'mb-2' : ''}`}>
          {questionText}
        </div>
        
        {onSpeak && !isListening && (
          <div className="flex justify-center mt-3">
            <button onClick={() => onSpeak(questionText)} className="p-2 rounded-full bg-white text-blue-500 shadow-sm border border-gray-200 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors">
              <Icons.Volume2 size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* KHU VỰC ĐÁP ÁN */}
      <div className={`grid gap-3 shrink-0 ${isImageQuiz ? 'grid-cols-2' : 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2'}`}>
        {(content.options || []).map((opt, idx) => {
          const isSelected = answer?.text === opt.text;
          const isCorrect = isReview && (opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true');
          
          let btnClass = "bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:border-blue-300";
          if (isReview) {
             if (isCorrect) btnClass = "bg-green-500 border-green-600 text-white shadow-md z-10";
             else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) btnClass = "bg-red-500 border-red-600 text-white shadow-md";
             else btnClass = "bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 opacity-60";
          } else if (isSelected) {
             btnClass = "bg-blue-100 border-blue-500 text-blue-800 ring-2 ring-blue-200";
          }

          if (isImageQuiz) {
            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                disabled={isReview}
                onClick={() => onAnswer(opt)}
                className={`relative aspect-square p-2 sm:p-3 rounded-2xl border-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 group overflow-hidden ${btnClass}`}
              >
                <div className="w-full h-full relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white flex items-center justify-center">
                   {opt.image ? (
                     <img src={opt.image} alt={opt.text} className={`w-full h-full object-contain p-2 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105 ${isReview && !isCorrect && !isSelected ? 'grayscale opacity-50' : ''}`} onError={(e) => { e.target.style.display = 'none'; }} />
                   ) : <Icons.Image size={32} className="opacity-20" />}
                </div>
                <div className={`absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm p-1.5 sm:p-2 border-t border-gray-100 text-center transition-transform duration-300 ${isReview || isSelected ? 'translate-y-0' : 'translate-y-full group-hover:translate-y-0'}`}>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: (isReview && isCorrect) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }} className={`text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold truncate block px-1 ${isReview && isCorrect ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
                        {opt.text}
                    </span>
                </div>
                {isReview && isCorrect && <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm z-10 p-0.5"><Icons.CheckCircle size={20} className="text-green-600"/></div>}
                {isReview && isSelected && !isCorrect && <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm z-10 p-0.5"><Icons.X size={20} className="text-red-600"/></div>}
              </button>
            );
          }

          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              disabled={isReview}
              onClick={() => onAnswer(opt)}
              style={{ fontFamily: (isReview && isCorrect) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }}
              className={`relative min-h-[64px] p-3 pl-12 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-left flex items-center transition-all active:scale-95 break-words ${btnClass}`}
            >
              <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black rounded border border-current opacity-60">
                {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
              </span>
              <span className="pr-6 w-full">{opt.text}</span>
              {isReview && isCorrect && <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><Icons.CheckCircle size={20} className="text-white"/></span>}
              {isReview && isSelected && !isCorrect && <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><Icons.X size={20} className="text-white"/></span>}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// ATOMIC RENDERER 2: FILL IN THE BLANK (Điền từ khuyết)
// ============================================================================
const RenderFillBlank = ({ content, answer, onAnswer, onSpeak, isReview = false, fontFamily }) => {
  const displaySentence = content.displaySentence || "";
  const options = content.options || [];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="flex-1 p-5 rounded-2xl bg-teal-50/50 border border-teal-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative text-center mb-4">
        <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-teal-500 mb-4 absolute top-3">
          Chọn từ điền vào chỗ trống
        </div>
        
        <div style={{ fontFamily }} className="text-xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words mt-4">
          {isReview
            ? <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, `<span class="text-${answer?.isCorrect || answer === content.targetWord ? 'green' : 'red'}-600 underline decoration-4 px-1">${answer?.text || answer || '___'}</span>`) }} />
            : <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, answer ? `<span class="text-teal-600 underline decoration-2 px-1">${answer.text || answer}</span>` : '<span class="inline-block w-20 border-b-4 border-gray-300 align-bottom mx-1"></span>') }} />
          }
        </div>
        
        {content.hint && (
          <div className="mt-6 text-sm font-bold text-gray-500 bg-white/70 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm">
            💡 {content.hint}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 shrink-0">
        {options.map((opt, idx) => {
          const isSelected = answer?.text === opt.text || answer === opt.text;
          const isCorrect = isReview && (opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true' || opt.text === content.targetWord);
          
          let btnClass = "bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-teal-50 hover:border-teal-300";
          if (isReview) {
             if (isCorrect) btnClass = "bg-green-500 border-green-600 text-white shadow-md z-10";
             else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) btnClass = "bg-red-500 border-red-600 text-white shadow-md";
             else btnClass = "bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 opacity-60";
          } else if (isSelected) {
             btnClass = "bg-teal-100 border-teal-500 text-teal-800 ring-2 ring-teal-200";
          }

          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              disabled={isReview}
              onClick={() => onAnswer(opt)}
              style={{ fontFamily: (isReview && isCorrect) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }}
              className={`relative min-h-[64px] p-3 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-center flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 break-words ${btnClass}`}
            >
              <span className="px-6">{opt.text}</span>
              {isReview && isCorrect && <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><Icons.CheckCircle size={20} className="text-white"/></span>}
              {isReview && isSelected && !isCorrect && <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><Icons.X size={20} className="text-white"/></span>}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// ATOMIC RENDERER 3: SPOT MISTAKE (Tìm lỗi sai)
// ============================================================================
const RenderSpotMistake = ({ content, answer, onAnswer, onSpeak, isReview = false, fontFamily, lang }) => {
  const sentence = content.wrongSentence || "";
  
  // Băm câu thành các nút bấm
  const words = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!sentence) return [];
    if (lang === 'zh') {
      return Array.from(sentence).map((char, idx) => ({ id: idx, display: char, original: char })).filter(i => i.original.trim() !== '');
    } else {
      return sentence.split(' ').map((word, idx) => ({ id: idx, display: word, original: word })).filter(i => i.original.trim() !== '');
    }
  }, [sentence, lang]);

  const targetWrongWord = content.wrongWord || '';

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="flex-1 p-5 rounded-2xl bg-orange-50/50 border border-orange-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative text-center mb-4">
        <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-orange-500 mb-6 absolute top-3">
          Chọn một từ bị sai trong câu
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 mt-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
          {words.map((word) => {
            const isSelected = answer?.id === word.id || answer?.original === word.original;
            const isActuallyWrong = targetWrongWord && word.original.toLowerCase().includes(targetWrongWord.toLowerCase());
            
            let wordStyle = "bg-white text-gray-800 border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-100 shadow-sm";
            if (isReview) {
              if (isActuallyWrong) {
                wordStyle = 'bg-green-500 text-white border-green-600 shadow-md scale-110 z-10';
              } else if (isSelected) {
                wordStyle = 'bg-red-500 text-white border-red-600 shadow-md animate-shake z-10';
              } else {
                wordStyle = 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-400 border-gray-200 opacity-50';
              }
            } else if (isSelected) {
              wordStyle = "bg-orange-100 border-orange-500 text-orange-800 ring-2 ring-orange-200 scale-105";
            }

            return (
              <button
                key={word.id}
                disabled={isReview}
                onClick={() => onAnswer(word)}
                style={{ fontFamily }}
                className={`px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-3 rounded-lg border-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold transition-all active:scale-95 ${wordStyle}`}
              >
                {word.display}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Trong Exam Mode, không hiển thị options thay thế mà chỉ click chọn từ */}
      {!isReview && !answer && (
        <div className="h-[60px] flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 select-none shrink-0">
          Chạm vào từ sai để chọn
        </div>
      )}
      {!isReview && answer && (
        <div className="h-[60px] flex items-center justify-between px-6 bg-orange-100 rounded-xl border border-orange-200 shrink-0">
          <span className="font-bold text-orange-800 text-sm">Đã chọn: {answer.display}</span>
          <button onClick={() => onAnswer(null)} className="text-xs font-bold text-orange-600 hover:text-red-500">Đổi ý</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// ATOMIC RENDERER 4: ODD ONE OUT (Từ khác loại)
// ============================================================================
const RenderOddOneOut = ({ content, answer, onAnswer, onSpeak, isReview = false, fontFamily }) => {
  const wordsList = Array.isArray(content.words) ? content.words : [];
  
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="shrink-0 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50/50 border border-indigo-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center mb-4">
        <div className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-indigo-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Icons.Eye size={16} /> Chọn từ không cùng nhóm
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 shrink-0 flex-1 content-center">
        {wordsList.map((wordStr, idx) => {
          const isCorrect = wordStr === content.oddWord;
          const isSelected = answer === wordStr || answer?.text === wordStr;
          
          let btnStyle = "bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50";
          if (isReview) {
             if (isCorrect) btnStyle = "bg-green-500 border-green-600 text-white shadow-md z-10 scale-[1.02]";
             else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) btnStyle = "bg-red-500 border-red-600 text-white shadow-md animate-shake";
             else btnStyle = "bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 opacity-60 scale-95";
          } else if (isSelected) {
             btnStyle = "bg-indigo-100 border-indigo-500 text-indigo-800 ring-2 ring-indigo-200";
          }

          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              disabled={isReview}
              onClick={() => onAnswer(wordStr)}
              style={{ fontFamily: (isReview && isCorrect) || !wordStr.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }}
              className={`relative min-h-[80px] p-4 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-lg sm:text-xl text-center flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 break-words ${btnStyle}`}
            >
              <span className="px-6">{wordStr}</span>
              {isReview && isCorrect && <span className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><Icons.CheckCircle size={24} className="text-white"/></span>}
              {isReview && isSelected && !isCorrect && <span className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><Icons.X size={24} className="text-white"/></span>}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// ATOMIC RENDERER 5: SCRAMBLE (Ghép câu / Từ)
// ============================================================================
const RenderScramble = ({ content, answer, onAnswer, onSpeak, isReview = false, fontFamily }) => {
  // Lấy danh sách mảnh ghép (Đảm bảo có id duy nhất)
  const poolTokens = React.useMemo(() => {
    return (content.parts || []).map((t, idx) => ({ id: `pt_${idx}`, text: t }));
  }, [content.parts]);
  
  // Trạng thái cục bộ cho mảnh ghép đang chọn
  const [selectedTokens, setSelectedTokens] = useState([]);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (answer && Array.isArray(answer)) {
      setSelectedTokens(answer);
    } else if (answer && typeof answer === 'string') {
      // Trường hợp gõ text (Nếu có hỗ trợ type mode trong Exam)
    }
  }, [answer]);

  const handleSelectPoolToken = (token) => {
    if (isReview) return;
    const newTokens = [...selectedTokens, token];
    setSelectedTokens(newTokens);
    onAnswer(newTokens); // Đẩy lên Shell
  };

  const handleRemoveSelectedToken = (indexToRemove) => {
    if (isReview) return;
    const newTokens = selectedTokens.filter((_, idx) => idx !== indexToRemove);
    setSelectedTokens(newTokens);
    onAnswer(newTokens.length > 0 ? newTokens : null);
  };

  if (isReview) {
    const isCorrect = answer && Array.isArray(answer) && answer.map(t => t.text).join('') === (content.term || content.origin?.term).replace(/\s/g, '');
    // Logic review đơn giản cho Scramble
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col h-full animate-in fade-in items-center justify-center space-y-4">
        <div className={`w-full p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 text-center ${isCorrect ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-500 text-green-800' : 'bg-red-50 border-red-500 text-red-800'}`}>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase mb-2 opacity-70">Đáp án của bạn:</div>
          <div style={{ fontFamily }} className="text-xl font-black">
            {Array.isArray(answer) ? answer.map(t => t.text).join(' ') : (answer || "Bỏ qua")}
          </div>
        </div>
        {!isCorrect && (
          <div className="w-full p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 text-center">
            <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase mb-2 opacity-70">Đáp án chuẩn:</div>
            <div style={{ fontFamily }} className="text-xl font-black">
              {content.term || content.origin?.term}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-purple-50/70 border border-purple-100 text-center mb-4 shrink-0">
        <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-purple-400 mb-1">
          Nghĩa câu / từ mục tiêu
        </div>
        <div className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words">
          {content.definition || content.origin?.definition || "Lắp ráp các mảnh vỡ"}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center space-y-6">
        <div className={`min-h-[100px] p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all ${selectedTokens.length > 0 ? 'bg-white border-purple-300' : 'bg-gray-50/80 border-gray-300'}`}>
          {selectedTokens.length === 0 ? (
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 italic select-none">
              Chạm vào các mảnh từ bên dưới...
            </span>
          ) : (
            selectedTokens.map((tok, idx) => (
              <button
                key={tok.id + idx}
                onClick={() => handleRemoveSelectedToken(idx)}
                style={{ fontFamily }}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-base shadow-sm border border-purple-300 bg-purple-50 text-purple-800 hover:bg-red-50 hover:border-red-300 hover:text-red-600 transition-colors"
              >
                {tok.text}
              </button>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Kho mảnh ghép
            </span>
            {selectedTokens.length > 0 && (
              <button onClick={() => { setSelectedTokens([]); onAnswer(null); }} className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500">
                Làm lại
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 p-2">
            {poolTokens.map((tok) => {
              const isUsed = selectedTokens.some((s) => s.id === tok.id);
              return (
                <button
                  key={tok.id}
                  disabled={isUsed}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectPoolToken(tok)}
                  style={{ fontFamily }}
                  className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-base border-2 transition-all ${
                    isUsed
                      ? 'bg-gray-100 text-transparent border-gray-200 pointer-events-none scale-95'
                      : 'bg-white text-gray-800 border-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50/40 active:scale-95'
                  }`}
                >
                  {tok.text}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


// ============================================================================
// MAIN COMPONENT: EXAM UI SHELL
// ============================================================================
export const ExamUIShell = ({
  question,         // Dữ liệu câu hỏi từ QueueEngine
  currentIndex,     // Vị trí hiện tại
  totalQuestions,   // Tổng số câu
  timeLeft,         // Thời gian còn lại
  onAnswerSubmit,   // Hàm nộp bài (gọi khi bấm nút Tiếp theo)
  onSpeak,          // Hàm đọc âm thanh
  isReviewMode = false, // Cờ xem lại bài
  userAnswer = null,    // Đáp án của User (trong lúc thi hoặc lúc xem lại)
  isCorrect = null,     // Đúng/Sai (Lúc xem lại)
  fontFamily = 'inherit',
  lang = 'en'
}) => {
  // State quản lý đáp án được chọn hiện tại (chưa Submit)
  const [currentAnswer, setCurrentAnswer] = useState(null);

  // Sync answer state when question changes or in review mode
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentAnswer(userAnswer);
  }, [question, userAnswer]);

  if (!question || !question.metadata || !question.content) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl border-2 border-gray-200 border-dashed">
        <Icons.AlertCircle size={48} className="text-gray-300 mb-4" />
        <p className="font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Lỗi kết xuất câu hỏi</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const meta = question.metadata;
  const content = question.content;
  const type = meta.type || 'unknown';

  // Điều phối Atomic Renderer
  const renderQuestionBody = () => {
    if (type.includes('multiple_choice') || type.includes('match') || type.includes('tfng') || type.includes('image_quiz') || type.includes('listening') || type.includes('pronunciation') || type.includes('reading')) {
      return <RenderMCQ content={content} metadata={meta} answer={currentAnswer} onAnswer={setCurrentAnswer} onSpeak={onSpeak} isReview={isReviewMode} fontFamily={fontFamily} lang={lang} />;
    }
    if (type.includes('fill_blank')) {
      return <RenderFillBlank content={content} answer={currentAnswer} onAnswer={setCurrentAnswer} onSpeak={onSpeak} isReview={isReviewMode} fontFamily={fontFamily} lang={lang} />;
    }
    if (type.includes('spot_mistake')) {
      return <RenderSpotMistake content={content} answer={currentAnswer} onAnswer={setCurrentAnswer} onSpeak={onSpeak} isReview={isReviewMode} fontFamily={fontFamily} lang={lang} />;
    }
    if (type.includes('odd_one_out')) {
      return <RenderOddOneOut content={content} answer={currentAnswer} onAnswer={setCurrentAnswer} onSpeak={onSpeak} isReview={isReviewMode} fontFamily={fontFamily} lang={lang} />;
    }
    if (type.includes('scramble')) {
      return <RenderScramble content={content} answer={currentAnswer} onAnswer={setCurrentAnswer} onSpeak={onSpeak} isReview={isReviewMode} fontFamily={fontFamily} lang={lang} />;
    }

    // Fallback Renderer
    return (
      <div className="p-6 text-center text-red-500 font-bold bg-red-50 rounded-xl">
        Không hỗ trợ hiển thị loại câu hỏi: {type}
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Xác định nút bấm Footer
  const canSubmit = currentAnswer !== null && currentAnswer !== undefined;

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (isReviewMode || !onAnswerSubmit) return;
    
    // Đánh giá Đúng/Sai cơ bản trước khi đẩy lên Logic
    let isCorrectLocal = false;
    
    if (type.includes('multiple_choice') || type.includes('match') || type.includes('tfng') || type.includes('image_quiz') || type.includes('listening') || type.includes('pronunciation') || type.includes('reading')) {
      isCorrectLocal = currentAnswer.isCorrect === true || String(currentAnswer.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';
    } else if (type.includes('fill_blank')) {
      isCorrectLocal = currentAnswer.isCorrect === true || String(currentAnswer.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true' || currentAnswer.text === content.targetWord;
    } else if (type.includes('spot_mistake')) {
      const targetWrong = content.wrongWord || '';
      isCorrectLocal = targetWrong && currentAnswer.original && currentAnswer.original.toLowerCase().includes(targetWrong.toLowerCase());
    } else if (type.includes('odd_one_out')) {
      isCorrectLocal = currentAnswer === content.oddWord;
    } else if (type.includes('scramble')) {
      const uText = Array.isArray(currentAnswer) ? currentAnswer.map(t=>t.text).join('') : (currentAnswer || "");
      const cText = (content.term || content.origin?.term || "").replace(/\s/g, '');
      isCorrectLocal = uText.toLowerCase() === cText.toLowerCase();
    }
    
    onAnswerSubmit(currentAnswer, isCorrectLocal);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden relative">
      
      {/* 1. TOP HUD (Chỉ hiển thị khi đang thi) */}
      {!isReviewMode && (
        <div className="bg-gray-900 text-white px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 shadow-md z-20">
           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
             <div className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white/20 rounded font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1 backdrop-blur-sm">
                <span>Câu</span>
                <span className="text-blue-300 font-black">{currentIndex + 1}</span>
                <span>/</span>
                <span>{totalQuestions}</span>
             </div>
             
             {/* Badge Cấp độ / Chặng */}
             <div className="hidden sm:block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest opacity-60">
                {meta.chapter || meta.phase || "Mock Test"}
             </div>
           </div>
           
           <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
             {timeLeft !== null && (
               <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded font-mono font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors ${timeLeft <= 60 ? 'bg-red-500 text-white animate-pulse' : 'bg-gray-800 text-green-400'}`}>
                 <Icons.Clock size={14} />
                 <span>{Math.floor(timeLeft / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}:{(timeLeft % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}</span>
               </div>
             )}
           </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. KHU VỰC CÂU HỎI TRUNG TÂM */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-3 sm:p-5 relative bg-gray-50/30">
        
        {/* Banner Review Mode */}
        {isReviewMode && (
          <div className={`mb-4 p-3 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-3 shadow-sm ${isCorrect ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-200 text-green-800' : 'bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-800'}`}>
             <div className={`p-2 rounded-full ${isCorrect ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-600' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-600'}`}>
                {isCorrect ? <Icons.CheckCircle size={24} /> : <Icons.X size={24} />}
             </div>
             <div>
                <div className="font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Kết quả câu hỏi</div>
                <div className="text-sm font-medium opacity-80 mt-0.5">
                  {isCorrect ? "Bạn đã trả lời chính xác!" : "Sai rồi. Hãy xem lại phần giải thích bên dưới."}
                </div>
             </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Gọi Component Render Câu hỏi tương ứng */}
        {renderQuestionBody()}

        {/* Giải thích (Chỉ hiện khi Review Mode) */}
        {isReviewMode && (content.explanation || content.analysis) && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-xl border border-purple-100 bg-purple-50/50 text-gray-700 text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed shadow-inner">
            <div className="font-black text-purple-600 uppercase tracking-widest text-[10px] mb-2 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Icons.Sparkles size={14} /> Phân tích chuyên sâu
            </div>
            {content.explanation || content.analysis}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 3. FOOTER ĐIỀU KHIỂN */}
      {!isReviewMode && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-white border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0 shadow-[0_-10px_20px_-10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]">
           <button
             onClick={handleSubmit}
             disabled={!canSubmit}
             className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base ${canSubmit ? 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 shadow-blue-200' : 'bg-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'}`}
           >
             {canSubmit ? (
               <>Xác nhận đáp án <Icons.ChevronRight size={20} /></>
             ) : (
               "Chọn đáp án để tiếp tục"
             )}
           </button>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
};

export default ExamUIShell;

FILE: src\features\games\common\gameHelpers.js

/**
 * @file src/features/games/common/gameHelpers.js
 * @description Kho vũ khí logic dùng chung cho toàn bộ 10 Mini-games & Khảo thí (Tính điểm, Âm thanh SFX, Anti-Streak, Kỷ luật thoát ngang, Chuẩn hóa Multi-select).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Nhóm 5A (Shared Game Logic)
 */

import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';

// ============================================================================
// 1. ĐỘNG CƠ TÍNH ĐIỂM & CHUỖI THẮNG CHUẨN HÓA (SCORING & STREAK ENGINE)
// ============================================================================
/**
 * Tính điểm dựa trên điểm cơ bản, thời gian còn lại, chuỗi thắng (combo) và độ khó.
 * Công thức: Score = BasePoints + floor(TimeLeft * Multiplier) + (Streak * 10)
 */
export const calculateGameScore = (basePoints = 100, timeLeft = 0, streak = 0, difficulty = 'normal') => {
  const safeBase = Number(basePoints) || 100;
  const safeTime = Math.max(0, Number(timeLeft) || 0);
  const safeStreak = Math.max(0, Number(streak) || 0);

  let timeMultiplier = 2;
  if (difficulty === 'hard') timeMultiplier = 4;
  else if (difficulty === 'easy') timeMultiplier = 1;

  const timeBonus = Math.floor(safeTime * timeMultiplier);
  const streakBonus = Math.min(safeStreak * 10, 100); // Trần thưởng combo tối đa +100 điểm/câu

  return safeBase + timeBonus + streakBonus;
};

// ============================================================================
// 2. BỘ TỔNG HỢP ÂM THANH HIỆU ỨNG (WEB AUDIO SFX SYNTHESIZER)
// ============================================================================
/**
 * Phát âm thanh hiệu ứng không cần file MP3 ngoài, dùng chung cho mọi Game & Phòng thi.
 * @param {'correct' | 'wrong' | 'finish' | 'tick' | 'click'} type
 * @param {boolean} isMuted
 */
export const playGameSFX = (type = 'correct', isMuted = false) => {
  if (isMuted) return;

  try {
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return;

    if (!window.fc_audioCtx) {
      window.fc_audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
    }
    const ctx = window.fc_audioCtx;
    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      ctx.resume();
    }

    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    if (type === 'correct') {
      // Âm Ting! trong trẻo (Hợp âm Đô trưởng đi lên: C5 -> E5 -> G5)
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, now); // C5
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, now + 0.08); // E5
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(783.99, now + 0.16); // G5

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.45);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.45);
    } else if (type === 'wrong') {
      // Âm Buzzer trầm báo lỗi (Sóng răng cưa đi xuống)
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(160, now);
      osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(110, now + 0.35);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.35);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.35);
    } else if (type === 'finish') {
      // Âm Fanfare chiến thắng khi hoàn thành màn chơi
      const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5]; // C5, E5, G5, C6
      notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        const startTime = now + idx * 0.11;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, startTime);

        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, startTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + 0.45);

        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(startTime);
        osc.stop(startTime + 0.45);
      });
    } else if (type === 'tick' || type === 'click') {
      // Âm gõ nhẹ khi chọn từ hoặc đếm ngược
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(800, now);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.05);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.05);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Bỏ qua lỗi AudioContext nếu trình duyệt chặn tự động phát
  }
};

// ============================================================================
// 3. THUẬT TOÁN "TRỘN CÓ TRÍ NHỚ" (ANTI-STREAK OPTION SHUFFLER)
// ============================================================================
/**
 * Chống hiện tượng đáp án đúng rơi vào cùng 1 vị trí (VD: toàn đáp án A) quá 2 lần liên tiếp.
 * @param {Array} options Mảng các lựa chọn [{ text, isCorrect, ... }]
 * @param {Object} streakTrackerRef React useRef chứa mảng lịch sử vị trí đúng (VD: useRef([]))
 * @returns {Array} Mảng options mới đã được kiểm duyệt vị trí
 */
export const applyAntiStreakShuffle = (options, streakTrackerRef) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(options) || options.length <= 1) return options;

  let cloned = [...options];
  let correctIdx = cloned.findIndex(
    (o) => o && (o.isCorrect === true || String(o.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true')
  );

  if (correctIdx === -1) return cloned;

  const history = streakTrackerRef?.current || [];
  let attempts = 0;

  // Nếu 2 câu trước đó đều có đáp án đúng nằm ở đúng vị trí này -> Cưỡng chế hoán đổi
  while (
    history.length >= 2 &&
    history[0] === correctIdx &&
    history[1] === correctIdx &&
    attempts < 6
  ) {
    let swapIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * cloned.length);
    if (swapIdx !== correctIdx) {
      const temp = cloned[correctIdx];
      cloned[correctIdx] = cloned[swapIdx];
      cloned[swapIdx] = temp;
      correctIdx = swapIdx;
    }
    attempts++;
  }

  if (streakTrackerRef && Array.isArray(streakTrackerRef.current)) {
    streakTrackerRef.current = [correctIdx, ...history].slice(0, 2);
  }

  return cloned;
};

// ============================================================================
// 4. KỶ LUẬT THOÁT NGANG (EXIT DISCIPLINE HANDLER)
// ============================================================================
/**
 * Nếu người chơi bấm nút Thoát khi câu hỏi đã hiện ra mà chưa trả lời xong,
 * tự động ghi nhận vào Sổ tay Lỗi sai (Incorrect List) và Túi nháp (Retry Bag).
 */
export const handleExitDiscipline = ({
  isPlaying,
  isAnswered,
  currentCard,
  rawQuestionData = null,
  gameType = 'quiz',
  onLogWrong,
  addToRetryBag
}) => {
  if (!isPlaying || isAnswered || !currentCard) return;

  try {
    const targetCard = currentCard.origin || currentCard.question || currentCard;
    if (targetCard && targetCard.term && typeof onLogWrong === 'function') {
      onLogWrong(targetCard);
    }

    if (typeof addToRetryBag === 'function') {
      const payloadToRetry = rawQuestionData || currentCard;
      addToRetryBag(gameType, payloadToRetry);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[ExitDiscipline] Lỗi ghi nhận kỷ luật thoát ngang:', e);
  }
};

// ============================================================================
// 5. VẮC-XIN CHUẨN HÓA MULTI-SELECT LEVEL & TOPIC (ARRAY ARMOR)
// ============================================================================
/**
 * Chuyển đổi an toàn `currentLevel` và `currentTopic` (có thể là Mảng hoặc Chuỗi)
 * thành định dạng chuẩn để truyền vào Lò đúc AI hoặc Bộ lọc Offline.
 */
export const normalizeLevelAndTopic = (currentLevel, currentTopic, lang = 'en') => {
  const defaultLevel = lang === 'zh' ? 'zh_level_1' : 'en_level_4';

  const levelArr = Array.isArray(currentLevel)
    ? currentLevel.filter(Boolean)
    : currentLevel
    ? [String(currentLevel)]
    : [defaultLevel];

  const topicArr = Array.isArray(currentTopic)
    ? currentTopic.filter(Boolean)
    : currentTopic
    ? [String(currentTopic)]
    : [];

  // Chọn 1 Level đại diện ngẫu nhiên nếu người dùng tick chọn nhiều Level cùng lúc
  const pickedLevel =
    levelArr.length > 0
      ? levelArr[Math.floor(Math.random() * levelArr.length)]
      : defaultLevel;

  // Chọn 1 Topic đại diện ngẫu nhiên (hoặc chuỗi rỗng nếu chọn Tất cả)
  const pickedTopic =
    topicArr.length > 0
      ? topicArr[Math.floor(Math.random() * topicArr.length)]
      : '';

  return {
    levelArr,
    topicArr,
    pickedLevel,
    pickedTopic,
    levelLabel: levelArr.join(', ') || defaultLevel,
    topicLabel: topicArr.length > 0 ? topicArr.join(', ') : 'All Topics'
  };
};

// ============================================================================
// 6. ĐỌC CẤU HÌNH THỜI GIAN LÀM NGUỘI UI (UI COOLDOWN READER)
// ============================================================================
export const getConfiguredUiCooldown = (defaultSec = 9) => {
  try {
    const cfg = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_ai_config', {});
    if (cfg && cfg.uiCooldown !== undefined) {
      return Math.max(0, parseInt(cfg.uiCooldown, 10));
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return defaultSec;
};

export const GameHelpers = {
  calculateGameScore,
  playGameSFX,
  applyAntiStreakShuffle,
  handleExitDiscipline,
  normalizeLevelAndTopic,
  getConfiguredUiCooldown
};

export const GameSummaryScreen = ({

        <Icons.Award size={48} />

      </h2>
      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-500 mb-6">

      </p>

          </span>
          <span className={`text-3xl font-black text-${mainColor}-600 font-mono`}>
            {score}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-green-50 border border-green-100 flex flex-col items-center">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
            Độ chính xác
          </span>
          <span className="text-3xl font-black text-green-600 font-mono">
            {correctCount}/{totalQuestions}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-green-500 mt-0.5">
            ({accuracy}%)
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 w-full max-w-sm">
        {onRestart && (
          <button
            onClick={onRestart}
            className={`flex-1 py-3.5 px-6 bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2`}

        </button>

  );
};

// ============================================================================
// 3. BỘ CHỌN CHUYÊN ĐỀ BẪY NGỮ PHÁP (GRAMMAR TRAP SELECTOR)
// ============================================================================
export const GrammarTrapSelector = ({
  gameType = 'quiz',
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  selectedTrap,
  onSelectTrap,
  mainColor = 'purple'
}) => {
  const topics = useMemo(() => {
    const repLevel = Array.isArray(currentLevel) ? currentLevel[0] : currentLevel;
    return getGrammarTopics(gameType, lang, repLevel);
  }, [gameType, lang, currentLevel]);

  const groupedTopics = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = {};
    topics.forEach((item) => {
      const g = item.group || 'Chuyên đề Khác';
      if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
      groups[g].push(item);
    });
    return groups;
  }, [topics]);

  if (!topics || topics.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="w-full bg-purple-50/70 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-purple-200 text-left space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-purple-800 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Icons.Target size={15} className="text-purple-600" />
          Trọng tâm Ngữ pháp (Tùy chọn)
        </label>
        {selectedTrap && (
          <button
            onClick={() => onSelectTrap('')}
            className="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-600 hover:text-red-500 underline"
          >
            Đặt lại ngẫu nhiên
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <select
        value={selectedTrap || ''}
        onChange={(e) => onSelectTrap(e.target.value)}
        className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white border border-purple-200 rounded-lg text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-300 shadow-sm"
      >
        <option value="">🎲 Ngẫu nhiên thông minh theo cấp độ (Khuyên dùng)</option>
        {Object.entries(groupedTopics).map(([groupName, items]) => (
          <optgroup key={groupName} label={`── ${groupName} ──`}>
            {items.map((tItem) => (
              <option key={tItem.id} value={tItem.id}>
                🎯 {tItem.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </optgroup>
        ))}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
};

          <span className={`text-[10px] font-medium ${sourceMode === 'ai' ? 'text-purple-100' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
            (Đề mới vô hạn)
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Bộ lọc Cấp độ, Chủ đề & Chế độ Từ/Câu khi bật AI Tự Sinh */}
      {sourceMode === 'ai' && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50/60 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 space-y-2.5 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-800 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
              <Icons.Sparkles size={13} className="text-indigo-600" /> Cấu hình Lò đúc AI
            </span>
            {!hideDataModeToggle && setDataMode && (
              <div className="flex bg-white p-0.5 rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 shadow-sm">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDataMode('vocab')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md transition-colors ${
                    dataMode === 'vocab' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-gray-500'
                  }`}
                >
                  Từ vựng
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDataMode('sentence')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md transition-colors ${
                    dataMode === 'sentence' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-gray-500'
                  }`}
                >
                  Câu văn
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {setCurrentLevel && (
              <div className="h-[42px]">
                <LevelSelector
                  lang={lang}
                  currentLevel={currentLevel}
                  onSelectLevel={setCurrentLevel}
                  mainColor="indigo"
                />
              </div>
            )}
            {setCurrentTopic && (
              <div className="h-[42px]">
                <TopicSelectorDropdown
                  currentLevel={currentLevel}
                  currentTopic={currentTopic}
                  onSelectTopic={setCurrentTopic}
                  mainColor="indigo"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// 5. THANH TRẠNG THÁI ĐỈNH TRONG GAME (IN-GAME TOP HUD BAR)
// ============================================================================
export const GameTopHUD = ({
  onExit,
  currentRound = 1,
  maxRounds = 20,
  isEndless = false,
  score = 0,
  streak = 0,
  timeLeft = null,
  ammoCount = 0,
  isAiSource = false,
  onSaveWord = null,
  onOpenHanzi = null,
  lang = 'en',
  mainColor = 'blue'
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-3 mb-3 border-b border-gray-100 shrink-0">
      {/* Nút Thoát & Tiến độ câu */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          onClick={onExit}
          className="p-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600 rounded-xl transition-colors active:scale-95"
          title="Thoát màn chơi"
        >
          <Icons.X size={18} />
        </button>

        <div className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-100 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1">
          <span>Câu</span>
          <span className={`text-${mainColor}-600 font-black`}>{currentRound}</span>
          <span>/</span>
          <span>{isEndless ? '∞' : maxRounds}</span>
        </div>

        {/* Huy hiệu Đạn AI dự trữ */}
        {isAiSource && (
          <div
            className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold"
            title="Số câu hỏi AI đã nạp sẵn trong băng đạn"
          >
            <Icons.Database size={12} />
            <span>Đạn: {ammoCount}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Khu vực Điểm số, Combo, Đồng hồ & Tiện ích */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
        {timeLeft !== null && (
          <div
            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl font-mono font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1 border ${
              timeLeft <= 5
                ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 border-red-200 animate-pulse'
                : 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Icons.Clock size={13} />
            <span>{timeLeft}s</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {streak > 1 && (
          <div className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 border border-orange-200 rounded-xl font-black text-xs flex items-center gap-0.5 animate-bounce">
            <Icons.Zap size={13} fill="currentColor" />
            <span>x{streak}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className={`px-3 py-1.5 bg-${mainColor}-50 text-${mainColor}-700 border border-${mainColor}-200 rounded-xl font-mono font-black text-xs sm:text-sm`}>
          {score} đ
        </div>

        {onSaveWord && (
          <button
            onClick={onSaveWord}
            className="p-2 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-600 border border-yellow-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-yellow-100 transition-colors"
            title="Lưu từ vào Sổ tay"
          >
            <Icons.Bookmark size={16} />
          </button>
        )}

        {lang === 'zh' && onOpenHanzi && (
          <button
            onClick={onOpenHanzi}
            className="p-2 bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-red-100 transition-colors"
            title="Tập viết chữ Hán"
          >
            <Icons.Brush size={16} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const GameSharedUI = {
  GameSummaryScreen,
  ResumeSessionBanner,
  GrammarTrapSelector,
  SourceModeSelector,
  GameTopHUD
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\FillBlankGame.jsx
=========================================

/**
 * @file src/features/games/FillBlankGame.jsx
 * @description Controller điều phối Mini-game Điền Từ (Fill in the Blanks) với QueueEngine & Fallback.
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.9 (FillBlank Game Logic)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { pullRetryCardWithLock } from '@/services/db';
import { QueueEngine } from '@/engines/queueEngine';
import { ExamEngine } from '@/engines/exam';
import { GameAlgoEngine } from '@/engines/gameOfflineEngine';
import { FallbackDataEngine } from '@/engines/fallbackData';
import { GlobalLoadingScreen } from '@/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen';

import {
  calculateGameScore,
  playGameSFX,
  handleExitDiscipline,
  normalizeLevelAndTopic,
  getConfiguredUiCooldown,
  applyAntiStreakShuffle
} from './common/gameHelpers';
import { GameSummaryScreen } from './common/GameSharedUI';
import { FillBlankSetup, FillBlankBoard } from './FillBlankUI';

export const FillBlankGame = ({
  cards = [],
  lang = 'en',
  apiKey = '',
  settings = {},
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode = 'sentence', // Mặc định Điền từ thường chơi bằng câu
  setDataMode,
  gameSessions = {},
  setGameSessions,
  globalRetryBag = {},
  addToRetryBag,
  removeFromRetryBag,
  onLogWrong,
  onSaveToHarvest,
  onOpenWordSelector,
  onOpenHanzi,
  speak,
  isMuted = false,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  setIsGamePlaying,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  // ============================================================================
  // 1. STATE CẤU HÌNH & TRẠNG THÁI VÒNG ĐỜI GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(() => {
    const saved = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_fillblank_config', {});
    return {
      sourceMode: cards.length >= 4 ? (saved.sourceMode || 'local') : 'ai',
      difficulty: saved.difficulty || 'normal',
      grammarId: saved.grammarId || '',
      isEndless: saved.isEndless || false,
      totalQuestions: saved.totalQuestions || 20,
      timerEnabled: saved.timerEnabled !== false,
      timeLimit: saved.timeLimit || 30,
      showHint: saved.showHint !== false // Ẩn/hiện gợi ý Tiếng Việt
    };
  });

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('setup'); // 'setup' | 'loading' | 'playing' | 'summary'
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [correctCount, setCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(null);
  const [cooldownLeft, setCooldownLeft] = useState(0);
  const [ammoCount, setAmmoCount] = useState(0);

  // State Bàn chơi hiện tại
  const [currentCard, setCurrentCard] = useState(null);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState(null);
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);
  const [wrongFeedback, setWrongFeedback] = useState(null);
  
  const [isExplaining, setIsExplaining] = useState(false);

  // Refs điều phối đa luồng & logic game
  const coordinatorRef = useRef(null);
  const usedTermsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(null);
  const streakTrackerRef = useRef([]); // Chống lặp vị trí đáp án

  // Lưu cấu hình khi thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_fillblank_config', config);
  }, [config]);

  // Đồng bộ cờ đang chơi lên App
  useEffect(() => {
    if (setIsGamePlaying) {
      setIsGamePlaying(status === 'playing' || status === 'loading');
    }
    return () => {
      if (setIsGamePlaying) setIsGamePlaying(false);
    };
  }, [status, setIsGamePlaying]);

  // Quét số lượng đạn AI dự trữ mỗi 500ms
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current && coordinatorRef.current.queue) {
        const aiItems = coordinatorRef.current.queue.filter((b) => b && b.content && b.content.isAiGenerated);
        setAmmoCount(aiItems.length);
      } else {
        setAmmoCount(0);
      }
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  // Dọn dẹp khi unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. HÀM ĐÓNG GÓI BÀN CHƠI NGOẠI TUYẾN (LOCAL / FALLBACK BOARD BUILDER)
  // ============================================================================
  const buildLocalBoard = useCallback(() => {
    const validDeck = cards.filter((c) => c && c.term && c.definition);
    let selectedItem = null;

    // 1. Rút 1 thẻ từ Túi nháp lỗi sai
    const retryCard = pullRetryCardWithLock('fillblank', globalRetryBag, lang);
    if (retryCard && retryCard.term && retryCard.definition) {
      selectedItem = retryCard;
    }

    // 2. Lấy thẻ chưa dùng trong bộ bài hiện tại
    if (!selectedItem) {
      let unusedPool = validDeck.filter((c) => !usedTermsRef.current.has(c.term));
      if (unusedPool.length === 0 && validDeck.length > 0) {
        usedTermsRef.current.clear();
        unusedPool = validDeck;
      }
      
      if (unusedPool.length > 0) {
        selectedItem = unusedPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * unusedPool.length)];
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback cứu hộ
    if (!selectedItem) {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const fallbackList = FallbackDataEngine.getGameReadyFallback('fillblank', lang, pickedLevel, { dataMode });
      return fallbackList; // Trả thẳng kết quả mask từ Fallback Engine
    }

    usedTermsRef.current.add(selectedItem.term || '');

    const type = Utils.detectSentence(selectedItem.term) ? 'sentence' : 'word';
    let maskedResult = null;

    // Động cơ đục lỗ Offline (Sử dụng GameAlgoEngine)
    if (GameAlgoEngine?.ClozeEngine?.offline_mask) {
      try {
        maskedResult = GameAlgoEngine.ClozeEngine.offline_mask(selectedItem.term, lang, type, validDeck);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("FillBlank Offline Mask Generation Error:", e);
      }
    }
    
    // Fallback nếu thuật toán trên thất bại
    if (!maskedResult) {
      maskedResult = {
        targetWord: selectedItem.term,
        displaySentence: "[__________]",
        hint: selectedItem.definition,
        distractors: ["Nhiễu 1", "Nhiễu 2", "Nhiễu 3"]
      };
    }

    const correctOpt = { text: maskedResult.targetWord, isCorrect: true };
    const distractors = (maskedResult.distractors || []).slice(0, 3).map(d => ({ text: d, isCorrect: false }));
    
    // Nếu thiếu nhiễu, bơm thêm cho đủ 4 đáp án
    while (distractors.length < 3) {
      distractors.push({ text: "Đáp án " + (distractors.length + 1), isCorrect: false });
    }
    
    // Áp dụng thuật toán xáo trộn chống Streak
    const shuffledOptions = applyAntiStreakShuffle([...distractors, correctOpt], streakTrackerRef);

    return {
      displaySentence: maskedResult.displaySentence,
      targetWord: maskedResult.targetWord,
      hint: maskedResult.hint || selectedItem.definition,
      options: shuffledOptions,
      origin: selectedItem,
      isAiGenerated: false
    };
  }, [cards, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, globalRetryBag, lang]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 3. HÀM TẢI ĐẠN AI CHO QUEUE COORDINATOR
  // ============================================================================
  const fetchAiQuestion = useCallback(async () => {
    const { pickedLevel, pickedTopic } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(
      currentLevel,
      currentTopic,
      lang
    );

    const meta = {
      id: `fillblank_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      type: 'fill_blank', // Sẽ được ánh xạ thành 'ioe_fill_blank' trong ExamEngine
      mode: 'minigame',
      lang,
      level: pickedLevel,
      topic: pickedTopic,
      difficulty: config.difficulty,
      grammarId: config.grammarId,
      dataMode
    };

    const hydrated = await ExamEngine.hydrateQuestion(meta, apiKey);
    if (hydrated && hydrated.content) {
      if (onSaveToHarvest && hydrated.isNewHarvest) {
        onSaveToHarvest(pickedLevel, hydrated.content.origin || hydrated.content);
      }
      return hydrated;
    }
    throw new Error('Dữ liệu FillBlank AI trả về rỗng.');
  }, [apiKey, config.difficulty, config.grammarId, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, lang, onSaveToHarvest]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 4. NẠP BÀN CHƠI MỚI & ĐỒNG HỒ ĐẾM NGƯỢC
  // ============================================================================
  const startCooldownIfNeeded = useCallback((isAiRound) => {
    if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    if (!isAiRound) {
      setCooldownLeft(0);
      return;
    }
    const cdSec = getConfiguredUiCooldown(9);
    setCooldownLeft(cdSec);
    cooldownRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCooldownLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  }, []);

  const loadQuestionBoard = useCallback(
    (targetIndex) => {
      let nextData = null;

      if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && coordinatorRef.current) {
        nextData = coordinatorRef.current.pop();
      }

      let qContent = null;
      if (nextData && nextData.content) {
        qContent = nextData.content;
      } else {
        if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && window.globalShowToast && targetIndex > 0) {
          window.globalShowToast('Đang dùng dữ liệu dự phòng trong lúc đợi AI nạp đạn...', 'warning');
        }
        qContent = buildLocalBoard();
      }
      
      // Xử lý options nếu AI chưa map sẵn
      if (qContent && (!qContent.options || qContent.options.length === 0) && qContent.distractors) {
         const correctOpt = { text: qContent.targetWord, isCorrect: true };
         const distractors = qContent.distractors.slice(0, 3).map(d => ({ text: d, isCorrect: false }));
         qContent.options = [...distractors, correctOpt];
      }

      // Đảm bảo Options được xáo trộn chuẩn chống Streak
      if (qContent && Array.isArray(qContent.options)) {
        qContent.options = applyAntiStreakShuffle(qContent.options, streakTrackerRef);
      }

      setCurrentCard(qContent);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setIsChecked(false);
      setWrongFeedback(null);
      setIsExplaining(false);
      
      setTimeLeft(config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null);
      startCooldownIfNeeded(config.sourceMode === 'ai');
    },
    [buildLocalBoard, config.sourceMode, config.timeLimit, config.timerEnabled, startCooldownIfNeeded]
  );

  // Đồng hồ đếm ngược
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'playing' || !config.timerEnabled || isChecked || timeLeft === null) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev === null) return null;
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
          setStreak(0);
          setIsChecked(true);
          
          if (currentCard?.origin) {
            if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
            if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('fillblank', currentCard.origin);
          }
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [status, config.timerEnabled, isChecked, timeLeft, isMuted, currentCard, onLogWrong, addToRetryBag]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 5. KHỞI ĐỘNG GAME & KHÔI PHỤC PHIÊN CHƠI
  // ============================================================================
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    usedTermsRef.current.clear();
    streakTrackerRef.current = [];
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setScore(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setCorrectCount(0);

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();

    if (config.sourceMode === 'ai') {
      coordinatorRef.current = QueueEngine.createQueueCoordinator(fetchAiQuestion, 4);
      setStatus('loading');
      coordinatorRef.current.maintain(true, 22000, false);
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleLoadingComplete = useCallback(() => {
    loadQuestionBoard(0);
    setStatus('playing');
  }, [loadQuestionBoard]);

  const handleResumeSession = () => {
    const saved = gameSessions?.fillblank;
    if (!saved) return;

    if (saved.config) setConfig(saved.config);
    setCurrentIndex(saved.currentIndex || 0);
    setScore(saved.score || 0);
    setStreak(saved.streak || 0);
    setCorrectCount(saved.correctCount || 0);

    if (saved.currentCard) {
      setCurrentCard(saved.currentCard);
      setSelectedOption(saved.selectedOption || null);
      setIsChecked(saved.isChecked || false);
      setWrongFeedback(saved.wrongFeedback || null);
      setTimeLeft(saved.timeLeft ?? (config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null));
      setStatus('playing');
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(saved.currentIndex || 0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleClearSession = () => {
    if (setGameSessions) {
      setGameSessions((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next.fillblank;
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 6. XỬ LÝ TƯƠNG TÁC (CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN)
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSelectOption = (opt) => {
    if (isChecked || !currentCard) return;

    setSelectedOption(opt);
    setIsChecked(true);

    const isCorrect = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';

    if (isCorrect) {
      playGameSFX('correct', isMuted);
      const nextStreak = streak + 1;
      const points = calculateGameScore(100, timeLeft || 0, nextStreak, config.difficulty);
      setStreak(nextStreak);
      setScore(prev => prev + points);
      setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1);
      
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.targetWord || '';
      if (removeFromRetryBag) removeFromRetryBag('fillblank', targetTerm);
      
    } else {
      playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
      setStreak(0);
      if (currentCard.origin) {
        if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
        if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('fillblank', currentCard.origin);
      }
      setWrongFeedback(currentCard.origin?.explanation || currentCard.explanation || "Hãy xem kỹ lại phân tích ngữ pháp.");
    }
  };

  const handleExplainGrammar = async () => {
    if (isExplaining) return;
    if (!apiKey) {
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Cần API Key để phân tích!", "warning");
      return;
    }

    setIsExplaining(true);
    try {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || (currentCard.displaySentence ? currentCard.displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, currentCard.targetWord) : "");
      
      if (!targetTerm) throw new Error("Không xác định được câu gốc để phân tích.");
      
      const res = await Utils.fillCardWithAi(targetTerm, lang, apiKey, ['analysis'], dataMode, [pickedLevel]);
      if (res && res.analysis) {
        setWrongFeedback(res.analysis);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Lỗi phân tích: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsExplaining(false);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 7. CHUYỂN CÂU & THOÁT GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    if (cooldownLeft > 0) return;

    if (!config.isEndless && currentIndex >= config.totalQuestions - 1) {
      handleClearSession();
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      setStatus('summary');
      return;
    }

    const nextIdx = currentIndex + 1;
    setCurrentIndex(nextIdx);
    loadQuestionBoard(nextIdx);
  };

  const handleExitGame = () => {
    if (status === 'playing' && !isChecked) {
      handleExitDiscipline({
        isPlaying: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        currentCard: currentCard?.origin || currentCard,
        gameType: 'fillblank',
        onLogWrong,
        addToRetryBag
      });

      if (setGameSessions) {
        setGameSessions((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          fillblank: {
            config,
            currentIndex,
            score,
            streak,
            correctCount,
            currentCard,
            selectedOption,
            isChecked,
            wrongFeedback,
            timeLeft,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          }
        }));
      }
    }

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
    setStatus('setup');
  };

  const handleSaveCurrentWord = () => {
    if (!onOpenWordSelector || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || (currentCard.displaySentence ? currentCard.displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, currentCard.targetWord) : "");
    if (targetTerm) onOpenWordSelector(targetTerm);
  };

  const handleOpenHanziCurrent = () => {
    if (!onOpenHanzi || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.targetWord || currentCard.origin?.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenHanzi(targetTerm);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 8. RENDER THEO TRẠNG THÁI
  // ============================================================================
  if (status === 'loading') {
    const { levelLabel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
    return (
      <GlobalLoadingScreen
        engine={coordinatorRef.current}
        onComplete={handleLoadingComplete}
        onCancel={() => {
          if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
          setStatus('setup');
        }}
        text="AI Đang Tạo Câu Hỏi Điền Từ..."
        subText="Đang trích xuất từ khóa và thiết kế đáp án nhiễu"
        mainColor={mainColor}
        levelStr={levelLabel}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'summary') {
    return (
      <GameSummaryScreen
        score={score}
        correctCount={correctCount}
        totalQuestions={currentIndex + 1}
        onRestart={handleStartGame}
        onBack={onBack}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'playing') {
    return (
      <FillBlankBoard
        currentIndex={currentIndex}
        totalQuestions={config.totalQuestions}
        isEndless={config.isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={config.sourceMode === 'ai'}
        currentCard={currentCard}
        selectedOption={selectedOption}
        isChecked={isChecked}
        wrongFeedback={wrongFeedback}
        showHint={config.showHint}
        cooldownLeft={cooldownLeft}
        onSelectOption={handleSelectOption}
        onNextQuestion={handleNextQuestion}
        onExplainGrammar={handleExplainGrammar}
        onSpeak={speak}
        onSaveWord={handleSaveCurrentWord}
        onOpenHanzi={handleOpenHanziCurrent}
        onExit={handleExitGame}
        fontFamily={Utils.getFontFamily(settings)}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <FillBlankSetup
      config={config}
      setConfig={setConfig}
      cardsCount={cards.length}
      lang={lang}
      currentLevel={currentLevel}
      setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
      currentTopic={currentTopic}
      setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
      dataMode={dataMode}
      setDataMode={setDataMode}
      savedSession={gameSessions?.fillblank}
      onResumeSession={handleResumeSession}
      onClearSession={handleClearSession}
      onStartGame={handleStartGame}
      onBack={onBack}
      onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
      mainColor={mainColor}
      t={t}
    />
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/features/games/FillBlankUI.jsx
 * @description Giao diện Setup & Bàn chơi của Mini-game Điền Từ (Fill in the Blanks).

// ============================================================================
// 1. MÀN HÌNH CÀI ĐẶT GAME ĐIỀN TỪ (FILL BLANK SETUP)

export const FillBlankSetup = ({
  config,
  setConfig,
  cardsCount = 0,
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode,
  setDataMode,
  savedSession,
  onResumeSession,
  onClearSession,
  onStartGame,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const minRequiredCards = 4;
  const canStart = config.sourceMode === 'ai' || cardsCount >= minRequiredCards;

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-5 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar border-2 border-gray-100 animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* Header Setup */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-600 shadow-sm`}>
              <Icons.Keyboard size={22} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-tight">
                Điền Từ Khuyết
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
                Tìm từ phù hợp nhất điền vào chỗ trống
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-full transition-colors"
            title="Quay lại Menu Game"
          >
            <Icons.X size={22} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Banner Khôi phục phiên chơi cũ */}
        <ResumeSessionBanner
          savedSession={savedSession}
          onResume={onResumeSession}
          onClear={onClearSession}
          mainColor={mainColor}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Nguồn Dữ Liệu (Thẻ của tôi vs AI Tự Sinh) */}
        <SourceModeSelector
          sourceMode={config.sourceMode}
          setSourceMode={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, sourceMode: val }))}
          cardsCount={cardsCount}
          minCards={minRequiredCards}
          lang={lang}
          currentLevel={currentLevel}
          setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
          currentTopic={currentTopic}
          setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
          dataMode={dataMode}
          setDataMode={setDataMode}
          mainColor={mainColor}
          onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Chuyên đề Bẫy Ngữ pháp (Khi dùng AI hoặc chế độ Khó) */}
        {(config.sourceMode === 'ai' || config.difficulty === 'hard') && (
          <GrammarTrapSelector
            gameType="fillblank"
            lang={lang}
            currentLevel={currentLevel}
            selectedTrap={config.grammarId}
            onSelectTrap={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, grammarId: val }))}
            mainColor={mainColor}
          />
        )}

        {/* Các Tùy chọn Chế độ chơi */}
        <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
          {/* Chế độ Vô tận (Endless Mode) */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.isEndless}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, isEndless: val }))}

              config.isEndless
