// ============================================================================
// 2. BÀN CHƠI ĐIỀN TỪ (FILL BLANK BOARD)
// ============================================================================
export const FillBlankBoard = ({
  currentIndex = 0,
  totalQuestions = 20,
  isEndless = false,
  score = 0,
  streak = 0,
  timeLeft = null,
  ammoCount = 0,
  isAiSource = false,
  currentCard = null,
  selectedOption = null,
  isChecked = false,
  wrongFeedback = null,
  showHint = true,
  cooldownLeft = 0,
  onSelectOption,
  onNextQuestion,
  onExplainGrammar,
  onSpeak,
  onSaveWord,
  onOpenHanzi,
  onExit,
  fontFamily = 'inherit',
  lang = 'en',
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const questionData = currentCard || {};
  const options = currentCard?.options || [];
  
  // Xác định text câu hỏi (đã đục lỗ)
  let displaySentence = questionData.displaySentence || "";
  
  // Phím tắt bàn phím (1, 2, 3, 4)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (isChecked) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && cooldownLeft === 0) {
          onNextQuestion();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const key = parseInt(e.key, 10);
      if (!isNaN(key) && key >= 1 && key <= options.length) {
        onSelectOption(options[key - 1]);
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isChecked, cooldownLeft, onNextQuestion, onSelectOption, options]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between border-2 border-gray-100 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in">
      {/* Thanh Top HUD Dùng chung */}
      <GameTopHUD
        onExit={onExit}
        currentRound={currentIndex + 1}
        maxRounds={totalQuestions}
        isEndless={isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={isAiSource}
        onSaveWord={onSaveWord}
        onOpenHanzi={onOpenHanzi}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
      />

      {/* Khu vực Câu hỏi */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar space-y-4 pr-1 my-1 flex flex-col">
        <div className={`flex-1 min-h-[140px] p-5 rounded-2xl bg-${mainColor}-50/50 border border-${mainColor}-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative text-center`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-2 absolute top-3">
            Chọn từ điền vào chỗ trống
          </div>
          
          <div 
            style={{ fontFamily }}
            className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words mt-4 whitespace-pre-wrap"
          >
            {/* Hiển thị câu đã điền nếu đã check, ngược lại hiển thị [__________] */}
            {isChecked && selectedOption 
              ? displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, ` <span class="text-${selectedOption.isCorrect ? 'green' : 'red'}-600 underline underline-offset-4 decoration-2">${selectedOption.text}</span> `)
              : displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, ' <span class="inline-block w-20 border-b-2 border-gray-400 align-bottom mx-1"></span> ')
            }
          </div>
          
          {/* Render câu dưới dạng HTML an toàn để hiện màu */}
          <div 
             style={{ fontFamily }}
             className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words mt-2 absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-5 opacity-0 pointer-events-none"
             dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
               __html: isChecked && selectedOption 
                ? displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, `<span class="text-${selectedOption.isCorrect ? 'green' : 'red'}-600 underline underline-offset-4 decoration-2 px-1">${selectedOption.text}</span>`)
                : displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, '<span class="inline-block w-24 border-b-4 border-gray-300 align-bottom mx-1 mb-1"></span>')
             }}
          />
          
          {/* Lớp phủ thực sự hiển thị HTML */}
          <div 
             style={{ fontFamily }}
             className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words mt-4"
             dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
               __html: isChecked && selectedOption 
                ? displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, `<span class="text-${selectedOption.isCorrect || String(selectedOption.isCorrect).toLowerCase()==='true' ? 'green' : 'red'}-600 underline underline-offset-4 decoration-4 px-1 bg-${selectedOption.isCorrect || String(selectedOption.isCorrect).toLowerCase()==='true' ? 'green' : 'red'}-100 rounded">${selectedOption.text}</span>`)
                : displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, '<span class="inline-block w-24 border-b-4 border-gray-400 align-bottom mx-1 mb-1"></span>')
             }}
          />
          
          {showHint && questionData.hint && (
            <div className="mt-4 text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 bg-white/60 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200">
              💡 {questionData.hint}
            </div>
          )}

          {onSpeak && questionData.targetWord && isChecked && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSpeak(questionData.displaySentence.replace(/\[__________\]/g, questionData.targetWord))}
              className={`mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white text-${mainColor}-600 border border-${mainColor}-200 text-xs font-bold shadow-sm hover:bg-${mainColor}-50 transition-all active:scale-95`}
            >
              <Icons.Volume2 size={14} />
              <span>Đọc toàn câu</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Khối Đáp án */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 shrink-0">
          {options.map((opt, idx) => {
            const isCorrectOption = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';
            const isSelected = selectedOption === opt;
            
            let btnStyle = `bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:border-${mainColor}-400 hover:bg-${mainColor}-50/40`;
            
            if (isChecked) {
              if (isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-green-500 border-green-600 text-white shadow-md scale-[1.02] z-10';
              } else if (isSelected && !isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-red-500 border-red-600 text-white shadow-md animate-shake';
              } else {
                btnStyle = 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 opacity-60 scale-95';
              }
            } else if (isSelected) {
              btnStyle = `bg-${mainColor}-100 border-${mainColor}-500 text-${mainColor}-800 ring-2 ring-${mainColor}-200`;
            }

            const OptionIcon = isChecked && isCorrectOption ? Icons.CheckCircle : (isChecked && isSelected ? Icons.X : null);

            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                type="button"
                disabled={isChecked}
                onClick={() => onSelectOption(opt)}
                style={{ fontFamily: (isChecked && isCorrectOption) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }}
                className={`relative min-h-[64px] p-3 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-center flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 break-words ${btnStyle}`}
              >
                <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 text-[10px] opacity-50 font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-current">
                  {idx + 1}
                </span>
                
                <span className="px-6">{opt.text}</span>
                
                {OptionIcon && (
                  <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
                    <OptionIcon size={20} className={isCorrectOption ? 'text-white' : 'text-white'} />
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        
        {/* Khối Giải thích / Feedback */}
        {isChecked && (
          <div className="animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 shrink-0">
             <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-2 ${
                selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true'
                  ? 'bg-green-50/80 border-green-200 text-green-900'
                  : 'bg-red-50/80 border-red-200 text-red-900'
              }`}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? (
                      <>
                        <Icons.CheckCircle size={18} className="text-green-600" />
                        <span>Chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Icons.AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600" />
                        <span>Chưa chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Nút giải thích ngữ pháp */}
                  {onExplainGrammar && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={onExplainGrammar}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white/60 hover:bg-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <Icons.Sparkles size={13} className="text-purple-600" /> Giải thích
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                
                {/* Nội dung giải thích có sẵn từ thẻ */}
                {(questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback || questionData.hint) && (
                  <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed bg-white/70 p-3 rounded-lg border border-black/5 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                    <div className="font-black opacity-60 mb-1 uppercase text-[10px]">Phân tích / Gợi ý:</div>
                    {questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback || questionData.hint}
                  </div>
                )}
             </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Tiếp theo */}
      <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0 h-[60px]">
        {isChecked ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNextQuestion}
            disabled={cooldownLeft > 0}
            className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm sm:text-base ${
              cooldownLeft > 0
                ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-wait'
                : `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700`
            }`}
          >
            <span>
              {cooldownLeft > 0
                ? `Đợi nạp đạn (${cooldownLeft}s)...`
                : 'Câu tiếp theo (Enter)'}
            </span>
            <Icons.ChevronRight size={20} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 select-none">
            Chọn 1 đáp án để tiếp tục
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const FillBlankUI = {
  FillBlankSetup,
  FillBlankBoard
};

/**
 * @file src/features/games/GameMenu.jsx
 * @description Giao diện Menu chính chọn 10 Mini-games & Cấu hình Phòng thi Khảo thí (Mock Test).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.7a (Game Menu & Exam Setup Hub)
 */


import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { LevelSelector, TopicSelectorDropdown } from '@/components/common/Controls';
import { ExamProfiles } from '@/engines/examProfiles';

import { normalizeLevelAndTopic } from './common/gameHelpers';


// Icon Hình ảnh nội bộ an toàn cho Game Đoán Hình

  <svg
    width={size}
    height={size}
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth="2"
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
    className={className}
  >
    <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"></circle>

export const GameMenu = ({
  onSelectGame,
  onStartExam,
  onResumeExam,
  onOpenExamPoolManager,
  onOpenAiConfig,
  cardsCount = 0,
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  gameSessions = {},
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('minigames'); // 'minigames' | 'exam'
  const [selectedProfileId, setSelectedProfileId] = useState(() =>
    lang === 'zh' ? 'hsk_mini' : 'ioe_mini'
  );
  const [mockDelay, setMockDelay] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('fc_mock_delay');
    return saved !== null ? parseInt(saved, 10) : 3;
  });
  const [activeExamSessionId, setActiveExamSessionId] = useState(null);


  // Tự động đồng bộ cấu hình đề thi mặc định khi đổi ngôn ngữ
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedProfileId(lang === 'zh' ? 'hsk_mini' : 'ioe_mini');
  }, [lang]);


  // Kiểm tra phiên thi Mock Test đang làm dở
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedExamId = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS?.ACTIVE_EXAM || 'fc_active_exam');
    setActiveExamSessionId(savedExamId || null);
  }, [activeTab]);


  const handleDelayChange = (val) => {
    const num = Number(val);
    setMockDelay(num);
    localStorage.setItem('fc_mock_delay', String(num));
  };


  // Danh sách 10 Mini-Games
  const miniGames = [
    {
      id: 'quiz',
      name: t ? t('modeQuiz') || 'Trắc Nghiệm' : 'Trắc Nghiệm',
      desc: 'Phản xạ 4 đáp án đa chiều',
      icon: Icons.Layers,
      color: 'blue',
      badge: 'Phổ biến'
    },
    {
      id: 'match',
      name: t ? t('modeMatch') || 'Nối Ô Từ Vựng' : 'Nối Ô Từ Vựng',
      desc: 'Ghép cặp từ và nghĩa tốc độ cao',
      icon: Icons.Link,
      color: 'teal',
      badge: null
    },
    {
      id: 'scramble',
      name: t ? t('modeScramble') || 'Ghép Câu & Từ' : 'Ghép Câu & Từ',
      desc: 'Sắp xếp mảnh từ hoặc gõ câu',
      icon: Icons.Shuffle,
      color: 'indigo',
      badge: null
    },
    {
      id: 'fillblank',
      name: 'Điền Từ Khuyết',
      desc: 'Hoàn thiện chỗ trống ngữ cảnh',
      icon: Icons.Keyboard,
      color: 'purple',
      badge: 'Collocations'
    },
    {
      id: 'spotmistake',
      name: 'Tìm Lỗi Sai',
      desc: 'Bắt lỗi ngữ pháp & chính tả',
      icon: Icons.Target,
      color: 'red',
      badge: 'Grammar'
    },
    {
      id: 'oddoneout',
      name: 'Từ Khác Loại',
      desc: 'Tư duy phân nhóm từ vựng',
      icon: Icons.Eye,
      color: 'orange',
      badge: null
    },
    {
      id: 'imagequiz',
      name: 'Đoán Hình',
      desc: 'Ghi nhớ từ vựng qua hình ảnh',
      icon: ImageIcon,
      color: 'green',
      badge: 'Visual'
    },
    {
      id: 'pronunciation',
      name: 'Vua Ngữ Âm',
      desc: 'Phân biệt âm đọc & thanh điệu',
      icon: Icons.Mic,
      color: 'pink',
      badge: null
    },
    {
      id: 'listening',
      name: 'Đôi Tai Vàng',
      desc: 'Luyện nghe kịch bản & hội thoại',
      icon: Icons.Headphones,
      color: 'cyan',
      badge: 'Audio'
    },
    {
      id: 'reading',
      name: 'Đọc Hiểu',
      desc: 'Phân tích đoạn văn chuyên sâu',
      icon: Icons.BookOpen,
      color: 'amber',
      badge: 'Passage'
    }
  ];


  // Danh sách Cấu hình Đề thi Khảo thí (Lọc theo ngôn ngữ học hiện tại)
  const allProfiles = Object.values(ExamProfiles.PROFILES || {});
  const availableProfiles = allProfiles.filter((p) =>
    lang === 'zh' ? p.track === 'hsk' : p.track !== 'hsk'
  );


  const handleTriggerStartExam = () => {
    if (!onStartExam) return;
    const { pickedLevel, pickedTopic } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(
      currentLevel,
      currentTopic,
      lang
    );
    onStartExam(selectedProfileId, pickedLevel, pickedTopic);
  };


  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden border-2 border-gray-100 animate-in fade-in">
      {/* HEADER & CHUYỂN TAB (MINI-GAMES vs KHẢO THÍ) */}
      <div className="shrink-0 space-y-3 mb-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-600 shadow-sm`}>
              <Icons.Gamepad2 size={24} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-tight uppercase tracking-wide">
                Trung Tâm Trò Chơi & Khảo Thí
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
                Đang có <b className={`text-${mainColor}-600`}>{cardsCount} thẻ</b> cục bộ • Hỗ trợ AI Tự Sinh vô hạn
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>


          {/* Nút mở nhanh Ngân hàng Đề thi & Cấu hình Lõi AI */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
            {onOpenExamPoolManager && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenExamPoolManager}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm active:scale-95"
                title="Quản lý Ngân hàng Đề thi & Tỉ lệ Lai"
              >
                <Icons.Database size={14} />
                <span>Kho Đề Thi</span>
              </button>
            )}
            {onOpenAiConfig && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenAiConfig}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-purple-100 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm active:scale-95"
                title="Cấu hình tốc độ nạp đạn Lõi AI"
              >
                <Icons.Cpu size={14} />
                <span>Lõi AI</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>


        {/* Thanh chuyển Tab */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 bg-gray-100 p-1 rounded-xl border border-gray-200">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('minigames')}
            className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg font-black text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all ${
              activeTab === 'minigames'
                ? `bg-white text-${mainColor}-700 shadow-sm`
                : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
            }`}
          >
            <Icons.Gamepad2 size={16} />
            <span>10 Mini-Games</span>
          </button>


          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('exam')}
            className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg font-black text-xs sm:text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all relative ${
              activeTab === 'exam'
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 text-white shadow-md'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-indigo-700'
            }`}
          >
            <Icons.Award size={16} />
            <span>Phòng Thi Ảo (Mock Test)</span>
            {activeExamSessionId && (
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-ping absolute top-1.5 right-2"></span>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>


      {/* NỘI DUNG CHÍNH THEO TAB */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
        {activeTab === 'minigames' ? (
          /* ================================================================
             TAB 1: LƯỚI 10 MINI-GAMES
             ================================================================ */
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 py-1">
            {miniGames.map((game) => {
              const IconComp = game.icon || Icons.Gamepad2;
              const hasSavedSession = Boolean(gameSessions && gameSessions[game.id]);


              return (
                <button
                  key={game.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onSelectGame && onSelectGame(game.id)}
                  className="group relative p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-gray-100 hover:border-blue-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex flex-col items-center text-center justify-between min-h-[128px]"
                >
                  {/* Huy hiệu Phiên chơi đang dở hoặc Nhãn tính năng */}
                  {hasSavedSession ? (
                    <span className="absolute top-2 right-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border border-orange-300 animate-pulse">
                      Đang dở
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    game.badge && (
                      <span className="absolute top-2 right-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold bg-gray-100 text-gray-500">
                        {game.badge}
                      </span>
                    )
                  )}


                  <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-${mainColor}-50 text-${mainColor}-600 flex items-center justify-center mb-2 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform shadow-sm border border-${mainColor}-100`}>
                    <IconComp size={24} />
                  </div>


                  <div>
                    <div className="font-black text-gray-800 text-xs sm:text-sm leading-tight mb-1">
                      {game.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-medium line-clamp-2 leading-snug">
                      {game.desc}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* ================================================================
             TAB 2: CẤU HÌNH PHÒNG THI KHẢO THÍ (MOCK TEST)
             ================================================================ */
          <div className="space-y-4 py-1 animate-in fade-in">
            {/* Banner Khôi phục Ca thi đang dở */}
            {activeExamSessionId && onResumeExam && (
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-50 to-orange-50 border-2 border-orange-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-orange-500 text-white shadow">
                    <Icons.Clock size={20} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-left">
                    <div className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-orange-800">
                      Có một bài thi đang tạm dừng!
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-orange-700 font-medium">
                      Bạn có thể tiếp tục làm bài ngay tại câu hỏi đã dừng trước đó.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>


                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onResumeExam(activeExamSessionId)}
                    className="flex-1 sm:flex-initial px-4 py-2 bg-orange-600 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow hover:bg-orange-700 transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                  >
                    <Icons.Play size={14} fill="currentColor" /> Tiếp tục thi
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS?.ACTIVE_EXAM || 'fc_active_exam');
                      setActiveExamSessionId(null);
                    }}
                    className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 rounded-lg"
                    title="Hủy phiên thi cũ"
                  >
                    <Icons.Trash2 size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}


            {/* Chọn Cấu trúc Đề thi (Exam Profile Cards) */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-xs font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider block text-left">
                1. Chọn Cấu Trúc Kỳ Thi ({lang === 'zh' ? 'Chuẩn HSK' : 'Chuẩn IOE & IELTS'})
              </label>


              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {availableProfiles.map((prof) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedProfileId === prof.id;
                  const minutes = Math.round((prof.timeLimit || 1800) / 60);


                  return (
                    <button
                      key={prof.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedProfileId(prof.id)}
                      className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 text-left transition-all flex flex-col justify-between gap-2 ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-indigo-50/70 border-indigo-600 ring-2 ring-indigo-200 shadow-md'
                          : 'bg-white border-gray-200 hover:border-indigo-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <div>
                          <span className="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 mb-1">
                            {prof.track.toUpperCase()} • {prof.mode.toUpperCase()}
                          </span>
                          <h3 className="font-black text-gray-800 text-base leading-tight">
                            {prof.name}
                          </h3>
                        </div>
                        <div
                          className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-1 ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-600 text-white'
                              : 'border-gray-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isSelected && <Icons.Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />}
                        </div>
                      </div>


                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 leading-relaxed">
                        {prof.description}
                      </p>


                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-gray-100 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Icons.Layers size={14} className="text-indigo-500" />
                          {prof.totalQuestions} câu
                        </span>
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Icons.Clock size={14} className="text-orange-500" />
                          {minutes} phút
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>


            {/* Chọn Cấp độ, Chủ đề & Độ trễ chuyển câu */}
            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 space-y-3">
              <div className="text-xs font-black text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider text-left">
                2. Thiết lập Cấp độ & Tốc độ Phòng thi
              </div>


              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="h-[44px]">
                  <LevelSelector
                    lang={lang}
                    currentLevel={currentLevel}
                    onSelectLevel={setCurrentLevel}
                    mainColor="indigo"
                  />
                </div>


                <div className="h-[44px]">
                  <TopicSelectorDropdown
                    currentLevel={currentLevel}
                    currentTopic={currentTopic}
                    onSelectTopic={setCurrentTopic}
                    mainColor="indigo"
                  />
                </div>


                {/* Bộ chọn thời gian nghỉ chuyển câu (Mock Delay) */}
                <div className="h-[44px] bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Icons.Clock size={13} className="text-indigo-500" /> Chuyển câu:
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex gap-1">
                    {[0, 2, 3, 5].map((sec) => (
                      <button
                        key={sec}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleDelayChange(sec)}
                        className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-black transition-colors ${
                          mockDelay === sec
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                            : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {sec}s
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>


            {/* Nút Bắt đầu Kỳ thi */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleTriggerStartExam}
              className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-indigo-700 hover:to-purple-700 text-white font-black text-base shadow-lg shadow-indigo-200 transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
            >
              <Icons.Play size={20} fill="currentColor" />
              <span>BẮT ĐẦU KỲ THI KHẢO THÍ</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


export default GameMenu;

FILE: src\features\games\GameView.jsx
=========================================

/**
 * @file src/features/games/GameView.jsx
 * @description Trạm Switchboard điều hướng trung tâm của Tầng 5. Quản lý việc hiển thị Game Menu, 10 Mini-games và Môi trường Khảo thí (Mock Test).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.7b (Game View Router)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';

// Giao diện Menu & Loader
import { GameMenu } from './GameMenu';
import { GlobalLoadingScreen } from '@/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen';

// 10 Mini-games Controllers
import { MatchGame } from './MatchGame';
import { QuizGame } from './QuizGame';
import { ScrambleGame } from './ScrambleGame';
import { FillBlankGame } from './FillBlankGame';
import { SpotMistakeGame } from './SpotMistakeGame';
import { OddOneOutGame } from './OddOneOutGame';
import { ImageQuizGame } from './ImageQuizGame';
import { PronunciationGame } from './PronunciationGame';
import { ListeningGame } from './ListeningGame';
import { ReadingGame } from './ReadingGame';

// Môi trường Khảo thí (Mock Test)
import { ExamUIShell } from '../exam/ExamUIShell';
import { ExamReportUI } from '../exam/ExamReportUI';
import { ExamReviewModal } from '../exam/ExamReviewModal';

export const GameView = ({ state, actions, setters }) => {
  const [activeGame, setActiveGame] = useState(null);
  const [isReviewModalOpen, setIsReviewModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Phân rã State và Logic
  const { lang, cards, mainColor, examLogic, gameSessions, settings } = state;

  // Lắng nghe tín hiệu Điều hướng Ẩn (từ Màn hình Sổ tay Lỗi sai muốn ôn tập bằng Game)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (window.__pendingGameRoute) {
      const route = window.__pendingGameRoute;
      window.__pendingGameRoute = null; // Consume route
      
      const gameType = route.split('_')[0];
      if (gameType) {
        setActiveGame(gameType);
      }
    }
  }, [activeGame]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 1. NHÁNH RENDER MÔI TRƯỜNG KHẢO THÍ (MOCK TEST ERA)
  // ============================================================================
  if (examLogic && examLogic.examState) {
    const { examState, currentQuestion, cachedCount, examCooldown } = examLogic;

    if (examState.status === 'loading') {
      return (
        <GlobalLoadingScreen
          duration={examState.preloadCountdown || 30}
          queueLength={cachedCount}
          text="Phòng Thi Đang Khởi Tạo..."
          subText="Đang nạp ngân hàng đề và phân bổ tổ kén câu hỏi"
          mainColor="indigo"
          onCancel={examLogic.quitExam}
        />
      );
    }

    if (examState.status === 'playing') {
      return (
        <div className="w-full h-full relative animate-in fade-in">
          <ExamUIShell
            question={currentQuestion}
            currentIndex={examState.currentIndex}
            totalQuestions={examState.blueprint.length}
            timeLeft={examState.timeRemaining}
            onAnswerSubmit={examLogic.submitAnswer}
            onSpeak={actions.speak}
            isReviewMode={false}
            fontFamily={Utils.getFontFamily(settings)}
            lang={lang}
          />
          
          {/* Nút nộp bài khẩn cấp */}
          <div className="absolute top-3 left-4 z-[60]">
            <button 
              onClick={() => {
                if(window.confirm('Bạn có chắc chắn muốn nộp bài sớm? Các câu chưa làm sẽ bị tính là sai.')) {
                  examLogic.forceSubmitExam();
                }
              }} 
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold shadow-sm hover:bg-red-100 transition-colors"
            >
              Nộp bài
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {/* Màn che bảo vệ khi chờ chuyển câu (Cooldown) */}
          {examCooldown > 0 && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 z-[100] bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center animate-in fade-in">
              <div className="bg-white px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-xl font-bold text-indigo-600 flex flex-col items-center gap-3 border border-indigo-100">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-indigo-200 border-t-indigo-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                <div className="animate-pulse tracking-wide">Chuẩn bị câu tiếp theo ({examCooldown}s)...</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (examState.status === 'completed') {
      return (
        <>
          <ExamReportUI
            examState={examState}
            onReview={() => setIsReviewModalOpen(true)}
            onRestart={() => examLogic.startExam(examState.profile?.id, examState.blueprint[0]?.level, '')}
            onBackToMenu={examLogic.quitExam}
            onExportExcel={examLogic.exportExamToExcel}
            mainColor="indigo"
          />
          <ExamReviewModal
            isOpen={isReviewModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsReviewModalOpen(false)}
            examState={examState}
            mainColor="indigo"
          />
        </>
      );
    }
    
    if (examState.status === 'error') {
       return (
         <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-red-50 rounded-2xl border-2 border-red-200 p-6 text-center">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-red-700 mb-2">Lỗi Khởi tạo Kỳ thi</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-red-600 mb-6">Mạng không ổn định hoặc dữ liệu kỳ thi bị hỏng.</p>
            <button onClick={examLogic.quitExam} className="px-6 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md hover:bg-red-700">Quay lại Menu</button>
         </div>
       );
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. NHÁNH RENDER MINI-GAMES & BỘ ĐỊNH TUYẾN
  // ============================================================================
  
  // Đóng gói toàn bộ Props khổng lồ dùng chung cho 10 games
  const commonGameProps = {
    cards: cards,
    lang: lang,
    apiKey: state.apiKey,
    settings: settings,
    currentLevel: state.currentLevel,
    setCurrentLevel: setters.setCurrentLevel,
    currentTopic: state.currentTopic,
    setCurrentTopic: setters.setCurrentTopic,
    dataMode: state.dataMode,
    setDataMode: setters.setDataMode,
    gameSessions: gameSessions,
    setGameSessions: setters.setGameSessions,
    globalRetryBag: state.globalRetryBag,
    addToRetryBag: actions.addToRetryBag,
    removeFromRetryBag: actions.removeFromRetryBag,
    onLogWrong: actions.handleLogWrong,
    onSaveToHarvest: actions.handleSaveToHarvest,
    onOpenWordSelector: actions.handleOpenWordSelector,
    onOpenHanzi: actions.handleOpenHanzi,
    speak: actions.speak,
    isMuted: state.isMuted,
    onBack: () => setActiveGame(null),
    onMissingKey: actions.onMissingKey,
    setIsGamePlaying: actions.setIsGamePlaying,
    mainColor: mainColor,
    t: actions.t
  };

  switch (activeGame) {
    case 'quiz':
      return <QuizGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'match':
      return <MatchGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'scramble':
      return <ScrambleGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'fillblank':
      return <FillBlankGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'spotmistake':
      return <SpotMistakeGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'oddoneout':
      return <OddOneOutGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'imagequiz':
      return <ImageQuizGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'pronunciation':
      return <PronunciationGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'listening':
      return <ListeningGame {...commonGameProps} />;
    case 'reading':
      return <ReadingGame {...commonGameProps} />;
      
    default:
      // Màn hình Mặc định: Game Menu
      return (
        <GameMenu
          onSelectGame={(gameId) => setActiveGame(gameId)}
          onStartExam={examLogic?.startExam}
          onResumeExam={examLogic?.resumeExam}
          onOpenExamPoolManager={actions.handleOpenExamPoolManager}
          onOpenAiConfig={actions.handleOpenAiConfig}
          cardsCount={cards.length}
          lang={lang}
          currentLevel={state.currentLevel}
          setCurrentLevel={setters.setCurrentLevel}
          currentTopic={state.currentTopic}
          setCurrentTopic={setters.setCurrentTopic}
          gameSessions={gameSessions}
          mainColor={mainColor}
          t={actions.t}
        />
      );
  }
};

export default GameView;

/**
 * @file src/features/games/ImageQuizGame.jsx
 * @description Controller điều phối Mini-game Đoán Hình (Image Quiz) với QueueEngine, 2D Gatekeeper & Fallback.
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.18 (Image Quiz Game Logic)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { pullRetryCardWithLock } from '@/services/db';
import { QueueEngine } from '@/engines/queueEngine';
import { ExamEngine } from '@/engines/exam';
import { GameAlgoEngine } from '@/engines/gameOfflineEngine';
import { FallbackDataEngine } from '@/engines/fallbackData';
import { GlobalLoadingScreen } from '@/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen';

import {
  calculateGameScore,
  playGameSFX,
  handleExitDiscipline,
  normalizeLevelAndTopic,
  getConfiguredUiCooldown,
  applyAntiStreakShuffle
} from './common/gameHelpers';
import { GameSummaryScreen } from './common/GameSharedUI';
import { ImageQuizSetup, ImageQuizBoard } from './ImageQuizUI';

export const ImageQuizGame = ({
  cards = [],
  lang = 'en',
  apiKey = '',
  settings = {},
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode = 'vocab',
  setDataMode,
  gameSessions = {},
  setGameSessions,
  globalRetryBag = {},
  addToRetryBag,
  removeFromRetryBag,
  onLogWrong,
  onSaveToHarvest,
  onOpenWordSelector,
  onOpenHanzi,
  speak,
  isMuted = false,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  setIsGamePlaying,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  // ============================================================================
  // 1. STATE CẤU HÌNH & TRẠNG THÁI VÒNG ĐỜI GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(() => {
    const saved = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_imagequiz_config', {});
    return {
      sourceMode: cards.length >= 4 ? (saved.sourceMode || 'local') : 'ai',
      isEndless: saved.isEndless || false,
      totalQuestions: saved.totalQuestions || 20,
      timerEnabled: saved.timerEnabled !== false,
      timeLimit: saved.timeLimit || 20,
      autoSpeak: saved.autoSpeak !== false
    };
  });

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('setup'); // 'setup' | 'loading' | 'playing' | 'summary'
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [correctCount, setCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(null);
  const [cooldownLeft, setCooldownLeft] = useState(0);
  const [ammoCount, setAmmoCount] = useState(0);

  // State Bàn chơi hiện tại
  const [currentCard, setCurrentCard] = useState(null);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState(null);
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);
  const [wrongFeedback, setWrongFeedback] = useState(null);
  
  const [isExplaining, setIsExplaining] = useState(false);

  // Refs điều phối đa luồng & logic game
  const coordinatorRef = useRef(null);
  const usedTermsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(null);
  const streakTrackerRef = useRef([]); // Chống lặp vị trí đáp án

  // Lưu cấu hình khi thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_imagequiz_config', config);
  }, [config]);

  // Đồng bộ cờ đang chơi lên App
  useEffect(() => {
    if (setIsGamePlaying) {
      setIsGamePlaying(status === 'playing' || status === 'loading');
    }
    return () => {
      if (setIsGamePlaying) setIsGamePlaying(false);
    };
  }, [status, setIsGamePlaying]);

  // Quét số lượng đạn AI dự trữ mỗi 500ms
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current && coordinatorRef.current.queue) {
        const aiItems = coordinatorRef.current.queue.filter((b) => b && b.content && b.content.isAiGenerated);
        setAmmoCount(aiItems.length);
      } else {
        setAmmoCount(0);
      }
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  // Dọn dẹp khi unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. HÀM ĐÓNG GÓI BÀN CHƠI NGOẠI TUYẾN (LOCAL / FALLBACK BOARD BUILDER)
  // ============================================================================
  const buildLocalBoard = useCallback(() => {
    const validDeck = cards.filter((c) => c && c.term && c.definition);
    let selectedItem = null;

    // 1. Rút 1 thẻ từ Túi nháp lỗi sai
    const retryCard = pullRetryCardWithLock('imagequiz', globalRetryBag, lang);
    if (retryCard && retryCard.term && retryCard.definition) {
      selectedItem = retryCard;
    }

    // 2. Lấy thẻ chưa dùng trong bộ bài hiện tại
    if (!selectedItem) {
      let unusedPool = validDeck.filter((c) => !usedTermsRef.current.has(c.term));
      if (unusedPool.length === 0 && validDeck.length > 0) {
        usedTermsRef.current.clear();
        unusedPool = validDeck;
      }
      
      if (unusedPool.length > 0) {
        selectedItem = unusedPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * unusedPool.length)];
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback cứu hộ
    if (!selectedItem) {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const fallbackList = FallbackDataEngine.getGameReadyFallback('imagequiz', lang, pickedLevel, { dataMode });
      return fallbackList;
    }

    usedTermsRef.current.add(selectedItem.term || '');

    const type = Utils.detectSentence(selectedItem.term) ? 'sentence' : 'word';
    const correctOptText = selectedItem.definition;
    
    // Động cơ sinh đáp án nhiễu Offline
    let distTexts = [];
    if (GameAlgoEngine?.OptionsEngine?.offline_generateOptions) {
      try {
        distTexts = GameAlgoEngine.OptionsEngine.offline_generateOptions(correctOptText, validDeck, lang, type, 3, false);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("ImageQuiz Offline Option Generation Error:", e);
      }
    }
    
    if (!distTexts || distTexts.length < 3) {
      distTexts = ["Hình ảnh nhiễu 1", "Hình ảnh nhiễu 2", "Hình ảnh nhiễu 3"];
    }

    const correctOpt = { text: correctOptText, isCorrect: true };
    const distractors = distTexts.slice(0, 3).map(d => ({ text: d, isCorrect: false }));
    
    // Áp dụng thuật toán xáo trộn chống Streak
    let shuffledOptions = applyAntiStreakShuffle([...distractors, correctOpt], streakTrackerRef);
    
    // Gắn đường dẫn hình ảnh tìm kiếm từ Bing Image
    shuffledOptions = shuffledOptions.map(opt => {
        let query = opt.text + " isolated clipart";
        if (opt.isCorrect && selectedItem.image_keyword) {
            query = selectedItem.image_keyword + " isolated white background clipart";
        }
        return {
            ...opt,
            image: `https://tse4.mm.bing.net/th?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&w=300&h=300&c=7&rs=1&p=0`
        };
    });

    return {
      term: selectedItem.term,
      options: shuffledOptions,
      origin: selectedItem,
      isAiGenerated: false
    };
  }, [cards, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, globalRetryBag, lang]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 3. HÀM TẢI ĐẠN AI CHO QUEUE COORDINATOR
  // ============================================================================
  const fetchAiQuestion = useCallback(async () => {
    const { pickedLevel, pickedTopic } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(
      currentLevel,
      currentTopic,
      lang
    );

    const meta = {
      id: `imagequiz_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      type: 'image_quiz', // ExamEngine sẽ ánh xạ sang 'ioe_image_quiz'
      mode: 'minigame',
      lang,
      level: pickedLevel,
      topic: pickedTopic,
      dataMode
    };

    const hydrated = await ExamEngine.hydrateQuestion(meta, apiKey);
    if (hydrated && hydrated.content) {
      if (onSaveToHarvest && hydrated.isNewHarvest) {
        onSaveToHarvest(pickedLevel, hydrated.content.origin || hydrated.content);
      }
      return hydrated;
    }
    throw new Error('Dữ liệu ImageQuiz AI trả về rỗng.');
  }, [apiKey, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, lang, onSaveToHarvest]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 4. NẠP BÀN CHƠI MỚI & ĐỒNG HỒ ĐẾM NGƯỢC
  // ============================================================================
  const startCooldownIfNeeded = useCallback((isAiRound) => {
    if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    if (!isAiRound) {
      setCooldownLeft(0);
      return;
    }
    const cdSec = getConfiguredUiCooldown(9);
    setCooldownLeft(cdSec);
    cooldownRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCooldownLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  }, []);

  const loadQuestionBoard = useCallback(
    (targetIndex) => {
      let nextData = null;

      if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && coordinatorRef.current) {
        nextData = coordinatorRef.current.pop();
      }

      let qContent = null;
      if (nextData && nextData.content) {
        qContent = nextData.content;
      } else {
        if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && window.globalShowToast && targetIndex > 0) {
          window.globalShowToast('Đang dùng dữ liệu dự phòng trong lúc đợi AI nạp đạn...', 'warning');
        }
        qContent = buildLocalBoard();
      }
      
      // Đảm bảo Options được xáo trộn chuẩn chống Streak
      if (qContent && Array.isArray(qContent.options)) {
        qContent.options = applyAntiStreakShuffle(qContent.options, streakTrackerRef);
      }

      setCurrentCard(qContent);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setIsChecked(false);
      setWrongFeedback(null);
      setIsExplaining(false);
      
      if (config.autoSpeak && qContent && qContent.term && speak) {
        speak(qContent.term);
      }
      
      setTimeLeft(config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null);
      startCooldownIfNeeded(config.sourceMode === 'ai');
    },
    [buildLocalBoard, config.autoSpeak, config.sourceMode, config.timeLimit, config.timerEnabled, speak, startCooldownIfNeeded]
  );

  // Đồng hồ đếm ngược
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'playing' || !config.timerEnabled || isChecked || timeLeft === null) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev === null) return null;
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
          setStreak(0);
          setIsChecked(true);
          
          if (currentCard?.origin) {
            if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
            if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('imagequiz', currentCard.origin);
          }
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [status, config.timerEnabled, isChecked, timeLeft, isMuted, currentCard, onLogWrong, addToRetryBag]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 5. KHỞI ĐỘNG GAME & KHÔI PHỤC PHIÊN CHƠI
  // ============================================================================
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    usedTermsRef.current.clear();
    streakTrackerRef.current = [];
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setScore(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setCorrectCount(0);

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();

    if (config.sourceMode === 'ai') {
      coordinatorRef.current = QueueEngine.createQueueCoordinator(fetchAiQuestion, 4);
      setStatus('loading');
      coordinatorRef.current.maintain(true, 22000, false);
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleLoadingComplete = useCallback(() => {
    loadQuestionBoard(0);
    setStatus('playing');
  }, [loadQuestionBoard]);

  const handleResumeSession = () => {
    const saved = gameSessions?.imagequiz;
    if (!saved) return;

    if (saved.config) setConfig(saved.config);
    setCurrentIndex(saved.currentIndex || 0);
    setScore(saved.score || 0);
    setStreak(saved.streak || 0);
    setCorrectCount(saved.correctCount || 0);

    if (saved.currentCard) {
      setCurrentCard(saved.currentCard);
      setSelectedOption(saved.selectedOption || null);
      setIsChecked(saved.isChecked || false);
      setWrongFeedback(saved.wrongFeedback || null);
      setTimeLeft(saved.timeLeft ?? (config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null));
      setStatus('playing');
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(saved.currentIndex || 0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleClearSession = () => {
    if (setGameSessions) {
      setGameSessions((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next.imagequiz;
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 6. XỬ LÝ TƯƠNG TÁC (CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN)
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSelectOption = (opt) => {
    if (isChecked || !currentCard) return;

    setSelectedOption(opt);
    setIsChecked(true);

    const isCorrect = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';

    if (isCorrect) {
      playGameSFX('correct', isMuted);
      const nextStreak = streak + 1;
      const points = calculateGameScore(100, timeLeft || 0, nextStreak, 'normal');
      setStreak(nextStreak);
      setScore(prev => prev + points);
      setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1);
      
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term || '';
      if (removeFromRetryBag) removeFromRetryBag('imagequiz', targetTerm);
      
    } else {
      playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
      setStreak(0);
      if (currentCard.origin) {
        if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
        if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('imagequiz', currentCard.origin);
      }
      setWrongFeedback(currentCard.origin?.explanation || "Vui lòng xem lại nghĩa của từ vựng này.");
    }
  };

  const handleExplainGrammar = async () => {
    if (isExplaining) return;
    if (!apiKey) {
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Cần API Key để phân tích!", "warning");
      return;
    }

    setIsExplaining(true);
    try {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
      const res = await Utils.fillCardWithAi(targetTerm, lang, apiKey, ['analysis'], dataMode, [pickedLevel]);
      if (res && res.analysis) {
        setWrongFeedback(res.analysis);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Lỗi phân tích: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsExplaining(false);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 7. CHUYỂN CÂU & THOÁT GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    if (cooldownLeft > 0) return;

    if (!config.isEndless && currentIndex >= config.totalQuestions - 1) {
      handleClearSession();
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      setStatus('summary');
      return;
    }

    const nextIdx = currentIndex + 1;
    setCurrentIndex(nextIdx);
    loadQuestionBoard(nextIdx);
  };

  const handleExitGame = () => {
    if (status === 'playing' && !isChecked) {
      handleExitDiscipline({
        isPlaying: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        currentCard: currentCard?.origin || currentCard,
        gameType: 'imagequiz',
        onLogWrong,
        addToRetryBag
      });

      if (setGameSessions) {
        setGameSessions((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          imagequiz: {
            config,
            currentIndex,
            score,
            streak,
            correctCount,
            currentCard,
            selectedOption,
            isChecked,
            wrongFeedback,
            timeLeft,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          }
        }));
      }
    }

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
    setStatus('setup');
  };

  const handleSaveCurrentWord = () => {
    if (!onOpenWordSelector || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenWordSelector(targetTerm);
  };

  const handleOpenHanziCurrent = () => {
    if (!onOpenHanzi || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenHanzi(targetTerm);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 8. RENDER THEO TRẠNG THÁI
  // ============================================================================
  if (status === 'loading') {
    const { levelLabel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
    return (
      <GlobalLoadingScreen
        engine={coordinatorRef.current}
        onComplete={handleLoadingComplete}
        onCancel={() => {
          if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
          setStatus('setup');
        }}
        text="AI Đang Tạo Bàn Chơi Trực Quan..."
        subText="Đang tìm kiếm hình ảnh minh họa cho các đáp án nhiễu"
        mainColor={mainColor}
        levelStr={levelLabel}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'summary') {
    return (
      <GameSummaryScreen
        score={score}
        correctCount={correctCount}
        totalQuestions={currentIndex + 1}
        onRestart={handleStartGame}
        onBack={onBack}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'playing') {
    return (
      <ImageQuizBoard
        currentIndex={currentIndex}
        totalQuestions={config.totalQuestions}
        isEndless={config.isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={config.sourceMode === 'ai'}
        currentCard={currentCard}
        selectedOption={selectedOption}
        isChecked={isChecked}
        wrongFeedback={wrongFeedback}
        cooldownLeft={cooldownLeft}
        onSelectOption={handleSelectOption}
        onNextQuestion={handleNextQuestion}
        onExplainGrammar={handleExplainGrammar}
        onSpeak={speak}
        onSaveWord={handleSaveCurrentWord}
        onOpenHanzi={handleOpenHanziCurrent}
        onExit={handleExitGame}
        fontFamily={Utils.getFontFamily(settings)}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <ImageQuizSetup
      config={config}
      setConfig={setConfig}
      cardsCount={cards.length}
      lang={lang}
      currentLevel={currentLevel}
      setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
      currentTopic={currentTopic}
      setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
      dataMode={dataMode}
      setDataMode={setDataMode}
      savedSession={gameSessions?.imagequiz}
      onResumeSession={handleResumeSession}
      onClearSession={handleClearSession}
      onStartGame={handleStartGame}
      onBack={onBack}
      onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
      mainColor={mainColor}
      t={t}
    />
  );
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\ImageQuizUI.jsx
=========================================

/**
 * @file src/features/games/ImageQuizUI.jsx
 * @description Giao diện Setup & Bàn chơi của Mini-game Đoán Hình (Image Quiz).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.17 (Image Quiz UI)
 */

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { MenuToggle } from '@/components/common/Controls';
import {
  ResumeSessionBanner,
  SourceModeSelector,
  GameTopHUD
} from './common/GameSharedUI';

// Icon Hình ảnh nội bộ (phòng trường hợp Icons chung không có)
const LocalImageIcon = ({ size = 24, className = "" }) => (
  <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className={className}>
    <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"></circle>
    <polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21"></polyline>
  </svg>
);

// ============================================================================
// 1. MÀN HÌNH CÀI ĐẶT GAME ĐOÁN HÌNH (IMAGE QUIZ SETUP)
// ============================================================================
export const ImageQuizSetup = ({
  config,
  setConfig,
  cardsCount = 0,
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode,
  setDataMode,
  savedSession,
  onResumeSession,
  onClearSession,
  onStartGame,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const minRequiredCards = 4;
  const canStart = config.sourceMode === 'ai' || cardsCount >= minRequiredCards;

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-5 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar border-2 border-gray-100 animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* Header Setup */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-600 shadow-sm`}>
              <LocalImageIcon size={22} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-tight">
                Đoán Hình Trực Quan
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
                Chọn hình ảnh minh họa đúng nhất cho từ vựng
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-full transition-colors"
            title="Quay lại Menu Game"
          >
            <Icons.X size={22} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Banner Khôi phục phiên chơi cũ */}
        <ResumeSessionBanner
          savedSession={savedSession}
          onResume={onResumeSession}
          onClear={onClearSession}
          mainColor={mainColor}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Nguồn Dữ Liệu (Thẻ của tôi vs AI Tự Sinh) */}
        <SourceModeSelector
          sourceMode={config.sourceMode}
          setSourceMode={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, sourceMode: val }))}
          cardsCount={cardsCount}
          minCards={minRequiredCards}
          lang={lang}
          currentLevel={currentLevel}
          setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
          currentTopic={currentTopic}
          setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
          dataMode={dataMode}
          setDataMode={setDataMode}
          mainColor={mainColor}
          onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
          hideDataModeToggle={true} // Game này thường chỉ dùng cho từ vựng
        />

        {/* Các Tùy chọn Chế độ chơi */}
        <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
          {/* Chế độ Vô tận (Endless Mode) */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.isEndless}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, isEndless: val }))}
            icon={Icons.InfinityIcon}
            color={mainColor}
            title="Chế độ Vô tận (Endless)"
            subtitle={
              config.isEndless
                ? 'Chơi liên tục không giới hạn số câu'
                : `Chơi theo phiên (${config.totalQuestions || 20} câu)`
            }
          />

          {/* Giới hạn thời gian */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.timerEnabled}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, timerEnabled: val }))}
            icon={Icons.Clock}
            color="orange"
            title="Đếm ngược thời gian"
            subtitle={
              config.timerEnabled
                ? `Giới hạn ${config.timeLimit || 20} giây mỗi câu`
                : 'Tắt đồng hồ đếm ngược'
            }
          />
          
          {/* Nút phát âm (Auto Speak) */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.autoSpeak}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, autoSpeak: val }))}
            icon={Icons.Volume2}
            color="blue"
            title="Phát âm tự động"
            subtitle="Đọc từ khóa ngay khi hiển thị câu hỏi"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Bắt đầu */}
      <div className="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
        {!canStart && (
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-red-500 text-center mb-2">
            ⚠️ Cần tối thiểu {minRequiredCards} thẻ để chơi hoặc chuyển sang chế độ AI Tự Sinh!
          </p>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={onStartGame}
          disabled={!canStart}
          className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base ${
            canStart
              ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 shadow-${mainColor}-200`
              : 'bg-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'
          }`}
        >
          <Icons.Play size={20} fill="currentColor" /> BẮT ĐẦU ĐOÁN HÌNH
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// 2. BÀN CHƠI ĐOÁN HÌNH (IMAGE QUIZ BOARD)
// ============================================================================
export const ImageQuizBoard = ({
  currentIndex = 0,
  totalQuestions = 20,
  isEndless = false,
  score = 0,
  streak = 0,
  timeLeft = null,
  ammoCount = 0,
  isAiSource = false,
  currentCard = null,
  selectedOption = null,
  isChecked = false,
  wrongFeedback = null,
  cooldownLeft = 0,
  onSelectOption,
  onNextQuestion,
  onExplainGrammar,
  onSpeak,
  onSaveWord,
  onOpenHanzi,
  onExit,
  fontFamily = 'inherit',
  lang = 'en',
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const questionData = currentCard?.origin || currentCard?.question || currentCard || {};
  const options = currentCard?.options || [];
  
  // Xác định text câu hỏi
  let questionText = questionData.term || questionData.definition;
  if (currentCard?.term) questionText = currentCard.term;
  if (!questionText) questionText = "Câu hỏi bị lỗi";

  // Phím tắt bàn phím (1, 2, 3, 4)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (isChecked) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && cooldownLeft === 0) {
          onNextQuestion();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const key = parseInt(e.key, 10);
      if (!isNaN(key) && key >= 1 && key <= options.length) {
        onSelectOption(options[key - 1]);
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isChecked, cooldownLeft, onNextQuestion, onSelectOption, options]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between border-2 border-gray-100 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in">
      {/* Thanh Top HUD Dùng chung */}
      <GameTopHUD
        onExit={onExit}
        currentRound={currentIndex + 1}
        maxRounds={totalQuestions}
        isEndless={isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={isAiSource}
        onSaveWord={onSaveWord}
        onOpenHanzi={onOpenHanzi}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
      />

      {/* Khu vực Câu hỏi */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar space-y-4 pr-1 my-1 flex flex-col">
        <div className={`shrink-0 min-h-[90px] p-4 rounded-2xl bg-${mainColor}-50/50 border border-${mainColor}-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative text-center`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-1 absolute top-2">
            Tìm hình ảnh cho từ này
          </div>
          
          <div 
            style={{ fontFamily }}
            className="text-xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words mt-3"
          >
            {questionText}
          </div>
          
          {onSpeak && questionData.term && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSpeak(questionText)}
              className={`absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-2 rounded-full bg-white text-${mainColor}-600 border border-${mainColor}-200 shadow-sm hover:bg-${mainColor}-50 transition-all active:scale-95`}
              title="Nghe phát âm"
            >
              <Icons.Volume2 size={16} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Khối Đáp án Hình ảnh (Grid 2x2) */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 shrink-0 flex-1 content-center">
          {options.map((opt, idx) => {
            const isCorrectOption = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';
            const isSelected = selectedOption === opt;
            
            let btnStyle = `bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 hover:border-${mainColor}-400 hover:bg-${mainColor}-50/20`;
            let imgStyle = `opacity-90`;
            
            if (isChecked) {
              if (isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-green-50 border-green-500 shadow-md scale-[1.02] z-10';
                imgStyle = 'opacity-100';
              } else if (isSelected && !isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-red-50 border-red-500 shadow-md animate-shake';
                imgStyle = 'opacity-80 grayscale';
              } else {
                btnStyle = 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 opacity-60 scale-95';
                imgStyle = 'opacity-40 grayscale';
              }
            } else if (isSelected) {
              btnStyle = `bg-${mainColor}-50 border-${mainColor}-500 ring-2 ring-${mainColor}-200 shadow-sm`;
              imgStyle = 'opacity-100';
            }

            const OptionIcon = isChecked && isCorrectOption ? Icons.CheckCircle : (isChecked && isSelected ? Icons.X : null);
            const iconColor = isCorrectOption ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600';

            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                type="button"
                disabled={isChecked}
                onClick={() => onSelectOption(opt)}
                className={`relative aspect-square p-2 sm:p-3 rounded-2xl border-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 overflow-hidden group ${btnStyle}`}
              >
                {/* Chỉ mục bàn phím */}
                <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black bg-white/80 rounded border border-gray-200 text-gray-500 z-10 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-sm">
                  {idx + 1}
                </span>
                
                {/* Hình ảnh */}
                <div className="w-full h-full relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white flex items-center justify-center">
                   {opt.image ? (
                     <img 
                       src={opt.image} 
                       alt={opt.text} 
                       className={`w-full h-full object-contain p-2 transition-all duration-300 group-hover:scale-105 ${imgStyle}`}
                       onError={(e) => { 
                         e.target.style.display = 'none'; 
                         e.target.nextSibling.style.display = 'flex'; 
                       }} 
                     />
                   ) : null}
                   
                   {/* Fallback khi không có ảnh hoặc ảnh lỗi */}
                   <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-100 text-gray-400" style={{ display: opt.image ? 'none' : 'flex' }}>
                      <LocalImageIcon size={32} className="opacity-30 mb-1" />
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">No Image</span>
                   </div>
                </div>
                
                {/* Nhãn text hiển thị sau khi chọn hoặc hover */}
                <div className={`absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm p-1.5 sm:p-2 border-t border-gray-100 text-center transition-transform duration-300 ${isChecked || isSelected ? 'translate-y-0' : 'translate-y-full group-hover:translate-y-0'}`}>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: (isChecked && isCorrectOption) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }} className={`text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold truncate block px-1 ${isChecked && isCorrectOption ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
                        {opt.text}
                    </span>
                </div>
                
                {/* Icon Kết quả */}
                {OptionIcon && (
                  <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm z-10">
                    <OptionIcon size={24} className={iconColor} />
                  </div>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        
        {/* Khối Giải thích / Feedback */}
        {isChecked && (
          <div className="animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 shrink-0">
             <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-2 ${
                selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true'
                  ? 'bg-green-50/80 border-green-200 text-green-900'
                  : 'bg-red-50/80 border-red-200 text-red-900'
              }`}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? (
                      <>
                        <Icons.CheckCircle size={18} className="text-green-600" />
                        <span>Chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Icons.AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600" />
                        <span>Chưa chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Nút giải thích ngữ pháp */}
                  {onExplainGrammar && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={onExplainGrammar}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white/60 hover:bg-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <Icons.Sparkles size={13} className="text-purple-600" /> Giải thích
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                
                {/* Nội dung giải thích có sẵn từ thẻ */}
                {(questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback) && (
                  <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed bg-white/70 p-3 rounded-lg border border-black/5 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                    {questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback}
                  </div>
                )}
             </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Tiếp theo */}
      <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0 h-[60px]">
        {isChecked ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNextQuestion}
            disabled={cooldownLeft > 0}
            className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm sm:text-base ${
              cooldownLeft > 0
                ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-wait'
                : `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700`
            }`}
          >
            <span>
              {cooldownLeft > 0
                ? `Đợi nạp đạn (${cooldownLeft}s)...`
                : 'Câu tiếp theo (Enter)'}
            </span>
            <Icons.ChevronRight size={20} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 select-none">
            Chọn 1 hình ảnh để tiếp tục
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const ImageQuizUI = {
  ImageQuizSetup,
  ImageQuizBoard
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\ListeningGame.jsx
