/**
 * @file src/features/games/PronunciationUI.jsx
 * @description Giao diện Setup & Bàn chơi của Mini-game Vua Ngữ Âm (Pronunciation Game).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.19 (Pronunciation UI)
 */

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { MenuToggle } from '@/components/common/Controls';
import {
  ResumeSessionBanner,
  SourceModeSelector,
  GameTopHUD
} from './common/GameSharedUI';

// ============================================================================
// 1. MÀN HÌNH CÀI ĐẶT GAME VUA NGỮ ÂM (PRONUNCIATION SETUP)
// ============================================================================
export const PronunciationSetup = ({
  config,
  setConfig,
  cardsCount = 0,
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode,
  setDataMode,
  savedSession,
  onResumeSession,
  onClearSession,
  onStartGame,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const minRequiredCards = 4;
  const canStart = config.sourceMode === 'ai' || cardsCount >= minRequiredCards;

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-5 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar border-2 border-gray-100 animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* Header Setup */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-600 shadow-sm`}>
              <Icons.Mic size={22} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-tight">
                Vua Ngữ Âm
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
                Tìm từ có cách phát âm khác biệt
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-full transition-colors"
            title="Quay lại Menu Game"
          >
            <Icons.X size={22} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Banner Khôi phục phiên chơi cũ */}
        <ResumeSessionBanner
          savedSession={savedSession}
          onResume={onResumeSession}
          onClear={onClearSession}
          mainColor={mainColor}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Nguồn Dữ Liệu (Thẻ của tôi vs AI Tự Sinh) */}
        <SourceModeSelector
          sourceMode={config.sourceMode}
          setSourceMode={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, sourceMode: val }))}
          cardsCount={cardsCount}
          minCards={minRequiredCards}
          lang={lang}
          currentLevel={currentLevel}
          setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
          currentTopic={currentTopic}
          setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
          dataMode={dataMode}
          setDataMode={setDataMode}
          mainColor={mainColor}
          onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
        />

        {/* Các Tùy chọn Chế độ chơi */}
        <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
          {/* Chế độ Vô tận (Endless Mode) */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.isEndless}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, isEndless: val }))}
            icon={Icons.InfinityIcon}
            color={mainColor}
            title="Chế độ Vô tận (Endless)"
            subtitle={
              config.isEndless
                ? 'Chơi liên tục không giới hạn số câu'
                : `Chơi theo phiên (${config.totalQuestions || 20} câu)`
            }
          />

          {/* Giới hạn thời gian */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.timerEnabled}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, timerEnabled: val }))}
            icon={Icons.Clock}
            color="orange"
            title="Đếm ngược thời gian"
            subtitle={
              config.timerEnabled
                ? `Giới hạn ${config.timeLimit || 20} giây mỗi câu`
                : 'Tắt đồng hồ đếm ngược'
            }
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Bắt đầu */}
      <div className="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
        {!canStart && (
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-red-500 text-center mb-2">
            ⚠️ Cần tối thiểu {minRequiredCards} thẻ để chơi hoặc chuyển sang chế độ AI Tự Sinh!
          </p>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={onStartGame}
          disabled={!canStart}
          className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base ${
            canStart
              ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 shadow-${mainColor}-200`
              : 'bg-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'
          }`}
        >
          <Icons.Play size={20} fill="currentColor" /> BẮT ĐẦU CHƠI
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// 2. BÀN CHƠI NGỮ ÂM (PRONUNCIATION BOARD)
// ============================================================================
export const PronunciationBoard = ({
  currentIndex = 0,
  totalQuestions = 20,
  isEndless = false,
  score = 0,
  streak = 0,
  timeLeft = null,
  ammoCount = 0,
  isAiSource = false,
  currentCard = null,
  selectedOption = null,
  isChecked = false,
  cooldownLeft = 0,
  onSelectOption,
  onNextQuestion,
  onSpeak,
  onSaveWord,
  onOpenHanzi,
  onExit,
  fontFamily = 'inherit',
  lang = 'en',
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const questionData = currentCard || {};
  const options = Array.isArray(questionData.options) ? questionData.options : [];
  
  // Xác định text câu hỏi
  let questionText = questionData.term;
  if (!questionText) questionText = "Câu hỏi bị lỗi";

  // Phím tắt bàn phím (1, 2, 3, 4)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (isChecked) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && cooldownLeft === 0) {
          onNextQuestion();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const key = parseInt(e.key, 10);
      if (!isNaN(key) && key >= 1 && key <= options.length) {
        onSelectOption(options[key - 1]);
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isChecked, cooldownLeft, onNextQuestion, onSelectOption, options]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between border-2 border-gray-100 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in">
      {/* Thanh Top HUD Dùng chung */}
      <GameTopHUD
        onExit={onExit}
        currentRound={currentIndex + 1}
        maxRounds={totalQuestions}
        isEndless={isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={isAiSource}
        onSaveWord={onSaveWord}
        onOpenHanzi={onOpenHanzi}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
      />

      {/* Khu vực Câu hỏi */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar space-y-4 pr-1 my-1 flex flex-col">
        <div className={`shrink-0 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-${mainColor}-50/50 border border-${mainColor}-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center`}>
          <div className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Icons.Mic size={16} className={`text-${mainColor}-500`} />
            Chọn từ có phần phát âm khác với các từ còn lại
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Khối Đáp án */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 shrink-0 flex-1 content-center">
          {options.map((opt, idx) => {
            const isCorrectOption = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';
            const isSelected = selectedOption === opt;
            
            let btnStyle = `bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:border-${mainColor}-400 hover:bg-${mainColor}-50/40`;
            
            if (isChecked) {
              if (isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-green-500 border-green-600 text-white shadow-md scale-[1.02] z-10';
              } else if (isSelected && !isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-red-500 border-red-600 text-white shadow-md animate-shake';
              } else {
                btnStyle = 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 opacity-60 scale-95';
              }
            } else if (isSelected) {
              btnStyle = `bg-${mainColor}-100 border-${mainColor}-500 text-${mainColor}-800 ring-2 ring-${mainColor}-200`;
            }

            const OptionIcon = isChecked && isCorrectOption ? Icons.CheckCircle : (isChecked && isSelected ? Icons.X : null);

            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                type="button"
                disabled={isChecked}
                onClick={() => onSelectOption(opt)}
                style={{ fontFamily: (isChecked && isCorrectOption) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }}
                className={`relative min-h-[80px] p-4 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-lg sm:text-xl text-center flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 break-words ${btnStyle}`}
              >
                <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 text-[10px] opacity-50 font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-current">
                  {idx + 1}
                </span>
                
                <span className="px-6">{opt.text}</span>
                
                {OptionIcon && (
                  <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
                    <OptionIcon size={20} className={isCorrectOption ? 'text-white' : 'text-white'} />
                  </span>
                )}

                {/* Nút nghe nhanh */}
                {onSpeak && !isChecked && (
                    <div
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        onSpeak(opt.text);
                      }}
                      className={`absolute right-3 top-3 p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors ${isSelected ? `text-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-200` : 'text-gray-400'}`}
                      title="Nghe phát âm"
                    >
                      <Icons.Volume2 size={16} />
                    </div>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        
        {/* Khối Giải thích / Feedback */}
        {isChecked && (
          <div className="animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 shrink-0">
             <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-2 ${
                selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true'
                  ? 'bg-green-50/80 border-green-200 text-green-900'
                  : 'bg-red-50/80 border-red-200 text-red-900'
              }`}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? (
                      <>
                        <Icons.CheckCircle size={18} className="text-green-600" />
                        <span>Chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Icons.AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600" />
                        <span>Chưa chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                {/* Nội dung giải thích có sẵn từ thẻ */}
                {(questionData.explanation || questionData.definition) && (
                  <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed bg-white/70 p-3 rounded-lg border border-black/5 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                    <div className="font-black opacity-60 mb-1 uppercase text-[10px]">Giải thích:</div>
                    {questionData.explanation || questionData.definition}
                  </div>
                )}
             </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Tiếp theo */}
      <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0 h-[60px]">
        {isChecked ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNextQuestion}
            disabled={cooldownLeft > 0}
            className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm sm:text-base ${
              cooldownLeft > 0
                ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-wait'
                : `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700`
            }`}
          >
            <span>
              {cooldownLeft > 0
                ? `Đợi nạp đạn (${cooldownLeft}s)...`
                : 'Câu tiếp theo (Enter)'}
            </span>
            <Icons.ChevronRight size={20} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 select-none">
            Chọn 1 đáp án để tiếp tục
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const PronunciationUI = {
  PronunciationSetup,
  PronunciationBoard
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\QuizGame.jsx
=========================================

/**
 * @file src/features/games/QuizGame.jsx
 * @description Controller điều phối Mini-game Trắc Nghiệm (Quiz Game) với QueueEngine, 2D Gatekeeper & Fallback.
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.6 (Quiz Game Logic)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { pullRetryCardWithLock } from '@/services/db';
import { QueueEngine } from '@/engines/queueEngine';
import { ExamEngine } from '@/engines/exam';
import { GameAlgoEngine } from '@/engines/gameOfflineEngine';
import { FallbackDataEngine } from '@/engines/fallbackData';
import { GlobalLoadingScreen } from '@/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen';

import {
  calculateGameScore,
  playGameSFX,
  handleExitDiscipline,
  normalizeLevelAndTopic,
  getConfiguredUiCooldown,
  applyAntiStreakShuffle
} from './common/gameHelpers';
import { GameSummaryScreen } from './common/GameSharedUI';
import { QuizSetup, QuizBoard } from './QuizUI';

export const QuizGame = ({
  cards = [],
  lang = 'en',
  apiKey = '',
  settings = {},
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode = 'vocab',
  setDataMode,
  gameSessions = {},
  setGameSessions,
  globalRetryBag = {},
  addToRetryBag,
  removeFromRetryBag,
  onLogWrong,
  onSaveToHarvest,
  onOpenWordSelector,
  onOpenHanzi,
  speak,
  isMuted = false,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  setIsGamePlaying,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  // ============================================================================
  // 1. STATE CẤU HÌNH & TRẠNG THÁI VÒNG ĐỜI GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(() => {
    const saved = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_quiz_config', {});
    return {
      sourceMode: cards.length >= 4 ? (saved.sourceMode || 'local') : 'ai',
      difficulty: saved.difficulty || 'normal', // Khảo sát tùy chọn
      askMode: saved.askMode || 'term', // 'term' | 'def'
      grammarId: saved.grammarId || '',
      isEndless: saved.isEndless || false,
      totalQuestions: saved.totalQuestions || 20,
      timerEnabled: saved.timerEnabled !== false,
      timeLimit: saved.timeLimit || 20,
      autoSpeak: saved.autoSpeak !== false
    };
  });

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('setup'); // 'setup' | 'loading' | 'playing' | 'summary'
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [correctCount, setCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(null);
  const [cooldownLeft, setCooldownLeft] = useState(0);
  const [ammoCount, setAmmoCount] = useState(0);

  // State Bàn chơi hiện tại
  const [currentCard, setCurrentCard] = useState(null);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState(null);
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);
  const [wrongFeedback, setWrongFeedback] = useState(null);
  
  const [isExplaining, setIsExplaining] = useState(false);

  // Refs điều phối đa luồng & logic game
  const coordinatorRef = useRef(null);
  const usedTermsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(null);
  const streakTrackerRef = useRef([]); // Chống lặp vị trí đáp án

  // Lưu cấu hình khi thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_quiz_config', config);
  }, [config]);

  // Đồng bộ cờ đang chơi lên App
  useEffect(() => {
    if (setIsGamePlaying) {
      setIsGamePlaying(status === 'playing' || status === 'loading');
    }
    return () => {
      if (setIsGamePlaying) setIsGamePlaying(false);
    };
  }, [status, setIsGamePlaying]);

  // Quét số lượng đạn AI dự trữ mỗi 500ms
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current && coordinatorRef.current.queue) {
        const aiItems = coordinatorRef.current.queue.filter((b) => b && b.content && b.content.isAiGenerated);
        setAmmoCount(aiItems.length);
      } else {
        setAmmoCount(0);
      }
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  // Dọn dẹp khi unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. HÀM ĐÓNG GÓI BÀN CHƠI NGOẠI TUYẾN (LOCAL / FALLBACK BOARD BUILDER)
  // ============================================================================
  const buildLocalBoard = useCallback(() => {
    const validDeck = cards.filter((c) => c && c.term && c.definition);
    let selectedItem = null;

    // 1. Rút 1 thẻ từ Túi nháp lỗi sai
    const retryCard = pullRetryCardWithLock('quiz', globalRetryBag, lang);
    if (retryCard && retryCard.term && retryCard.definition) {
      selectedItem = retryCard;
    }

    // 2. Lấy thẻ chưa dùng trong bộ bài hiện tại
    if (!selectedItem) {
      let unusedPool = validDeck.filter((c) => !usedTermsRef.current.has(c.term));
      if (unusedPool.length === 0 && validDeck.length > 0) {
        usedTermsRef.current.clear();
        unusedPool = validDeck;
      }
      
      if (unusedPool.length > 0) {
        selectedItem = unusedPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * unusedPool.length)];
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback cứu hộ
    if (!selectedItem) {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const fallbackList = FallbackDataEngine.getGameReadyFallback('quiz', lang, pickedLevel, { dataMode, isReverse: config.askMode === 'def' });
      return fallbackList;
    }

    usedTermsRef.current.add(selectedItem.term || '');

    const isReverse = config.askMode === 'def';
    const type = Utils.detectSentence(selectedItem.term) ? 'sentence' : 'word';
    const correctOptText = isReverse ? selectedItem.term : selectedItem.definition;
    
    // Động cơ sinh đáp án nhiễu Offline (Sử dụng GameAlgoEngine)
    let distTexts = [];
    if (GameAlgoEngine?.OptionsEngine?.offline_generateOptions) {
      try {
        distTexts = GameAlgoEngine.OptionsEngine.offline_generateOptions(correctOptText, validDeck, lang, type, 3, isReverse);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Quiz Offline Option Generation Error:", e);
      }
    }
    
    // Fallback mảng nhiễu nếu thuật toán trên thất bại
    if (!distTexts || distTexts.length < 3) {
      distTexts = ["Đáp án nhiễu 1", "Đáp án nhiễu 2", "Đáp án nhiễu 3"];
    }

    const correctOpt = { text: correctOptText, isCorrect: true };
    const distractors = distTexts.slice(0, 3).map(d => ({ text: d, isCorrect: false }));
    
    // Áp dụng thuật toán xáo trộn chống Streak
    const shuffledOptions = applyAntiStreakShuffle([...distractors, correctOpt], streakTrackerRef);

    return {
      term: isReverse ? selectedItem.definition : selectedItem.term,
      options: shuffledOptions,
      origin: selectedItem,
      isAiGenerated: false
    };
  }, [cards, config.askMode, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, globalRetryBag, lang]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 3. HÀM TẢI ĐẠN AI CHO QUEUE COORDINATOR
  // ============================================================================
  const fetchAiQuestion = useCallback(async () => {
    const { pickedLevel, pickedTopic } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(
      currentLevel,
      currentTopic,
      lang
    );

    const meta = {
      id: `quiz_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      type: 'quiz', // ExamEngine sẽ ánh xạ sang 'vocab_mcq' hoặc 'grammar_mcq'
      mode: 'minigame',
      lang,
      level: pickedLevel,
      topic: pickedTopic,
      difficulty: config.difficulty,
      askMode: config.askMode,
      grammarId: config.grammarId,
      dataMode
    };

    const hydrated = await ExamEngine.hydrateQuestion(meta, apiKey);
    if (hydrated && hydrated.content) {
      if (onSaveToHarvest && hydrated.isNewHarvest) {
        onSaveToHarvest(pickedLevel, hydrated.content.origin || hydrated.content);
      }
      return hydrated;
    }
    throw new Error('Dữ liệu Quiz AI trả về rỗng.');
  }, [apiKey, config.askMode, config.difficulty, config.grammarId, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, lang, onSaveToHarvest]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 4. NẠP BÀN CHƠI MỚI & ĐỒNG HỒ ĐẾM NGƯỢC
  // ============================================================================
  const startCooldownIfNeeded = useCallback((isAiRound) => {
    if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    if (!isAiRound) {
      setCooldownLeft(0);
      return;
    }
    const cdSec = getConfiguredUiCooldown(9);
    setCooldownLeft(cdSec);
    cooldownRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCooldownLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  }, []);

  const loadQuestionBoard = useCallback(
    (targetIndex) => {
      let nextData = null;

      if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && coordinatorRef.current) {
        nextData = coordinatorRef.current.pop();
      }

      let qContent = null;
      if (nextData && nextData.content) {
        qContent = nextData.content;
      } else {
        if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && window.globalShowToast && targetIndex > 0) {
          window.globalShowToast('Đang dùng dữ liệu dự phòng trong lúc đợi AI nạp đạn...', 'warning');
        }
        qContent = buildLocalBoard();
      }
      
      // Đảm bảo Options được xáo trộn chuẩn chống Streak
      if (qContent && Array.isArray(qContent.options)) {
        qContent.options = applyAntiStreakShuffle(qContent.options, streakTrackerRef);
      }

      setCurrentCard(qContent);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setIsChecked(false);
      setWrongFeedback(null);
      setIsExplaining(false);
      
      if (config.autoSpeak && qContent && qContent.term && speak) {
        speak(qContent.term);
      }
      
      setTimeLeft(config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null);
      startCooldownIfNeeded(config.sourceMode === 'ai');
    },
    [buildLocalBoard, config.autoSpeak, config.sourceMode, config.timeLimit, config.timerEnabled, speak, startCooldownIfNeeded]
  );

  // Đồng hồ đếm ngược
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'playing' || !config.timerEnabled || isChecked || timeLeft === null) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev === null) return null;
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
          setStreak(0);
          setIsChecked(true);
          
          if (currentCard?.origin) {
            if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
            if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('quiz', currentCard.origin);
          }
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [status, config.timerEnabled, isChecked, timeLeft, isMuted, currentCard, onLogWrong, addToRetryBag]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 5. KHỞI ĐỘNG GAME & KHÔI PHỤC PHIÊN CHƠI
  // ============================================================================
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    usedTermsRef.current.clear();
    streakTrackerRef.current = [];
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setScore(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setCorrectCount(0);

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();

    if (config.sourceMode === 'ai') {
      coordinatorRef.current = QueueEngine.createQueueCoordinator(fetchAiQuestion, 4);
      setStatus('loading');
      coordinatorRef.current.maintain(true, 22000, false);
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleLoadingComplete = useCallback(() => {
    loadQuestionBoard(0);
    setStatus('playing');
  }, [loadQuestionBoard]);

  const handleResumeSession = () => {
    const saved = gameSessions?.quiz;
    if (!saved) return;

    if (saved.config) setConfig(saved.config);
    setCurrentIndex(saved.currentIndex || 0);
    setScore(saved.score || 0);
    setStreak(saved.streak || 0);
    setCorrectCount(saved.correctCount || 0);

    if (saved.currentCard) {
      setCurrentCard(saved.currentCard);
      setSelectedOption(saved.selectedOption || null);
      setIsChecked(saved.isChecked || false);
      setWrongFeedback(saved.wrongFeedback || null);
      setTimeLeft(saved.timeLeft ?? (config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null));
      setStatus('playing');
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(saved.currentIndex || 0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleClearSession = () => {
    if (setGameSessions) {
      setGameSessions((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next.quiz;
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 6. XỬ LÝ TƯƠNG TÁC (CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN)
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSelectOption = (opt) => {
    if (isChecked || !currentCard) return;

    setSelectedOption(opt);
    setIsChecked(true);

    const isCorrect = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';

    if (isCorrect) {
      playGameSFX('correct', isMuted);
      const nextStreak = streak + 1;
      const points = calculateGameScore(100, timeLeft || 0, nextStreak, config.difficulty);
      setStreak(nextStreak);
      setScore(prev => prev + points);
      setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1);
      
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term || '';
      if (removeFromRetryBag) removeFromRetryBag('quiz', targetTerm);
      
      if (config.autoSpeak && speak) {
        speak(opt.text);
      }
    } else {
      playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
      setStreak(0);
      if (currentCard.origin) {
        if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
        if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('quiz', currentCard.origin);
      }
      setWrongFeedback(currentCard.origin?.explanation || "Hãy xem kỹ lại phân tích ngữ pháp.");
    }
  };

  const handleExplainGrammar = async () => {
    if (isExplaining) return;
    if (!apiKey) {
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Cần API Key để phân tích!", "warning");
      return;
    }

    setIsExplaining(true);
    try {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
      const res = await Utils.fillCardWithAi(targetTerm, lang, apiKey, ['analysis'], dataMode, [pickedLevel]);
      if (res && res.analysis) {
        setWrongFeedback(res.analysis);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Lỗi phân tích: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsExplaining(false);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 7. CHUYỂN CÂU & THOÁT GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    if (cooldownLeft > 0) return;

    if (!config.isEndless && currentIndex >= config.totalQuestions - 1) {
      handleClearSession();
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      setStatus('summary');
      return;
    }

    const nextIdx = currentIndex + 1;
    setCurrentIndex(nextIdx);
    loadQuestionBoard(nextIdx);
  };

  const handleExitGame = () => {
    if (status === 'playing' && !isChecked) {
      handleExitDiscipline({
        isPlaying: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        currentCard: currentCard?.origin || currentCard,
        gameType: 'quiz',
        onLogWrong,
        addToRetryBag
      });

      if (setGameSessions) {
        setGameSessions((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          quiz: {
            config,
            currentIndex,
            score,
            streak,
            correctCount,
            currentCard,
            selectedOption,
            isChecked,
            wrongFeedback,
            timeLeft,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          }
        }));
      }
    }

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
    setStatus('setup');
  };

  const handleSaveCurrentWord = () => {
    if (!onOpenWordSelector || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenWordSelector(targetTerm);
  };

  const handleOpenHanziCurrent = () => {
    if (!onOpenHanzi || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenHanzi(targetTerm);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 8. RENDER THEO TRẠNG THÁI
  // ============================================================================
  if (status === 'loading') {
    const { levelLabel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
    return (
      <GlobalLoadingScreen
        engine={coordinatorRef.current}
        onComplete={handleLoadingComplete}
        onCancel={() => {
          if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
          setStatus('setup');
        }}
        text="AI Đang Tạo Câu Hỏi Trắc Nghiệm..."
        subText="Đang chắt lọc từ vựng và thiết kế đáp án nhiễu"
        mainColor={mainColor}
        levelStr={levelLabel}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'summary') {
    return (
      <GameSummaryScreen
        score={score}
        correctCount={correctCount}
        totalQuestions={currentIndex + 1}
        onRestart={handleStartGame}
        onBack={onBack}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'playing') {
    return (
      <QuizBoard
        currentIndex={currentIndex}
        totalQuestions={config.totalQuestions}
        isEndless={config.isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={config.sourceMode === 'ai'}
        currentCard={currentCard}
        selectedOption={selectedOption}
        isChecked={isChecked}
        wrongFeedback={wrongFeedback}
        cooldownLeft={cooldownLeft}
        onSelectOption={handleSelectOption}
        onNextQuestion={handleNextQuestion}
        onExplainGrammar={handleExplainGrammar}
        onSpeak={speak}
        onSaveWord={handleSaveCurrentWord}
        onOpenHanzi={handleOpenHanziCurrent}
        onExit={handleExitGame}
        fontFamily={Utils.getFontFamily(settings)}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <QuizSetup
      config={config}
      setConfig={setConfig}
      cardsCount={cards.length}
      lang={lang}
      currentLevel={currentLevel}
      setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
      currentTopic={currentTopic}
      setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
      dataMode={dataMode}
      setDataMode={setDataMode}
      savedSession={gameSessions?.quiz}
      onResumeSession={handleResumeSession}
      onClearSession={handleClearSession}
      onStartGame={handleStartGame}
      onBack={onBack}
      onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
      mainColor={mainColor}
      t={t}
    />
  );
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\QuizUI.jsx

/**
 * @file src/features/games/QuizUI.jsx
 * @description Giao diện Setup & Bàn chơi của Mini-game Trắc Nghiệm (Quiz Game).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.5 (Quiz UI)
 */

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { MenuToggle } from '@/components/common/Controls';
import {
  ResumeSessionBanner,
  SourceModeSelector,
  GrammarTrapSelector,
  GameTopHUD
} from './common/GameSharedUI';

// ============================================================================
// 1. MÀN HÌNH CÀI ĐẶT GAME TRẮC NGHIỆM (QUIZ SETUP)
// ============================================================================
export const QuizSetup = ({
  config,
  setConfig,
  cardsCount = 0,
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode,
  setDataMode,
  savedSession,
  onResumeSession,
  onClearSession,
  onStartGame,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const minRequiredCards = 4;
  const canStart = config.sourceMode === 'ai' || cardsCount >= minRequiredCards;

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-5 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar border-2 border-gray-100 animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* Header Setup */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-600 shadow-sm`}>
              <Icons.Layers size={22} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-tight">
                {t ? t('modeQuiz') || 'Trắc Nghiệm 4 Đáp Án' : 'Trắc Nghiệm 4 Đáp Án'}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
                {t ? t('descQuiz') || 'Chọn đáp án chính xác nhất' : 'Chọn đáp án chính xác nhất'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-full transition-colors"
            title="Quay lại Menu Game"
          >
            <Icons.X size={22} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Banner Khôi phục phiên chơi cũ */}
        <ResumeSessionBanner
          savedSession={savedSession}
          onResume={onResumeSession}
          onClear={onClearSession}
          mainColor={mainColor}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Nguồn Dữ Liệu (Thẻ của tôi vs AI Tự Sinh) */}
        <SourceModeSelector
          sourceMode={config.sourceMode}
          setSourceMode={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, sourceMode: val }))}
          cardsCount={cardsCount}
          minCards={minRequiredCards}
          lang={lang}
          currentLevel={currentLevel}
          setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
          currentTopic={currentTopic}
          setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
          dataMode={dataMode}
          setDataMode={setDataMode}
          mainColor={mainColor}
          onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Chuyên đề Bẫy Ngữ pháp (Khi dùng AI hoặc chế độ Khó) */}
        {(config.sourceMode === 'ai' || config.difficulty === 'hard') && (
          <GrammarTrapSelector
            gameType="quiz"
            lang={lang}
            currentLevel={currentLevel}
            selectedTrap={config.grammarId}
            onSelectTrap={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, grammarId: val }))}
            mainColor={mainColor}
          />
        )}

        {/* Các Tùy chọn Chế độ chơi */}
        <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
          {/* Chiều Hỏi (Ask Mode) */}
          <div className="bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600">
                <Icons.RefreshCcw size={18} />
              </div>
              <div className="text-left">
                <div className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">Chiều hỏi đáp</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                  {config.askMode === 'def'
                    ? 'Hỏi Tiếng Việt, chọn Ngoại ngữ'
                    : 'Hỏi Ngoại ngữ, chọn Tiếng Việt'}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 shadow-sm shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, askMode: 'term' }))}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
                  config.askMode !== 'def'
                    ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white shadow-sm`
                    : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                Hỏi từ
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, askMode: 'def' }))}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
                  config.askMode === 'def'
                    ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white shadow-sm`
                    : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                Hỏi nghĩa
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Chế độ Vô tận (Endless Mode) */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.isEndless}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, isEndless: val }))}
            icon={Icons.InfinityIcon}
            color={mainColor}
            title="Chế độ Vô tận (Endless)"
            subtitle={
              config.isEndless
                ? 'Chơi liên tục không giới hạn số câu'
                : `Chơi theo phiên (${config.totalQuestions || 20} câu)`
            }
          />

          {/* Giới hạn thời gian */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.timerEnabled}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, timerEnabled: val }))}
            icon={Icons.Clock}
            color="orange"
            title="Đếm ngược thời gian"
            subtitle={
              config.timerEnabled
                ? `Giới hạn ${config.timeLimit || 20} giây mỗi câu`
                : 'Tắt đồng hồ đếm ngược'
            }
          />

          {/* Nút phát âm (Auto Speak) */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.autoSpeak}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, autoSpeak: val }))}
            icon={Icons.Volume2}
            color="blue"
            title="Phát âm tự động"
            subtitle="Đọc câu hỏi / đáp án ngay khi hiển thị"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Bắt đầu */}
      <div className="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
        {!canStart && (
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-red-500 text-center mb-2">
            ⚠️ Cần tối thiểu {minRequiredCards} thẻ để chơi hoặc chuyển sang chế độ AI Tự Sinh!
          </p>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={onStartGame}
          disabled={!canStart}
          className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base ${
            canStart
              ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 shadow-${mainColor}-200`
              : 'bg-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'
          }`}
        >
          <Icons.Play size={20} fill="currentColor" /> BẮT ĐẦU THỬ THÁCH
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// 2. BÀN CHƠI TRẮC NGHIỆM (QUIZ BOARD)
// ============================================================================
export const QuizBoard = ({
  currentIndex = 0,
  totalQuestions = 20,
  isEndless = false,
  score = 0,
  streak = 0,
  timeLeft = null,
  ammoCount = 0,
  isAiSource = false,
  currentCard = null,
  selectedOption = null,
  isChecked = false,
  wrongFeedback = null,
  cooldownLeft = 0,
  onSelectOption,
  onNextQuestion,
  onExplainGrammar,
  onSpeak,
  onSaveWord,
  onOpenHanzi,
  onExit,
  fontFamily = 'inherit',
  lang = 'en',
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {

  const questionData = currentCard?.origin || currentCard?.question || currentCard || {};
  const options = currentCard?.options || [];
  
  // Xác định text câu hỏi dựa trên cấu trúc sinh ra từ ExamNormalizer
  let questionText = questionData.term;
  if (currentCard?.term) questionText = currentCard.term; // Dữ liệu AI tự sinh
  if (!questionText) questionText = "Câu hỏi bị lỗi";

  // Phím tắt bàn phím (1, 2, 3, 4)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (isChecked) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && cooldownLeft === 0) {
          onNextQuestion();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const key = parseInt(e.key, 10);
      if (!isNaN(key) && key >= 1 && key <= options.length) {
        onSelectOption(options[key - 1]);
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isChecked, cooldownLeft, onNextQuestion, onSelectOption, options]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between border-2 border-gray-100 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in">
      {/* Thanh Top HUD Dùng chung */}
      <GameTopHUD
        onExit={onExit}
        currentRound={currentIndex + 1}
        maxRounds={totalQuestions}
        isEndless={isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={isAiSource}
        onSaveWord={onSaveWord}
        onOpenHanzi={onOpenHanzi}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
      />

      {/* Khu vực Câu hỏi */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar space-y-4 pr-1 my-1 flex flex-col">
        <div className={`flex-1 min-h-[120px] p-5 rounded-2xl bg-${mainColor}-50/50 border border-${mainColor}-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative text-center`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-2 absolute top-3">
            {t ? t('question') || 'Câu hỏi' : 'Câu hỏi'}
          </div>
          
          <div 
            style={{ fontFamily }}
            className="text-lg sm:text-2xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words mt-4"
          >
            {questionText}
          </div>
          
          {onSpeak && questionData.term && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSpeak(questionText)}
              className={`mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white text-${mainColor}-600 border border-${mainColor}-200 text-xs font-bold shadow-sm hover:bg-${mainColor}-50 transition-all active:scale-95`}
            >
              <Icons.Volume2 size={14} />
              <span>{t ? t('listenAgain') : 'Nghe phát âm'}</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Khối Đáp án */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 shrink-0">
          {options.map((opt, idx) => {
            const isCorrectOption = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';
            const isSelected = selectedOption === opt;
            
            let btnStyle = `bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:border-${mainColor}-400 hover:bg-${mainColor}-50/40`;
            
            if (isChecked) {
              if (isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-green-500 border-green-600 text-white shadow-md scale-[1.02] z-10';
              } else if (isSelected && !isCorrectOption) {
                btnStyle = 'bg-red-500 border-red-600 text-white shadow-md animate-shake';
              } else {
                btnStyle = 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 opacity-60 scale-95';
              }
            } else if (isSelected) {
              btnStyle = `bg-${mainColor}-100 border-${mainColor}-500 text-${mainColor}-800 ring-2 ring-${mainColor}-200`;
            }

            const OptionIcon = isChecked && isCorrectOption ? Icons.CheckCircle : (isChecked && isSelected ? Icons.X : null);

            return (
              <button
                key={idx}
                type="button"
                disabled={isChecked}
                onClick={() => onSelectOption(opt)}
                style={{ fontFamily: (isChecked && isCorrectOption) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }}
                className={`relative min-h-[64px] p-3 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-center flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 break-words ${btnStyle}`}
              >
                <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 text-[10px] opacity-50 font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-current">
                  {idx + 1}
                </span>
                
                <span className="px-6">{opt.text}</span>
                
                {OptionIcon && (
                  <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
                    <OptionIcon size={20} className={isCorrectOption ? 'text-white' : 'text-white'} />
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        
        {/* Khối Giải thích / Feedback */}
        {isChecked && (
          <div className="animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 shrink-0">
             <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-2 ${
                selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true'
                  ? 'bg-green-50/80 border-green-200 text-green-900'
                  : 'bg-red-50/80 border-red-200 text-red-900'
              }`}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? (
                      <>
                        <Icons.CheckCircle size={18} className="text-green-600" />
                        <span>Chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Icons.AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600" />
                        <span>Chưa chính xác!</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Nút giải thích ngữ pháp */}
                  {onExplainGrammar && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={onExplainGrammar}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white/60 hover:bg-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <Icons.Sparkles size={13} className="text-purple-600" /> Giải thích
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                
                {/* Nội dung giải thích có sẵn từ thẻ */}
                {(questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback) && (
                  <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed bg-white/70 p-3 rounded-lg border border-black/5 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                    {questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback}
                  </div>
                )}
             </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Tiếp theo */}
      <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0 h-[60px]">
        {isChecked ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNextQuestion}
            disabled={cooldownLeft > 0}
            className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm sm:text-base ${
              cooldownLeft > 0
                ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-wait'
                : `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700`
            }`}
          >
            <span>
              {cooldownLeft > 0
                ? `Đợi nạp đạn (${cooldownLeft}s)...`
                : 'Câu tiếp theo (Enter)'}
            </span>
            <Icons.ChevronRight size={20} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 select-none">
            Chọn 1 đáp án để tiếp tục
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const QuizUI = {
  QuizSetup,
  QuizBoard
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\ReadingGame.jsx
=========================================

/**
 * @file src/features/games/ReadingGame.jsx
 * @description Controller điều phối Mini-game Đọc Hiểu (Reading Game) với QueueEngine & Fallback.
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.24 (Reading Game Logic)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { pullRetryCardWithLock } from '@/services/db';
import { QueueEngine } from '@/engines/queueEngine';
import { ExamEngine } from '@/engines/exam';
import { GameAlgoEngine } from '@/engines/gameOfflineEngine';
import { FallbackDataEngine } from '@/engines/fallbackData';
import { GlobalLoadingScreen } from '@/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen';

import {
  calculateGameScore,
  playGameSFX,
  handleExitDiscipline,
  normalizeLevelAndTopic,
  getConfiguredUiCooldown,
  applyAntiStreakShuffle
} from './common/gameHelpers';
import { GameSummaryScreen } from './common/GameSharedUI';
import { ReadingSetup, ReadingBoard } from './ReadingUI';

export const ReadingGame = ({
  cards = [],
  lang = 'en',
  apiKey = '',
  settings = {},
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode = 'sentence', // Đọc hiểu ưu tiên câu văn / đoạn văn
  setDataMode,
  gameSessions = {},
  setGameSessions,
  globalRetryBag = {},
  addToRetryBag,
  removeFromRetryBag,
  onLogWrong,
  onSaveToHarvest,
  onOpenWordSelector,
  onOpenHanzi,
  speak,
  isMuted = false,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  setIsGamePlaying,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  // ============================================================================
  // 1. STATE CẤU HÌNH & TRẠNG THÁI VÒNG ĐỜI GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(() => {
    const saved = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_reading_config', {});
    return {
      sourceMode: cards.length >= 4 ? (saved.sourceMode || 'local') : 'ai',
      isEndless: saved.isEndless || false,
      totalQuestions: saved.totalQuestions || 10,
      timerEnabled: saved.timerEnabled !== false,
      timeLimit: saved.timeLimit || 90 // Game đọc hiểu cần nhiều thời gian hơn
    };
  });

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('setup'); // 'setup' | 'loading' | 'playing' | 'summary'
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [correctCount, setCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(null);
  const [cooldownLeft, setCooldownLeft] = useState(0);
  const [ammoCount, setAmmoCount] = useState(0);

  // State Bàn chơi hiện tại
  const [currentCard, setCurrentCard] = useState(null);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState(null);
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);
  const [wrongFeedback, setWrongFeedback] = useState(null);

  // Refs điều phối đa luồng & logic game
  const coordinatorRef = useRef(null);
  const usedTermsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(null);
  const streakTrackerRef = useRef([]); // Chống lặp vị trí đáp án

  // Lưu cấu hình khi thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_reading_config', config);
  }, [config]);

  // Đồng bộ cờ đang chơi lên App
  useEffect(() => {
    if (setIsGamePlaying) {
      setIsGamePlaying(status === 'playing' || status === 'loading');
    }
    return () => {
      if (setIsGamePlaying) setIsGamePlaying(false);
    };
  }, [status, setIsGamePlaying]);

  // Quét số lượng đạn AI dự trữ mỗi 500ms
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current && coordinatorRef.current.queue) {
        const aiItems = coordinatorRef.current.queue.filter((b) => b && b.content && b.content.isAiGenerated);
        setAmmoCount(aiItems.length);
      } else {
        setAmmoCount(0);
      }
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  // Dọn dẹp khi unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. HÀM ĐÓNG GÓI BÀN CHƠI NGOẠI TUYẾN (LOCAL / FALLBACK BOARD BUILDER)
  // ============================================================================
  const buildLocalBoard = useCallback(() => {
    const validDeck = cards.filter((c) => c && c.term && c.definition);
    let selectedItem = null;

    // 1. Rút 1 thẻ từ Túi nháp lỗi sai
    const retryCard = pullRetryCardWithLock('reading', globalRetryBag, lang);
    if (retryCard && retryCard.term && retryCard.definition) {
      selectedItem = retryCard;
    }

    // 2. Lấy thẻ chưa dùng trong bộ bài hiện tại
    if (!selectedItem) {
      let unusedPool = validDeck.filter((c) => !usedTermsRef.current.has(c.term));
      if (unusedPool.length === 0 && validDeck.length > 0) {
        usedTermsRef.current.clear();
        unusedPool = validDeck;
      }
      
      if (unusedPool.length > 0) {
        selectedItem = unusedPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * unusedPool.length)];
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback cứu hộ chuyên dụng cho Reading
    if (!selectedItem) {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const fallbackList = FallbackDataEngine.getGameReadyFallback('reading', lang, pickedLevel, { dataMode });
      
      if (fallbackList && Array.isArray(fallbackList.options)) {
        fallbackList.options = applyAntiStreakShuffle(fallbackList.options, streakTrackerRef);
      }
      return fallbackList;
    }

    usedTermsRef.current.add(selectedItem.term || '');

    // Nếu thẻ ngoại tuyến là thẻ chuẩn đã được chế biến sẵn cho Reading
    if (selectedItem.passage && selectedItem.options) {
        selectedItem.options = applyAntiStreakShuffle(selectedItem.options, streakTrackerRef);
        return { ...selectedItem, isAiGenerated: false };
    }

    // Nếu thẻ ngoại tuyến là thẻ Flashcard thông thường -> Biến tấu (Graceful Degradation)
    const type = Utils.detectSentence(selectedItem.term) ? 'sentence' : 'word';
    const correctOptText = selectedItem.definition;
    
    // Động cơ sinh đáp án nhiễu Offline
    let distTexts = [];
    if (GameAlgoEngine?.OptionsEngine?.offline_generateOptions) {
      try {
        distTexts = GameAlgoEngine.OptionsEngine.offline_generateOptions(correctOptText, validDeck, lang, type, 3, false);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Reading Offline Option Generation Error:", e);
      }
    }
    
    if (!distTexts || distTexts.length < 3) {
      distTexts = ["Đáp án nhiễu 1", "Đáp án nhiễu 2", "Đáp án nhiễu 3"];
    }

    const correctOpt = { text: correctOptText, isCorrect: true };
    const distractors = distTexts.slice(0, 3).map(d => ({ text: d, isCorrect: false }));
    const shuffledOptions = applyAntiStreakShuffle([...distractors, correctOpt], streakTrackerRef);

    return {
      passage: selectedItem.term,
      term: "Chọn nghĩa chính xác cho đoạn văn bản trên:",
      options: shuffledOptions,
      origin: selectedItem,
      isAiGenerated: false
    };
  }, [cards, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, globalRetryBag, lang]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 3. HÀM TẢI ĐẠN AI CHO QUEUE COORDINATOR
  // ============================================================================
  const fetchAiQuestion = useCallback(async () => {
    const { pickedLevel, pickedTopic } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(
      currentLevel,
      currentTopic,
      lang
    );

    const meta = {
      id: `reading_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      type: 'reading', // ExamEngine sẽ ánh xạ sang 'ielts_reading_passage'
      mode: 'minigame',
      lang,
      level: pickedLevel,
      topic: pickedTopic,
      dataMode
    };

    // ExamEngine sẽ tự động sinh ra passageGroup và bóc tách thành từng câu hỏi con
    const hydrated = await ExamEngine.hydrateQuestion(meta, apiKey);
    if (hydrated && hydrated.content) {
      if (onSaveToHarvest && hydrated.isNewHarvest) {
        // Lưu toàn bộ Passage Data vào Harvest Pool thay vì chỉ 1 câu hỏi con
        const contentToSave = hydrated.content._fullPassageData || hydrated.content.origin || hydrated.content;
        onSaveToHarvest(pickedLevel, contentToSave);
      }
      return hydrated;
    }
    throw new Error('Dữ liệu Reading AI trả về rỗng.');
  }, [apiKey, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, lang, onSaveToHarvest]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 4. NẠP BÀN CHƠI MỚI & ĐỒNG HỒ ĐẾM NGƯỢC
  // ============================================================================
  const startCooldownIfNeeded = useCallback((isAiRound) => {
    if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    if (!isAiRound) {
      setCooldownLeft(0);
      return;
    }
    const cdSec = getConfiguredUiCooldown(9);
    setCooldownLeft(cdSec);
    cooldownRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCooldownLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  }, []);

  const loadQuestionBoard = useCallback(
    (targetIndex) => {
      let nextData = null;

      if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && coordinatorRef.current) {
        nextData = coordinatorRef.current.pop();
      }

      let qContent = null;
      if (nextData && nextData.content) {
        qContent = nextData.content;
      } else {
        if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && window.globalShowToast && targetIndex > 0) {
          window.globalShowToast('Đang dùng dữ liệu dự phòng trong lúc đợi AI nạp đạn...', 'warning');
        }
        qContent = buildLocalBoard();
      }
      
      // Đảm bảo Options được xáo trộn chuẩn chống Streak
      if (qContent && Array.isArray(qContent.options)) {
        qContent.options = applyAntiStreakShuffle(qContent.options, streakTrackerRef);
      }

      setCurrentCard(qContent);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setIsChecked(false);
      setWrongFeedback(null);
      
      setTimeLeft(config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null);
      startCooldownIfNeeded(config.sourceMode === 'ai');
    },
    [buildLocalBoard, config.sourceMode, config.timeLimit, config.timerEnabled, startCooldownIfNeeded]
  );

  // Đồng hồ đếm ngược
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'playing' || !config.timerEnabled || isChecked || timeLeft === null) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev === null) return null;
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
          setStreak(0);
          setIsChecked(true);
          
          if (currentCard?.origin) {
            if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
            if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('reading', currentCard.origin);
          }
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [status, config.timerEnabled, isChecked, timeLeft, isMuted, currentCard, onLogWrong, addToRetryBag]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 5. KHỞI ĐỘNG GAME & KHÔI PHỤC PHIÊN CHƠI
  // ============================================================================
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    usedTermsRef.current.clear();
    streakTrackerRef.current = [];
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setScore(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setCorrectCount(0);

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();

    if (config.sourceMode === 'ai') {
      // Game đọc hiểu cần tải ít nhất 2 câu hỏi để đảm bảo mạch đọc trơn tru nếu chung passage
      coordinatorRef.current = QueueEngine.createQueueCoordinator(fetchAiQuestion, 4);
      setStatus('loading');
      coordinatorRef.current.maintain(true, 25000, false);
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleLoadingComplete = useCallback(() => {
    loadQuestionBoard(0);
    setStatus('playing');
  }, [loadQuestionBoard]);

  const handleResumeSession = () => {
    const saved = gameSessions?.reading;
    if (!saved) return;

    if (saved.config) setConfig(saved.config);
    setCurrentIndex(saved.currentIndex || 0);
    setScore(saved.score || 0);
    setStreak(saved.streak || 0);
    setCorrectCount(saved.correctCount || 0);

    if (saved.currentCard) {
      setCurrentCard(saved.currentCard);
      setSelectedOption(saved.selectedOption || null);
      setIsChecked(saved.isChecked || false);
      setWrongFeedback(saved.wrongFeedback || null);
      setTimeLeft(saved.timeLeft ?? (config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null));
      setStatus('playing');
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(saved.currentIndex || 0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleClearSession = () => {
    if (setGameSessions) {
      setGameSessions((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next.reading;
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 6. XỬ LÝ TƯƠNG TÁC (CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN)
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSelectOption = (opt) => {
    if (isChecked || !currentCard) return;

    setSelectedOption(opt);
    setIsChecked(true);

    const isCorrect = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';

    if (isCorrect) {
      playGameSFX('correct', isMuted);
      const nextStreak = streak + 1;
      const points = calculateGameScore(100, timeLeft || 0, nextStreak, 'normal');
      setStreak(nextStreak);
      setScore(prev => prev + points);
      setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1);
      
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.passage || '';
      if (removeFromRetryBag) removeFromRetryBag('reading', targetTerm);
      
    } else {
      playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
      setStreak(0);
      if (currentCard.origin) {
        if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
        if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('reading', currentCard.origin);
      }
      setWrongFeedback(currentCard.origin?.explanation || currentCard.explanation || "Hãy đọc lại đoạn văn một lần nữa.");
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 7. CHUYỂN CÂU & THOÁT GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    if (cooldownLeft > 0) return;

    if (!config.isEndless && currentIndex >= config.totalQuestions - 1) {
      handleClearSession();
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      setStatus('summary');
      return;
    }

    const nextIdx = currentIndex + 1;
    setCurrentIndex(nextIdx);
    loadQuestionBoard(nextIdx);
  };

  const handleExitGame = () => {
    if (status === 'playing' && !isChecked) {
      handleExitDiscipline({
        isPlaying: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        currentCard: currentCard?.origin || currentCard,
        gameType: 'reading',
        onLogWrong,
        addToRetryBag
      });

      if (setGameSessions) {
        setGameSessions((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          reading: {
            config,
            currentIndex,
            score,
            streak,
            correctCount,
            currentCard,
            selectedOption,
            isChecked,
            wrongFeedback,
            timeLeft,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          }
        }));
      }
    }

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
    setStatus('setup');
  };

  const handleSaveCurrentWord = () => {
    if (!onOpenWordSelector || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.passage || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenWordSelector(targetTerm);
  };

  const handleOpenHanziCurrent = () => {
    if (!onOpenHanzi || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.passage || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenHanzi(targetTerm);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 8. RENDER THEO TRẠNG THÁI
  // ============================================================================
  if (status === 'loading') {
    const { levelLabel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
    return (
      <GlobalLoadingScreen
        engine={coordinatorRef.current}
        onComplete={handleLoadingComplete}
        onCancel={() => {
          if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
          setStatus('setup');
        }}
        text="AI Đang Biên Soạn Bài Đọc Hiểu..."
        subText="Đang viết đoạn văn và chắt lọc câu hỏi thử thách"
        mainColor={mainColor}
        levelStr={levelLabel}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'summary') {
    return (
      <GameSummaryScreen
        score={score}
        correctCount={correctCount}
        totalQuestions={currentIndex + 1}
        onRestart={handleStartGame}
        onBack={onBack}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'playing') {
    return (
      <ReadingBoard
        currentIndex={currentIndex}
        totalQuestions={config.totalQuestions}
        isEndless={config.isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={config.sourceMode === 'ai'}
        currentCard={currentCard}
        selectedOption={selectedOption}
        isChecked={isChecked}
        wrongFeedback={wrongFeedback}
        cooldownLeft={cooldownLeft}
        onSelectOption={handleSelectOption}
        onNextQuestion={handleNextQuestion}
        onSpeak={speak}
        onSaveWord={handleSaveCurrentWord}
        onOpenHanzi={handleOpenHanziCurrent}
        onExit={handleExitGame}
        fontFamily={Utils.getFontFamily(settings)}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <ReadingSetup
      config={config}
      setConfig={setConfig}
      cardsCount={cards.length}
      lang={lang}
      currentLevel={currentLevel}
      setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
      currentTopic={currentTopic}
      setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
      dataMode={dataMode}
      setDataMode={setDataMode}
      savedSession={gameSessions?.reading}
      onResumeSession={handleResumeSession}
      onClearSession={handleClearSession}
      onStartGame={handleStartGame}
      onBack={onBack}
      onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
      mainColor={mainColor}
      t={t}
    />
  );
};

/**
 * @file src/features/games/ReadingUI.jsx
 * @description Giao diện Setup & Bàn chơi của Mini-game Đọc Hiểu (Reading Game).

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';

  ResumeSessionBanner,
  SourceModeSelector,

// ============================================================================
// 1. MÀN HÌNH CÀI ĐẶT GAME ĐỌC HIỂU (READING SETUP)
// ============================================================================
export const ReadingSetup = ({
  config,
  setConfig,
  cardsCount = 0,
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode,
  setDataMode,
  savedSession,
  onResumeSession,
  onClearSession,
  onStartGame,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
