// ============================================================================
// 2. BÀN CHƠI ĐỌC HIỂU (READING BOARD)
// ============================================================================
export const ReadingBoard = ({
  currentIndex = 0,
  totalQuestions = 20,
  isEndless = false,
  score = 0,
  streak = 0,
  timeLeft = null,
  ammoCount = 0,
  isAiSource = false,
  currentCard = null,
  selectedOption = null,
  isChecked = false,
  wrongFeedback = null,
  cooldownLeft = 0,
  onSelectOption,
  onNextQuestion,
  onSpeak,
  onSaveWord,
  onOpenHanzi,
  onExit,
  fontFamily = 'inherit',
  lang = 'en',
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const questionData = currentCard || {};
  const options = Array.isArray(questionData.options) ? questionData.options : [];
  
  const passage = questionData.passage || "";
  let questionText = questionData.term || questionData.questionText || "";
  if (!questionText) questionText = "Câu hỏi bị lỗi";

  // Phím tắt bàn phím (1, 2, 3, 4)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (isChecked) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && cooldownLeft === 0) {
          onNextQuestion();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const key = parseInt(e.key, 10);
      if (!isNaN(key) && key >= 1 && key <= options.length) {
        onSelectOption(options[key - 1]);
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isChecked, cooldownLeft, onNextQuestion, onSelectOption, options]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between border-2 border-gray-100 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in">
      {/* Thanh Top HUD Dùng chung */}
      <GameTopHUD
        onExit={onExit}
        currentRound={currentIndex + 1}
        maxRounds={totalQuestions}
        isEndless={isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={isAiSource}
        onSaveWord={onSaveWord}
        onOpenHanzi={onOpenHanzi}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
      />

      {/* Khu vực Nội dung (Split View cho màn hình lớn) */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 my-1">
        
        {/* Đoạn văn bản (Passage) */}
        <div className="flex-1 md:w-1/2 bg-gray-50/80 border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex flex-col relative shadow-inner">
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 sticky top-0 bg-gray-50/90 py-1 z-10 backdrop-blur-sm">
            <Icons.BookOpen size={14} /> Đoạn văn
          </div>
          <div 
            style={{ fontFamily }}
            className="text-sm sm:text-base text-gray-800 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap font-medium"
          >
            {passage}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Khối Câu hỏi và Đáp án */}
        <div className="flex-1 md:w-1/2 flex flex-col overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1 space-y-4">
          
          <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-50/50 border border-${mainColor}-100`}>
            <div className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-${mainColor}-400 mb-2`}>
              Câu hỏi {currentIndex + 1}
            </div>
            <div 
              style={{ fontFamily }}
              className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words"
            >
              {questionText}
            </div>
            
            {onSpeak && questionData.term && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSpeak(questionText)}
                className={`mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white text-${mainColor}-600 border border-${mainColor}-200 text-[10px] font-bold shadow-sm hover:bg-${mainColor}-50 transition-all active:scale-95`}
              >
                <Icons.Volume2 size={12} /> Nghe
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 shrink-0">
            {options.map((opt, idx) => {
              const isCorrectOption = opt.isCorrect === true || String(opt.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true';
              const isSelected = selectedOption === opt;
              
              let btnStyle = `bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:border-${mainColor}-400 hover:bg-${mainColor}-50/40`;
              
              if (isChecked) {
                if (isCorrectOption) {
                  btnStyle = 'bg-green-500 border-green-600 text-white shadow-md scale-[1.02] z-10';
                } else if (isSelected && !isCorrectOption) {
                  btnStyle = 'bg-red-500 border-red-600 text-white shadow-md animate-shake';
                } else {
                  btnStyle = 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 text-gray-400 opacity-60 scale-95';
                }
              } else if (isSelected) {
                btnStyle = `bg-${mainColor}-100 border-${mainColor}-500 text-${mainColor}-800 ring-2 ring-${mainColor}-200`;
              }

              const OptionIcon = isChecked && isCorrectOption ? Icons.CheckCircle : (isChecked && isSelected ? Icons.X : null);

              return (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isChecked}
                  onClick={() => onSelectOption(opt)}
                  style={{ fontFamily: (isChecked && isCorrectOption) || !opt.text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/) ? 'inherit' : fontFamily }}
                  className={`relative min-h-[56px] p-3 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-sm text-left flex items-center transition-all active:scale-95 break-words ${btnStyle}`}
                >
                  <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[10px] opacity-50 font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-current">
                    {idx + 1}
                  </span>
                  
                  <span className="pl-8 pr-6">{opt.text}</span>
                  
                  {OptionIcon && (
                    <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
                      <OptionIcon size={18} className={isCorrectOption ? 'text-white' : 'text-white'} />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          
          {/* Khối Giải thích / Feedback */}
          {isChecked && (
            <div className="animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 shrink-0 pb-2">
               <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-2 ${
                  selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true'
                    ? 'bg-green-50/80 border-green-200 text-green-900'
                    : 'bg-red-50/80 border-red-200 text-red-900'
                }`}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">
                      {selectedOption?.isCorrect === true || String(selectedOption?.isCorrect).toLowerCase() === 'true' ? (
                        <>
                          <Icons.CheckCircle size={18} className="text-green-600" />
                          <span>Chính xác!</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Icons.AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600" />
                          <span>Chưa chính xác!</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Nội dung giải thích có sẵn từ thẻ */}
                  {(questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback) && (
                    <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed bg-white/70 p-3 rounded-lg border border-black/5 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                      <div className="font-black opacity-60 mb-1 uppercase text-[10px]">Trích dẫn / Giải thích:</div>
                      {questionData.explanation || questionData.analysis || wrongFeedback}
                    </div>
                  )}
               </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Tiếp theo */}
      <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0 h-[60px]">
        {isChecked ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNextQuestion}
            disabled={cooldownLeft > 0}
            className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm sm:text-base ${
              cooldownLeft > 0
                ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-wait'
                : `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700`
            }`}
          >
            <span>
              {cooldownLeft > 0
                ? `Đợi nạp đạn (${cooldownLeft}s)...`
                : 'Câu tiếp theo (Enter)'}
            </span>
            <Icons.ChevronRight size={20} />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 select-none">
            Chọn 1 đáp án để tiếp tục
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const ReadingUI = {
  ReadingSetup,
  ReadingBoard
};

FILE: src\features\games\ScrambleGame.jsx

/**
 * @file src/features/games/ScrambleGame.jsx
 * @description Controller điều phối Mini-game Ghép Câu (Scramble Game) tích hợp QueueEngine & Fallback.
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.4 (Scramble Game Logic)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { pullRetryCardWithLock } from '@/services/db';
import { QueueEngine } from '@/engines/queueEngine';
import { ExamEngine } from '@/engines/exam';
import { GameAlgoEngine } from '@/engines/gameOfflineEngine';
import { FallbackDataEngine } from '@/engines/fallbackData';
import { GlobalLoadingScreen } from '@/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen';

import {
  calculateGameScore,
  playGameSFX,
  handleExitDiscipline,
  normalizeLevelAndTopic,
  getConfiguredUiCooldown
} from './common/gameHelpers';
import { GameSummaryScreen } from './common/GameSharedUI';
import { ScrambleSetup, ScrambleBoard } from './ScrambleUI';

export const ScrambleGame = ({
  cards = [],
  lang = 'en',
  apiKey = '',
  settings = {},
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode = 'sentence', // Mặc định là câu văn cho game này
  setDataMode,
  gameSessions = {},
  setGameSessions,
  globalRetryBag = {},
  addToRetryBag,
  removeFromRetryBag,
  onLogWrong,
  onSaveToHarvest,
  onOpenWordSelector,
  onOpenHanzi,
  speak,
  isMuted = false,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  setIsGamePlaying,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  // ============================================================================
  // 1. STATE CẤU HÌNH & TRẠNG THÁI VÒNG ĐỜI GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(() => {
    const saved = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_scramble_config', {});
    return {
      sourceMode: cards.length >= 1 ? (saved.sourceMode || 'local') : 'ai',
      difficulty: saved.difficulty || 'easy',
      inputMethod: saved.inputMethod || 'tap', // 'tap' | 'type'
      grammarId: saved.grammarId || '',
      isEndless: saved.isEndless || false,
      totalQuestions: saved.totalQuestions || 20,
      timerEnabled: saved.timerEnabled !== false,
      timeLimit: saved.timeLimit || 45
    };
  });

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('setup'); // 'setup' | 'loading' | 'playing' | 'summary'
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [correctCount, setCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(null);
  const [cooldownLeft, setCooldownLeft] = useState(0);
  const [ammoCount, setAmmoCount] = useState(0);

  // State Bàn chơi hiện tại
  const [currentCard, setCurrentCard] = useState(null);
  const [poolTokens, setPoolTokens] = useState([]);
  const [selectedTokens, setSelectedTokens] = useState([]);
  const [typedAnswer, setTypedAnswer] = useState('');
  
  const [answerStatus, setAnswerStatus] = useState(null); // null | 'correct' | 'wrong'
  const [grammarExplanation, setGrammarExplanation] = useState('');
  const [isExplaining, setIsExplaining] = useState(false);

  // Refs điều phối đa luồng
  const coordinatorRef = useRef(null);
  const usedTermsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(null);

  // Lưu cấu hình khi thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_scramble_config', config);
  }, [config]);

  // Đồng bộ cờ đang chơi lên App
  useEffect(() => {
    if (setIsGamePlaying) {
      setIsGamePlaying(status === 'playing' || status === 'loading');
    }
    return () => {
      if (setIsGamePlaying) setIsGamePlaying(false);
    };
  }, [status, setIsGamePlaying]);

  // Quét số lượng đạn AI dự trữ mỗi 500ms
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current && coordinatorRef.current.queue) {
        const aiItems = coordinatorRef.current.queue.filter((b) => b && b.content && b.content.isAiGenerated);
        setAmmoCount(aiItems.length);
      } else {
        setAmmoCount(0);
      }
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  // Dọn dẹp khi unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. HÀM ĐÓNG GÓI BÀN CHƠI NGOẠI TUYẾN (LOCAL / FALLBACK BOARD BUILDER)
  // ============================================================================
  const buildLocalBoard = useCallback(() => {
    const validDeck = cards.filter((c) => c && c.term && c.definition);
    let selectedItem = null;

    // 1. Rút 1 thẻ từ Túi nháp lỗi sai
    const retryCard = pullRetryCardWithLock('scramble', globalRetryBag, lang);
    if (retryCard && retryCard.term && retryCard.definition) {
      selectedItem = retryCard;
    }

    // 2. Lấy thẻ chưa dùng trong bộ bài hiện tại
    if (!selectedItem) {
      let unusedPool = validDeck.filter((c) => !usedTermsRef.current.has(c.term));
      if (unusedPool.length === 0 && validDeck.length > 0) {
        usedTermsRef.current.clear();
        unusedPool = validDeck;
      }
      
      if (unusedPool.length > 0) {
        selectedItem = unusedPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * unusedPool.length)];
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback cứu hộ
    if (!selectedItem) {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const fallbackList = FallbackDataEngine.getGameReadyFallback('scramble', lang, pickedLevel, { dataMode });
      selectedItem = fallbackList?.origin || { term: "Error fallback", definition: "Lỗi dữ liệu", _isRescued: true };
    }

    usedTermsRef.current.add(selectedItem.term || '');

    // Tạo mảnh ghép (Parts)
    let parts = [];
    const isChinese = lang === 'zh';
    const isSentence = Utils.detectSentence(selectedItem.term);
    const type = isSentence ? 'sentence' : 'word';
    
    const cleanAndLower = (textArr) => textArr.map(p => { 
      let cleaned = p.replace(/^[^\p{L}\p{N}]+|[^\p{L}\p{N}]+$/gu, ""); 
      if (!isChinese) cleaned = cleaned.toLowerCase(); 
      return cleaned; 
    }).filter(p => p.trim() !== "");
    
    if (isChinese) {
      parts = (selectedItem.term || '').split('');
    } else {
      parts = isSentence ? (selectedItem.term || '').split(' ') : (selectedItem.term || '').split('');
    }
    
    parts = cleanAndLower(parts);

    // Bơm rác (Noise) nếu ở chế độ Hard
    if (config.difficulty === 'hard') {
      let targetCount = 2;
      const len = parts.length;
      if (len >= 5 && len <= 10) targetCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2) + 4;
      else if (len > 10) targetCount = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 5;
      
      const noiseWords = GameAlgoEngine.ScrambleNoiseEngine.offline_getNoise(selectedItem.term, validDeck, lang, type, targetCount);
      if (noiseWords && noiseWords.length > 0) {
        let finalNoiseWords = [];
        if (isChinese || type === 'word') {
          noiseWords.forEach(w => { const cleanW = String(w).replace(/\s/g, ''); finalNoiseWords.push(...cleanW.split('')); });
        } else {
          finalNoiseWords = noiseWords;
        }
        finalNoiseWords = cleanAndLower(finalNoiseWords).slice(0, targetCount);
        parts.push(...finalNoiseWords);
      }
    }

    return {
      origin: selectedItem,
      parts: Utils.shuffleArray(parts),
      isAiGenerated: false
    };
  }, [cards, config.difficulty, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, globalRetryBag, lang]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 3. HÀM TẢI ĐẠN AI CHO QUEUE COORDINATOR
  // ============================================================================
  const fetchAiQuestion = useCallback(async () => {
    const { pickedLevel, pickedTopic } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(
      currentLevel,
      currentTopic,
      lang
    );

    const meta = {
      id: `scramble_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      type: 'scramble',
      mode: 'minigame',
      lang,
      level: pickedLevel,
      topic: pickedTopic,
      difficulty: config.difficulty,
      inputMethod: config.inputMethod,
      grammarId: config.grammarId,
      dataMode
    };

    const hydrated = await ExamEngine.hydrateQuestion(meta, apiKey);
    if (hydrated && hydrated.content) {
      if (onSaveToHarvest && hydrated.isNewHarvest) {
        onSaveToHarvest(pickedLevel, hydrated.content.origin || hydrated.content);
      }
      return hydrated;
    }
    throw new Error('Dữ liệu Scramble AI trả về rỗng.');
  }, [apiKey, config.difficulty, config.grammarId, config.inputMethod, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, lang, onSaveToHarvest]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 4. NẠP BÀN CHƠI MỚI & ĐỒNG HỒ ĐẾM NGƯỢC
  // ============================================================================
  const startCooldownIfNeeded = useCallback((isAiRound) => {
    if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    if (!isAiRound) {
      setCooldownLeft(0);
      return;
    }
    const cdSec = getConfiguredUiCooldown(9);
    setCooldownLeft(cdSec);
    cooldownRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCooldownLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  }, []);

  const loadQuestionBoard = useCallback(
    (targetIndex) => {
      let nextData = null;

      if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && coordinatorRef.current) {
        nextData = coordinatorRef.current.pop();
      }

      let qContent = null;
      if (nextData && nextData.content) {
        qContent = nextData.content;
      } else {
        if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && window.globalShowToast && targetIndex > 0) {
          window.globalShowToast('Đang dùng dữ liệu dự phòng trong lúc đợi AI nạp đạn...', 'warning');
        }
        qContent = buildLocalBoard();
      }

      setCurrentCard(qContent);
      
      // Khởi tạo mảng poolTokens (có ID duy nhất để React render đúng key)
      if (qContent && qContent.parts) {
        setPoolTokens(qContent.parts.map((t, idx) => ({ id: `pt_${idx}_${Date.now()}`, text: t })));
      } else {
        setPoolTokens([]);
      }
      
      setSelectedTokens([]);
      setTypedAnswer('');
      setAnswerStatus(null);
      setGrammarExplanation('');
      setIsExplaining(false);
      
      setTimeLeft(config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null);
      startCooldownIfNeeded(config.sourceMode === 'ai');
    },
    [buildLocalBoard, config.sourceMode, config.timeLimit, config.timerEnabled, startCooldownIfNeeded]
  );

  // Đồng hồ đếm ngược
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'playing' || !config.timerEnabled || answerStatus !== null || timeLeft === null) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev === null) return null;
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
          setStreak(0);
          setAnswerStatus('wrong');
          
          if (currentCard?.origin) {
            if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
            if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('scramble', currentCard.origin);
          }
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [status, config.timerEnabled, answerStatus, timeLeft, isMuted, currentCard, onLogWrong, addToRetryBag]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 5. KHỞI ĐỘNG GAME & KHÔI PHỤC PHIÊN CHƠI
  // ============================================================================
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    usedTermsRef.current.clear();
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setScore(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setCorrectCount(0);

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();

    if (config.sourceMode === 'ai') {
      coordinatorRef.current = QueueEngine.createQueueCoordinator(fetchAiQuestion, 4);
      setStatus('loading');
      coordinatorRef.current.maintain(true, 22000, false);
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleLoadingComplete = useCallback(() => {
    loadQuestionBoard(0);
    setStatus('playing');
  }, [loadQuestionBoard]);

  const handleResumeSession = () => {
    const saved = gameSessions?.scramble;
    if (!saved) return;

    if (saved.config) setConfig(saved.config);
    setCurrentIndex(saved.currentIndex || 0);
    setScore(saved.score || 0);
    setStreak(saved.streak || 0);
    setCorrectCount(saved.correctCount || 0);

    if (saved.currentCard) {
      setCurrentCard(saved.currentCard);
      setPoolTokens(saved.poolTokens || []);
      setSelectedTokens(saved.selectedTokens || []);
      setTypedAnswer(saved.typedAnswer || '');
      setAnswerStatus(saved.answerStatus || null);
      setTimeLeft(saved.timeLeft ?? (config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null));
      setStatus('playing');
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(saved.currentIndex || 0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleClearSession = () => {
    if (setGameSessions) {
      setGameSessions((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next.scramble;
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 6. XỬ LÝ TƯƠNG TÁC (SCRAMBLE LOGIC)
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSelectPoolToken = (token) => {
    if (answerStatus !== null) return;
    playGameSFX('click', isMuted);
    setSelectedTokens(prev => [...prev, token]);
  };

  const handleRemoveSelectedToken = (token, indexToRemove) => {
    if (answerStatus !== null) return;
    playGameSFX('click', isMuted);
    setSelectedTokens(prev => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== indexToRemove));
  };

  const handleClearSelected = () => {
    if (answerStatus !== null) return;
    setSelectedTokens([]);
  };

  const cleanStringForComparison = (str) => {
    if (!str) return "";
    return str.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, "").trim();
  };

  const handleCheckAnswer = () => {
    if (answerStatus !== null || !currentCard) return;

    let userAnswer = '';
    if (config.inputMethod === 'type') {
      userAnswer = typedAnswer;
    } else {
      userAnswer = selectedTokens.map(t => t.text).join(lang === 'zh' ? '' : ' ');
    }

    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term || '';
    
    const isCorrect = cleanStringForComparison(userAnswer) === cleanStringForComparison(targetTerm);

    if (isCorrect) {
      playGameSFX('correct', isMuted);
      setAnswerStatus('correct');
      const nextStreak = streak + 1;
      const points = calculateGameScore(100, timeLeft || 0, nextStreak, config.difficulty);
      setStreak(nextStreak);
      setScore(prev => prev + points);
      setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1);

      if (removeFromRetryBag) removeFromRetryBag('scramble', targetTerm);
    } else {
      playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
      setAnswerStatus('wrong');
      setStreak(0);
      if (currentCard.origin) {
        if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
        if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('scramble', currentCard.origin);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleExplainGrammar = async () => {
    if (isExplaining || grammarExplanation) return;
    if (!apiKey) {
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Cần API Key để phân tích!", "warning");
      return;
    }

    setIsExplaining(true);
    try {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
      const res = await Utils.fillCardWithAi(targetTerm, lang, apiKey, ['analysis'], dataMode, [pickedLevel]);
      if (res && res.analysis) {
        setGrammarExplanation(res.analysis);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Lỗi phân tích: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsExplaining(false);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 7. CHUYỂN CÂU & THOÁT GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    if (cooldownLeft > 0) return;

    if (!config.isEndless && currentIndex >= config.totalQuestions - 1) {
      handleClearSession();
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      setStatus('summary');
      return;
    }

    const nextIdx = currentIndex + 1;
    setCurrentIndex(nextIdx);
    loadQuestionBoard(nextIdx);
  };

  const handleExitGame = () => {
    if (status === 'playing' && answerStatus === null) {
      handleExitDiscipline({
        isPlaying: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        currentCard: currentCard?.origin || currentCard,
        gameType: 'scramble',
        onLogWrong,
        addToRetryBag
      });

      if (setGameSessions) {
        setGameSessions((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          scramble: {
            config,
            currentIndex,
            score,
            streak,
            correctCount,
            currentCard,
            poolTokens,
            selectedTokens,
            typedAnswer,
            answerStatus,
            timeLeft,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          }
        }));
      }
    }

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
    setStatus('setup');
  };

  const handleSaveCurrentWord = () => {
    if (!onOpenWordSelector || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenWordSelector(targetTerm);
  };

  const handleOpenHanziCurrent = () => {
    if (!onOpenHanzi || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenHanzi(targetTerm);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 8. RENDER THEO TRẠNG THÁI
  // ============================================================================
  if (status === 'loading') {
    const { levelLabel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
    return (
      <GlobalLoadingScreen
        engine={coordinatorRef.current}
        onComplete={handleLoadingComplete}
        onCancel={() => {
          if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
          setStatus('setup');
        }}
        text="AI Đang Tạo Câu Hỏi Ghép Câu..."
        subText="Đang trộn mảnh ghép và cài đặt bẫy ngữ pháp"
        mainColor={mainColor}
        levelStr={levelLabel}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'summary') {
    return (
      <GameSummaryScreen
        score={score}
        correctCount={correctCount}
        totalQuestions={currentIndex + 1}
        onRestart={handleStartGame}
        onBack={onBack}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'playing') {
    return (
      <ScrambleBoard
        currentIndex={currentIndex}
        totalQuestions={config.totalQuestions}
        isEndless={config.isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={config.sourceMode === 'ai'}
        currentCard={currentCard}
        inputMethod={config.inputMethod}
        poolTokens={poolTokens}
        selectedTokens={selectedTokens}
        typedAnswer={typedAnswer}
        setTypedAnswer={setTypedAnswer}
        answerStatus={answerStatus}
        grammarExplanation={grammarExplanation}
        isExplaining={isExplaining}
        cooldownLeft={cooldownLeft}
        onSelectPoolToken={handleSelectPoolToken}
        onRemoveSelectedToken={handleRemoveSelectedToken}
        onClearSelected={handleClearSelected}
        onCheckAnswer={handleCheckAnswer}
        onNextQuestion={handleNextQuestion}
        onExplainGrammar={handleExplainGrammar}
        onSpeak={speak}
        onSaveWord={handleSaveCurrentWord}
        onOpenHanzi={handleOpenHanziCurrent}
        onExit={handleExitGame}
        fontFamily={Utils.getFontFamily(settings)}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <ScrambleSetup
      config={config}
      setConfig={setConfig}
      cardsCount={cards.length}
      lang={lang}
      currentLevel={currentLevel}
      setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
      currentTopic={currentTopic}
      setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
      dataMode={dataMode}
      setDataMode={setDataMode}
      savedSession={gameSessions?.scramble}
      onResumeSession={handleResumeSession}
      onClearSession={handleClearSession}
      onStartGame={handleStartGame}
      onBack={onBack}
      onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
      mainColor={mainColor}
      t={t}
    />
  );
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\ScrambleUI.jsx

/**
 * @file src/features/games/ScrambleUI.jsx
 * @description Giao diện Setup & Bàn chơi của Mini-game Ghép Câu / Sắp Xếp Từ (Scramble Game).
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.3 (Scramble UI)
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Icons } from '@/components/common/Icons';
import { MenuToggle } from '@/components/common/Controls';
import {
  ResumeSessionBanner,
  SourceModeSelector,
  GrammarTrapSelector,
  GameTopHUD
} from './common/GameSharedUI';

// ============================================================================
// 1. MÀN HÌNH CÀI ĐẶT GAME GHÉP CÂU (SCRAMBLE SETUP)
// ============================================================================
export const ScrambleSetup = ({
  config,
  setConfig,
  cardsCount = 0,
  lang = 'en',
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode,
  setDataMode,
  savedSession,
  onResumeSession,
  onClearSession,
  onStartGame,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const minRequiredCards = 1;
  const canStart = config.sourceMode === 'ai' || cardsCount >= minRequiredCards;

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-5 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar border-2 border-gray-100 animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* Header Setup */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-${mainColor}-100 text-${mainColor}-600 shadow-sm`}>
              <Icons.Shuffle size={22} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-tight">
                {t ? t('modeScramble') : 'Ghép Câu & Từ'}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">
                {t ? t('descScramble') : 'Sắp xếp các mảnh từ thành câu/từ hoàn chỉnh'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-full transition-colors"
            title="Quay lại Menu Game"
          >
            <Icons.X size={22} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Banner Khôi phục phiên chơi cũ */}
        <ResumeSessionBanner
          savedSession={savedSession}
          onResume={onResumeSession}
          onClear={onClearSession}
          mainColor={mainColor}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Nguồn Dữ Liệu (Thẻ của tôi vs AI Tự Sinh) */}
        <SourceModeSelector
          sourceMode={config.sourceMode}
          setSourceMode={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, sourceMode: val }))}
          cardsCount={cardsCount}
          minCards={minRequiredCards}
          lang={lang}
          currentLevel={currentLevel}
          setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
          currentTopic={currentTopic}
          setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
          dataMode={dataMode}
          setDataMode={setDataMode}
          mainColor={mainColor}
          onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
        />

        {/* Bộ chọn Chuyên đề Bẫy Ngữ pháp (Khi dùng AI hoặc chế độ Khó) */}
        {(config.sourceMode === 'ai' || config.difficulty === 'hard') && (
          <GrammarTrapSelector
            gameType="scramble"
            lang={lang}
            currentLevel={currentLevel}
            selectedTrap={config.grammarId}
            onSelectTrap={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, grammarId: val }))}
            mainColor={mainColor}
          />
        )}

        {/* Các Tùy chọn Chế độ chơi */}
        <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
          {/* Phương thức thao tác: Chạm chọn từ (Tap) vs Gõ phím (Type) */}
          <div className="bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600">
                <Icons.Keyboard size={18} />
              </div>
              <div className="text-left">
                <div className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">Phương thức trả lời</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                  {config.inputMethod === 'type'
                    ? 'Tự gõ lại toàn bộ từ/câu bằng bàn phím'
                    : 'Chạm chọn các mảnh từ bị xáo trộn'}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 shadow-sm shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, inputMethod: 'tap' }))}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
                  config.inputMethod !== 'type'
                    ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white shadow-sm`
                    : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                Chạm từ
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, inputMethod: 'type' }))}
                className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
                  config.inputMethod === 'type'
                    ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 text-white shadow-sm`
                    : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                Gõ phím
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Độ khó: Dễ (Không có từ rác) vs Khó (Trộn thêm từ nhiễu) */}
          {config.inputMethod !== 'type' && (
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-full bg-orange-100 text-orange-600">
                  <Icons.Zap size={18} />
                </div>
                <div className="text-left">
                  <div className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-700">Độ khó mảnh ghép</div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                    {config.difficulty === 'hard'
                      ? 'Khó: Cài thêm các mảnh từ rác gây nhiễu'
                      : 'Dễ: Chỉ chứa đúng các mảnh của câu gốc'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 shadow-sm shrink-0">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, difficulty: 'easy' }))}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
                    config.difficulty === 'easy'
                      ? 'bg-green-500 text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  Dễ
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, difficulty: 'hard' }))}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition-all ${
                    config.difficulty === 'hard'
                      ? 'bg-red-500 text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  Khó (+Bẫy)
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Chế độ Vô tận (Endless Mode) */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.isEndless}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, isEndless: val }))}
            icon={Icons.InfinityIcon}
            color={mainColor}
            title="Chế độ Vô tận (Endless)"
            subtitle={
              config.isEndless
                ? 'Chơi liên tục không giới hạn số câu'
                : `Chơi theo phiên (${config.totalQuestions || 20} câu)`
            }
          />

          {/* Giới hạn thời gian */}
          <MenuToggle
            active={config.timerEnabled}
            setActive={(val) => setConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, timerEnabled: val }))}
            icon={Icons.Clock}
            color="orange"
            title="Đếm ngược thời gian"
            subtitle={
              config.timerEnabled
                ? `Giới hạn ${config.timeLimit || 45} giây mỗi câu`
                : 'Tắt đồng hồ đếm ngược'
            }
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Bắt đầu */}
      <div className="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
        {!canStart && (
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-red-500 text-center mb-2">
            ⚠️ Danh sách học đang trống! Hãy thêm thẻ hoặc chuyển sang chế độ AI Tự Sinh.
          </p>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={onStartGame}
          disabled={!canStart}
          className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-base ${
            canStart
              ? `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700 shadow-${mainColor}-200`
              : 'bg-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed'
          }`}
        >
          <Icons.Play size={20} fill="currentColor" /> BẮT ĐẦU GHÉP CÂU
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================================
// 2. BÀN CHƠI GHÉP CÂU (SCRAMBLE BOARD)
// ============================================================================
export const ScrambleBoard = ({
  currentIndex = 0,
  totalQuestions = 20,
  isEndless = false,
  score = 0,
  streak = 0,
  timeLeft = null,
  ammoCount = 0,
  isAiSource = false,
  currentCard = null,
  inputMethod = 'tap',
  poolTokens = [],
  selectedTokens = [],
  typedAnswer = '',
  setTypedAnswer,
  answerStatus = null, // null | 'correct' | 'wrong'
  grammarExplanation = '',
  isExplaining = false,
  cooldownLeft = 0,
  onSelectPoolToken,
  onRemoveSelectedToken,
  onClearSelected,
  onCheckAnswer,
  onNextQuestion,
  onExplainGrammar,
  onSpeak,
  onSaveWord,
  onOpenHanzi,
  onExit,
  fontFamily = 'inherit',
  lang = 'en',
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (inputMethod === 'type' && answerStatus === null) {
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 80);
    }
  }, [currentIndex, inputMethod, answerStatus]);

  const originCard = currentCard?.origin || currentCard || {};
  const promptMeaning = originCard.definition || 'Sắp xếp thành từ/câu hoàn chỉnh';
  const targetTerm = originCard.term || '';

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between border-2 border-gray-100 overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in">
      {/* Thanh Top HUD Dùng chung */}
      <GameTopHUD
        onExit={onExit}
        currentRound={currentIndex + 1}
        maxRounds={totalQuestions}
        isEndless={isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={isAiSource}
        onSaveWord={onSaveWord}
        onOpenHanzi={onOpenHanzi}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
      />

      {/* Khu vực trung tâm bàn chơi */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar space-y-4 pr-1 my-1 flex flex-col justify-center">
        {/* Đề bài: Nghĩa Tiếng Việt + Nút nghe gợi ý */}
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl bg-${mainColor}-50/70 border border-${mainColor}-100 text-center relative`}>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-1">
            {t ? t('meaning') : 'Nghĩa câu / từ mục tiêu'}
          </div>
          <div className="text-base sm:text-xl font-black text-gray-800 leading-snug break-words">
            {promptMeaning}
          </div>

          {onSpeak && targetTerm && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSpeak(targetTerm)}
              className={`mt-2.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-white text-${mainColor}-600 border border-${mainColor}-200 text-xs font-bold shadow-sm hover:bg-${mainColor}-50 transition-all active:scale-95`}
            >
              <Icons.Volume2 size={14} />
              <span>{t ? t('listenAgain') : 'Nghe phát âm'}</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Khu vực lắp ráp câu (Tap Mode) hoặc Ô gõ chữ (Type Mode) */}
        {inputMethod === 'type' ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <textarea
              ref={inputRef}
              rows={3}
              disabled={answerStatus !== null}
              value={typedAnswer}
              onChange={(e) => setTypedAnswer(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  if (answerStatus === null) onCheckAnswer();
                  else if (cooldownLeft === 0) onNextQuestion();
                }
              }}
              style={{ fontFamily }}
              placeholder="Gõ câu hoặc từ trả lời của bạn vào đây..."
              className={`w-full p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 text-base sm:text-lg font-bold outline-none resize-none transition-all ${
                answerStatus === 'correct'
                  ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-500 text-green-800'
                  : answerStatus === 'wrong'
                  ? 'bg-red-50 border-red-500 text-red-800'
                  : `bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 focus:bg-white focus:border-${mainColor}-400`
              }`}
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Khay chứa các từ đã chọn */}
            <div
              className={`min-h-[84px] p-3.5 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all ${
                answerStatus === 'correct'
                  ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-400'
                  : answerStatus === 'wrong'
                  ? 'bg-red-50 border-red-400'
                  : 'bg-gray-50/80 border-gray-300'
              }`}
            >
              {selectedTokens.length === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 italic select-none">
                  Chạm vào các mảnh từ bên dưới để ghép thành câu...
                </span>
              ) : (
                selectedTokens.map((tok, idx) => (
                  <button
                    key={tok.id}
                    type="button"
                    disabled={answerStatus !== null}
                    onClick={() => onRemoveSelectedToken(tok, idx)}
                    style={{ fontFamily }}
                    className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base shadow-sm border transition-all active:scale-95 ${
                      answerStatus === 'correct'
                        ? 'bg-green-600 text-white border-green-700'
                        : answerStatus === 'wrong'
                        ? 'bg-red-600 text-white border-red-700'
                        : `bg-white text-${mainColor}-700 border-${mainColor}-300 hover:bg-red-50 hover:border-red-300`
                    }`}
                  >
                    {tok.text}
                  </button>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Kho các mảnh từ xáo trộn bên dưới */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Các mảnh ghép khả dụng
                </span>
                {selectedTokens.length > 0 && answerStatus === null && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onClearSelected}
                    className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 flex items-center gap-1"
                  >
                    <Icons.RotateCcw size={12} /> Làm lại
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 p-2">
                {poolTokens.map((tok) => {
                  const isUsed = selectedTokens.some((s) => s.id === tok.id);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={tok.id}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isUsed || answerStatus !== null}
                      onClick={() => onSelectPoolToken(tok)}
                      style={{ fontFamily }}
                      className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base border-2 transition-all ${
                        isUsed
                          ? 'bg-gray-100 text-transparent border-gray-200 pointer-events-none scale-95'
                          : 'bg-white text-gray-800 border-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50/40 active:scale-95'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {tok.text}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Khối hiển thị Đáp án chuẩn & Phân tích Ngữ pháp sau khi kiểm tra */}
        {answerStatus !== null && (
          <div
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-left space-y-2 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 ${
              answerStatus === 'correct'
                ? 'bg-green-50/90 border-green-200 text-green-900'
                : 'bg-red-50/90 border-red-200 text-red-900'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-black text-sm">
                {answerStatus === 'correct' ? (
                  <>
                    <Icons.CheckCircle size={18} className="text-green-600" />
                    <span>{t ? t('scrambleCorrect') : 'Chính xác tuyệt đối!'}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Icons.AlertCircle size={18} className="text-red-600" />
                    <span>{t ? t('scrambleWrong') : 'Chưa chính xác!'}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>

              {onExplainGrammar && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isExplaining}
                  onClick={onExplainGrammar}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-purple-200 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <Icons.Sparkles size={13} className={isExplaining ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
                  <span>{isExplaining ? 'Đang phân tích...' : t ? t('explainBtn') : 'Giải thích'}</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm">
              <span className="font-bold opacity-75">Đáp án chuẩn: </span>
              <b style={{ fontFamily }} className="text-sm sm:text-base underline decoration-dotted">
                {targetTerm}
              </b>
            </div>

            {(grammarExplanation || originCard.analysis) && (
              <div className="p-2.5 bg-white/90 rounded-xl border border-purple-100 text-xs text-gray-700 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                <div className="font-black text-purple-700 mb-0.5 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Icons.Sparkles size={12} /> Phân tích cấu trúc:
                </div>
                {grammarExplanation || originCard.analysis}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer Nút Kiểm tra / Câu tiếp theo */}
      <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 shrink-0">
        {answerStatus === null ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onCheckAnswer}
            disabled={
              inputMethod === 'type' ? !typedAnswer.trim() : selectedTokens.length === 0
            }
            className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm sm:text-base disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700`}
          >
            <Icons.Check size={20} />
            <span>{t ? t('matchCheckBtn') : 'Kiểm tra đáp án'}</span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onNextQuestion}
            disabled={cooldownLeft > 0}
            className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-white shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm sm:text-base ${
              cooldownLeft > 0
                ? 'bg-gray-400 cursor-wait'
                : `bg-${mainColor}-600 hover:bg-${mainColor}-700`
            }`}
          >
            <span>
              {cooldownLeft > 0
                ? `Đợi nạp đạn (${cooldownLeft}s)...`
                : 'Câu tiếp theo'}
            </span>
            <Icons.ChevronRight size={20} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const ScrambleUI = {
  ScrambleSetup,
  ScrambleBoard
};

/**
 * @file src/features/games/SpotMistakeGame.jsx
 * @description Controller điều phối Mini-game Tìm Lỗi Sai (Spot Mistake) với QueueEngine & Fallback.
 * @origin Tầng 5 - Block 5.11 (Spot Mistake Game Logic)
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { pullRetryCardWithLock } from '@/services/db';
import { QueueEngine } from '@/engines/queueEngine';
import { ExamEngine } from '@/engines/exam';
import { GameAlgoEngine } from '@/engines/gameOfflineEngine';
import { FallbackDataEngine } from '@/engines/fallbackData';
import { GlobalLoadingScreen } from '@/components/common/GlobalLoadingScreen';

import {
  calculateGameScore,
  playGameSFX,
  handleExitDiscipline,
  normalizeLevelAndTopic,
  getConfiguredUiCooldown
} from './common/gameHelpers';
import { GameSummaryScreen } from './common/GameSharedUI';
import { SpotMistakeSetup, SpotMistakeBoard } from './SpotMistakeUI';

export const SpotMistakeGame = ({
  cards = [],
  lang = 'en',
  apiKey = '',
  settings = {},
  currentLevel,
  setCurrentLevel,
  currentTopic,
  setCurrentTopic,
  dataMode = 'sentence', // Mặc định Tìm lỗi sai dùng câu văn
  setDataMode,
  gameSessions = {},
  setGameSessions,
  globalRetryBag = {},
  addToRetryBag,
  removeFromRetryBag,
  onLogWrong,
  onSaveToHarvest,
  onOpenWordSelector,
  onOpenHanzi,
  speak,
  isMuted = false,
  onBack,
  onMissingKey,
  setIsGamePlaying,
  mainColor = 'blue',
  t
}) => {
  // ============================================================================
  // 1. STATE CẤU HÌNH & TRẠNG THÁI VÒNG ĐỜI GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(() => {
    const saved = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_spotmistake_config', {});
    return {
      sourceMode: cards.length >= 1 ? (saved.sourceMode || 'local') : 'ai',
      difficulty: saved.difficulty || 'normal',
      grammarId: saved.grammarId || '',
      isEndless: saved.isEndless || false,
      totalQuestions: saved.totalQuestions || 20,
      timerEnabled: saved.timerEnabled !== false,
      timeLimit: saved.timeLimit || 45
    };
  });

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('setup'); // 'setup' | 'loading' | 'playing' | 'summary'
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [correctCount, setCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(null);
  const [cooldownLeft, setCooldownLeft] = useState(0);
  const [ammoCount, setAmmoCount] = useState(0);

  // State Bàn chơi hiện tại
  const [currentCard, setCurrentCard] = useState(null);
  const [sentenceWords, setSentenceWords] = useState([]);
  const [selectedWordIndex, setSelectedWordIndex] = useState(null);
  
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);
  const [answerStatus, setAnswerStatus] = useState(null); // null | 'correct' | 'wrong'
  const [grammarExplanation, setGrammarExplanation] = useState('');
  const [isExplaining, setIsExplaining] = useState(false);

  // Refs điều phối đa luồng & logic game
  const coordinatorRef = useRef(null);
  const usedTermsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const timerRef = useRef(null);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(null);

  // Lưu cấu hình khi thay đổi
  useEffect(() => {
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_spotmistake_config', config);
  }, [config]);

  // Đồng bộ cờ đang chơi lên App
  useEffect(() => {
    if (setIsGamePlaying) {
      setIsGamePlaying(status === 'playing' || status === 'loading');
    }
    return () => {
      if (setIsGamePlaying) setIsGamePlaying(false);
    };
  }, [status, setIsGamePlaying]);

  // Quét số lượng đạn AI dự trữ mỗi 500ms
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current && coordinatorRef.current.queue) {
        const aiItems = coordinatorRef.current.queue.filter((b) => b && b.content && b.content.isAiGenerated);
        setAmmoCount(aiItems.length);
      } else {
        setAmmoCount(0);
      }
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  // Dọn dẹp khi unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. HÀM ĐÓNG GÓI BÀN CHƠI NGOẠI TUYẾN (LOCAL / FALLBACK BOARD BUILDER)
  // ============================================================================
  const buildLocalBoard = useCallback(() => {
    const validDeck = cards.filter((c) => c && c.term && c.definition);
    let selectedItem = null;

    // 1. Rút 1 thẻ từ Túi nháp lỗi sai
    const retryCard = pullRetryCardWithLock('spotmistake', globalRetryBag, lang);
    if (retryCard && retryCard.term && retryCard.definition) {
      selectedItem = retryCard;
    }

    // 2. Lấy thẻ chưa dùng trong bộ bài hiện tại
    if (!selectedItem) {
      let unusedPool = validDeck.filter((c) => !usedTermsRef.current.has(c.term));
      if (unusedPool.length === 0 && validDeck.length > 0) {
        usedTermsRef.current.clear();
        unusedPool = validDeck;
      }
      
      if (unusedPool.length > 0) {
        selectedItem = unusedPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * unusedPool.length)];
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback cứu hộ
    if (!selectedItem) {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const fallbackList = FallbackDataEngine.getGameReadyFallback('spotmistake', lang, pickedLevel, { dataMode });
      return fallbackList;
    }

    usedTermsRef.current.add(selectedItem.term || '');

    const type = Utils.detectSentence(selectedItem.term) ? 'sentence' : 'word';
    let distortedResult = null;

    // Động cơ bóp méo Offline (Sử dụng GameAlgoEngine)
    if (GameAlgoEngine?.DistortionEngine?.offline_distort) {
      try {
        distortedResult = GameAlgoEngine.DistortionEngine.offline_distort(selectedItem.term, lang, type);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("SpotMistake Offline Distortion Error:", e);
      }
    }
    
    // Fallback nếu thuật toán trên thất bại
    if (!distortedResult) {
      distortedResult = {
        wrongSentence: selectedItem.term + "x",
        wrongWord: selectedItem.term + "x",
        correction: selectedItem.term,
        explanation: "Lỗi hình thái (Dự phòng)"
      };
    }

    return {
      wrongSentence: distortedResult.wrongSentence,
      wrongWord: distortedResult.wrongWord,
      correction: distortedResult.correction,
      explanation: distortedResult.explanation || selectedItem.definition,
      origin: selectedItem,
      isAiGenerated: false
    };
  }, [cards, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, globalRetryBag, lang]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 3. HÀM TẢI ĐẠN AI CHO QUEUE COORDINATOR
  // ============================================================================
  const fetchAiQuestion = useCallback(async () => {
    const { pickedLevel, pickedTopic } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(
      currentLevel,
      currentTopic,
      lang
    );

    const meta = {
      id: `spotmistake_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      type: 'spot_mistake', // Sẽ được ánh xạ thành 'ioe_spot_mistake' trong ExamEngine
      mode: 'minigame',
      lang,
      level: pickedLevel,
      topic: pickedTopic,
      difficulty: config.difficulty,
      grammarId: config.grammarId,
      dataMode
    };

    const hydrated = await ExamEngine.hydrateQuestion(meta, apiKey);
    if (hydrated && hydrated.content) {
      if (onSaveToHarvest && hydrated.isNewHarvest) {
        onSaveToHarvest(pickedLevel, hydrated.content.origin || hydrated.content);
      }
      return hydrated;
    }
    throw new Error('Dữ liệu SpotMistake AI trả về rỗng.');
  }, [apiKey, config.difficulty, config.grammarId, currentLevel, currentTopic, dataMode, lang, onSaveToHarvest]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 4. NẠP BÀN CHƠI MỚI & ĐỒNG HỒ ĐẾM NGƯỢC
  // ============================================================================
  const startCooldownIfNeeded = useCallback((isAiRound) => {
    if (cooldownRef.current) clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
    if (!isAiRound) {
      setCooldownLeft(0);
      return;
    }
    const cdSec = getConfiguredUiCooldown(9);
    setCooldownLeft(cdSec);
    cooldownRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCooldownLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(cooldownRef.current);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
  }, []);

  const parseSentenceToWords = (sentenceStr, targetLang) => {
    if (!sentenceStr) return [];
    
    if (targetLang === 'zh') {
      // Tiếng Trung: băm theo từng ký tự, lọc bỏ khoảng trắng
      return Array.from(sentenceStr).map((char, idx) => ({
        id: `w_${idx}`,
        original: char,
        display: char
      })).filter(item => item.original.trim() !== '');
    } else {
      // Tiếng Anh: băm theo khoảng trắng
      return sentenceStr.split(' ').map((word, idx) => ({
        id: `w_${idx}`,
        original: word,
        display: word
      })).filter(item => item.original.trim() !== '');
    }
  };

  const loadQuestionBoard = useCallback(
    (targetIndex) => {
      let nextData = null;

      if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && coordinatorRef.current) {
        nextData = coordinatorRef.current.pop();
      }

      let qContent = null;
      if (nextData && nextData.content) {
        qContent = nextData.content;
      } else {
        if (config.sourceMode === 'ai' && window.globalShowToast && targetIndex > 0) {
          window.globalShowToast('Đang dùng dữ liệu dự phòng trong lúc đợi AI nạp đạn...', 'warning');
        }
        qContent = buildLocalBoard();
      }

      setCurrentCard(qContent);
      
      // Phân tách câu sai thành các mảnh chữ có thể click
      const words = parseSentenceToWords(qContent.wrongSentence, lang);
      setSentenceWords(words);
      
      setSelectedWordIndex(null);
      setIsChecked(false);
      setAnswerStatus(null);
      setGrammarExplanation('');
      setIsExplaining(false);
      
      setTimeLeft(config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null);
      startCooldownIfNeeded(config.sourceMode === 'ai');
    },
    [buildLocalBoard, config.sourceMode, config.timeLimit, config.timerEnabled, lang, startCooldownIfNeeded]
  );

  // Đồng hồ đếm ngược
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'playing' || !config.timerEnabled || isChecked || timeLeft === null) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev === null) return null;
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
          setStreak(0);
          setIsChecked(true);
          setAnswerStatus('wrong');
          
          if (currentCard?.origin) {
            if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
            if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('spotmistake', currentCard.origin);
          }
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [status, config.timerEnabled, isChecked, timeLeft, isMuted, currentCard, onLogWrong, addToRetryBag]);

  // ============================================================================
  // 5. KHỞI ĐỘNG GAME & KHÔI PHỤC PHIÊN CHƠI
  // ============================================================================
  const handleStartGame = () => {
    usedTermsRef.current.clear();
    setCurrentIndex(0);
    setScore(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setCorrectCount(0);

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();

    if (config.sourceMode === 'ai') {
      coordinatorRef.current = QueueEngine.createQueueCoordinator(fetchAiQuestion, 4);
      setStatus('loading');
      coordinatorRef.current.maintain(true, 22000, false);
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleLoadingComplete = useCallback(() => {
    loadQuestionBoard(0);
    setStatus('playing');
  }, [loadQuestionBoard]);

  const handleResumeSession = () => {
    const saved = gameSessions?.spotmistake;
    if (!saved) return;

    if (saved.config) setConfig(saved.config);
    setCurrentIndex(saved.currentIndex || 0);
    setScore(saved.score || 0);
    setStreak(saved.streak || 0);
    setCorrectCount(saved.correctCount || 0);

    if (saved.currentCard) {
      setCurrentCard(saved.currentCard);
      setSentenceWords(saved.sentenceWords || []);
      setSelectedWordIndex(saved.selectedWordIndex ?? null);
      setIsChecked(saved.isChecked || false);
      setAnswerStatus(saved.answerStatus || null);
      setTimeLeft(saved.timeLeft ?? (config.timerEnabled ? config.timeLimit : null));
      setStatus('playing');
    } else {
      loadQuestionBoard(saved.currentIndex || 0);
      setStatus('playing');
    }
  };

  const handleClearSession = () => {
    if (setGameSessions) {
      setGameSessions((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next.spotmistake;
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 6. XỬ LÝ TƯƠNG TÁC (CHỌN TỪ & KIỂM TRA)
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSelectWord = (index) => {
    if (isChecked) return;
    playGameSFX('click', isMuted);
    setSelectedWordIndex(index);
  };

  const handleCheckAnswer = () => {
    if (isChecked || selectedWordIndex === null || !currentCard) return;

    setIsChecked(true);
    
    const selectedWordObj = sentenceWords[selectedWordIndex];
    if (!selectedWordObj) return;

    const targetWrongWord = currentCard.wrongWord || '';
    
    // Kiểm tra xem từ được chọn có chứa từ bị sai không (Fuzzy match nhẹ)
    const isCorrect = targetWrongWord && selectedWordObj.original.toLowerCase().includes(targetWrongWord.toLowerCase());

    if (isCorrect) {
      playGameSFX('correct', isMuted);
      setAnswerStatus('correct');
      const nextStreak = streak + 1;
      const points = calculateGameScore(100, timeLeft || 0, nextStreak, config.difficulty);
      setStreak(nextStreak);
      setScore(prev => prev + points);
      setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1);
      
      const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.wrongSentence || '';
      if (removeFromRetryBag) removeFromRetryBag('spotmistake', targetTerm);
      
    } else {
      playGameSFX('wrong', isMuted);
      setAnswerStatus('wrong');
      setStreak(0);
      if (currentCard.origin) {
        if (onLogWrong) onLogWrong(currentCard.origin);
        if (addToRetryBag) addToRetryBag('spotmistake', currentCard.origin);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleExplainGrammar = async () => {
    if (isExplaining || grammarExplanation) return;
    if (!apiKey) {
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Cần API Key để phân tích!", "warning");
      return;
    }

    setIsExplaining(true);
    try {
      const { pickedLevel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
      const targetTerm = currentCard.correction ? currentCard.wrongSentence.replace(currentCard.wrongWord, currentCard.correction) : (currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.wrongSentence);
      
      const res = await Utils.fillCardWithAi(targetTerm, lang, apiKey, ['analysis'], dataMode, [pickedLevel]);
      if (res && res.analysis) {
        setGrammarExplanation(res.analysis);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast("Lỗi phân tích: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setIsExplaining(false);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 7. CHUYỂN CÂU & THOÁT GAME
  // ============================================================================
  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    if (cooldownLeft > 0) return;

    if (!config.isEndless && currentIndex >= config.totalQuestions - 1) {
      handleClearSession();
      if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
      setStatus('summary');
      return;
    }

    const nextIdx = currentIndex + 1;
    setCurrentIndex(nextIdx);
    loadQuestionBoard(nextIdx);
  };

  const handleExitGame = () => {
    if (status === 'playing' && !isChecked) {
      handleExitDiscipline({
        isPlaying: true,
        isAnswered: false,
        currentCard: currentCard?.origin || currentCard,
        gameType: 'spotmistake',
        onLogWrong,
        addToRetryBag
      });

      if (setGameSessions) {
        setGameSessions((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          spotmistake: {
            config,
            currentIndex,
            score,
            streak,
            correctCount,
            currentCard,
            sentenceWords,
            selectedWordIndex,
            isChecked,
            answerStatus,
            timeLeft,
            timestamp: Date.now()
          }
        }));
      }
    }

    if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
    setStatus('setup');
  };

  const handleSaveCurrentWord = () => {
    if (!onOpenWordSelector || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.origin?.term || currentCard.wrongSentence;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenWordSelector(targetTerm);
  };

  const handleOpenHanziCurrent = () => {
    if (!onOpenHanzi || !currentCard) return;
    const targetTerm = currentCard.wrongSentence || currentCard.origin?.term;
    if (targetTerm) onOpenHanzi(targetTerm);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // 8. RENDER THEO TRẠNG THÁI
  // ============================================================================
  if (status === 'loading') {
    const { levelLabel } = normalizeLevelAndTopic(currentLevel, currentTopic, lang);
    return (
      <GlobalLoadingScreen
        engine={coordinatorRef.current}
        onComplete={handleLoadingComplete}
        onCancel={() => {
          if (coordinatorRef.current) coordinatorRef.current.destroy();
          setStatus('setup');
        }}
        text="AI Đang Tạo Câu Hỏi Tìm Lỗi Sai..."
        subText="Đang chọn vị trí đục lỗ và cấy ghép lỗi ngữ pháp"
        mainColor={mainColor}
        levelStr={levelLabel}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'summary') {
    return (
      <GameSummaryScreen
        score={score}
        correctCount={correctCount}
        totalQuestions={currentIndex + 1}
        onRestart={handleStartGame}
        onBack={onBack}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  if (status === 'playing') {
    return (
      <SpotMistakeBoard
        currentIndex={currentIndex}
        totalQuestions={config.totalQuestions}
        isEndless={config.isEndless}
        score={score}
        streak={streak}
        timeLeft={timeLeft}
        ammoCount={ammoCount}
        isAiSource={config.sourceMode === 'ai'}
        currentCard={currentCard}
        sentenceWords={sentenceWords}
        selectedWordIndex={selectedWordIndex}
        isChecked={isChecked}
        answerStatus={answerStatus}
        grammarExplanation={grammarExplanation}
        isExplaining={isExplaining}
        cooldownLeft={cooldownLeft}
        onSelectWord={handleSelectWord}
        onCheckAnswer={handleCheckAnswer}
        onNextQuestion={handleNextQuestion}
        onExplainGrammar={handleExplainGrammar}
        onSpeak={speak}
        onSaveWord={handleSaveCurrentWord}
        onOpenHanzi={handleOpenHanziCurrent}
        onExit={handleExitGame}
        fontFamily={Utils.getFontFamily(settings)}
        lang={lang}
        mainColor={mainColor}
        t={t}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <SpotMistakeSetup
      config={config}
      setConfig={setConfig}
      cardsCount={cards.length}
      lang={lang}
      currentLevel={currentLevel}
      setCurrentLevel={setCurrentLevel}
      currentTopic={currentTopic}
      setCurrentTopic={setCurrentTopic}
      dataMode={dataMode}
      setDataMode={setDataMode}
      savedSession={gameSessions?.spotmistake}
      onResumeSession={handleResumeSession}
      onClearSession={handleClearSession}
      onStartGame={handleStartGame}
      onBack={onBack}
      onMissingKey={onMissingKey}
      mainColor={mainColor}
      t={t}
    />
  );
};

=========================================
FILE: src\features\games\SpotMistakeUI.jsx
