  // Hanzi Toggles
  const [showHanziSelector, setShowHanziSelector] = useState(false);
  const [showHanziWriter, setShowHanziWriter] = useState(false);
  const [currentHanziChar, setCurrentHanziChar] = useState('');
  const [wordSelectTarget, setWordSelectTarget] = useState('');
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [isAiLoading, setIsAiLoading] = useState(false);

  // AI Modes & Pending Actions
  const [isAiModeLearn, setIsAiModeLearn] = useState(false);
  const [isAiModeGame, setIsAiModeGame] = useState(false);
  const [resetPending, setResetPending] = useState(false);

  // URLs
  const [exportUrl, setExportUrl] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.EXPORT_URL || 'fc_export_url') || "");
  const [apiKeySheetUrl, setApiKeySheetUrl] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.API_KEY_SHEET || 'fc_apikey_sheet') || "");
  const [importUrl, setImportUrl] = useState('');
  const [defaultUrl, setDefaultUrl] = useState('');

  // Playback & Game State
  const [currentCardIndex, setCurrentCardIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isFlipped, setIsFlipped] = useState(false);
  const [isAutoPlaying, setIsAutoPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isShuffle, setIsShuffle] = useState(false);
  const [isAutoMode, setIsAutoMode] = useState(false);
  const [isFlipLocked, setIsFlipLocked] = useState(false);
  const [isGamePlaying, setIsGamePlaying] = useState(false);

  // Quản lý Sessions đa ngôn ngữ
  const [globalGameSessions, setGlobalGameSessions] = useState(() => {
    const data = Utils.safeJsonParse('fc_game_sessions', {});
    if (data && (data.quiz || data.match || data.scramble)) return {};
    return data;
  });

  // Proxy các biến state cho riêng ngôn ngữ hiện tại
  const gameSessions = globalGameSessions[lang] || {};
  const setGameSessions = (updater) => {
    setGlobalGameSessions(prev => {
      const currentLangSessions = prev[lang] || {};
      const nextLangSessions = typeof updater === 'function' ? updater(currentLangSessions) : updater;
      return { ...prev, [lang]: nextLangSessions };
    });
  };

  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(() => Utils.safeJsonParse(STORAGE_KEYS.SETTINGS || 'fc_settings', DEFAULT_SETTINGS));
  const [voices, setVoices] = useState([]);
  const [isContentHidden, setIsContentHidden] = useState(false);
  const [isBatterySaverMode, setIsBatterySaverMode] = useState(false);

  // --- REFS ---
  const audioTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
  const autoPlayTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
  const processingCardsRef = useRef(new Set());
  const resetTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
  const aiQueueRef = useRef([]);
  const isAiQueueProcessing = useRef(false);

  // --- INITIALIZATION EFFECTS ---

  // ĐỘNG CƠ KHỞI TẠO CƠ SỞ DỮ LIỆU (INDEXEDDB INIT)
  useEffect(() => {
    const initPersistence = async () => {
      if (!FcDB) {
        console.error('[CoreState] FcDB not found');
        setIsDbReady(true);
        return;
      }
      try {
        await FcDB.init();
        const pool = await FcDB.get('fc_ai_harvest_pool');
        if (pool) setAiHarvestPool(pool);
        
        try {
          const viKeys = ['fc_data_vi', 'fc_current_level_vi', 'fc_current_topic_vi', 'fc_master_data_vi_vocab', 'fc_master_data_vi_sentence', 'fc_ai_memory_vi'];
          viKeys.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));
          await FcDB.set('fc_notebook_vi', []);
          await FcDB.set('fc_mastered_vi', []);
          const incorrectKey = STORAGE_KEYS.INCORRECT_LIST ? STORAGE_KEYS.INCORRECT_LIST + '_vi' : 'fc_incorrect_list_vi';
          await FcDB.set(incorrectKey, []);
          await FcDB.set('fc_global_retry_bag_vi', {});
        } catch(err) {
          console.warn('[CoreState] Silenced Cleanup Error:', err);
        }
        
        setIsDbReady(true);
        console.log('[CoreState] IndexedDB ready. Vietnamese deprecated.');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[CoreState] IndexedDB Init Error:', e);
        setIsDbReady(true);
      }
    };
    initPersistence();
  }, []);

  // 1. Load Fonts
  useEffect(() => {
    const googleId = 'fc-google-fonts';
    const googleUrl = 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Long+Cang&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@400;700&display=swap';
    const kaitiId = 'fc-kaiti-font';
    const kaitiUrl = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lxgw-wenkai-lite-webfont@1.7.0/style.css';
    loadFont(googleId, googleUrl);
    loadFont(kaitiId, kaitiUrl);
  }, []);

  // 2. Load Voices
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadVoices = () => {
      if (window.speechSynthesis) {
        setVoices(window.speechSynthesis.getVoices());
      }
    };
    loadVoices();
    if (window.speechSynthesis) {
      window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = loadVoices;
    }
  }, []);

  // Lưu UI Lang riêng biệt
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.UI_LANG || 'fc_ui_lang', JSON.stringify(uiLang));
  }, [uiLang]);

  // 3. EFFECT: Đổi Ngôn Ngữ -> Tải các Sổ tay, Túi Nháp và Khởi tạo Level
  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LANG || 'fc_lang', JSON.stringify(lang));
    
    const loadUserData = async () => {
      if (isDbReady && FcDB) {
        const savedNote = await FcDB.get('fc_notebook_' + lang) || [];
        const savedMaster = await FcDB.get('fc_mastered_' + lang) || [];
        const savedIncorrect = await FcDB.get((STORAGE_KEYS.INCORRECT_LIST || 'fc_incorrect_list') + '_' + lang) || [];
        const savedRetryBag = await FcDB.get('fc_global_retry_bag_' + lang) || {};
        setNotebook(savedNote);
        setMastered(savedMaster);
        setIncorrectList(savedIncorrect);
        setGlobalRetryBag(savedRetryBag);
      }
    };
    loadUserData();
    
    // Cầu dao bảo vệ: Chỉ reset các trạng thái khi THỰC SỰ đổi ngôn ngữ
    if (prevLangRef.current !== lang) {
      setCurrentCardIndex(0);
      setIsStudyingNotebook(false);
      setStudySourceName(null);
      aiQueueRef.current = [];
      localStorage.removeItem('fc_ai_memory');
      
      if (ExamEngine && typeof ExamEngine.clearVolatileMemory === 'function') {
        ExamEngine.clearVolatileMemory();
      }
      if (Utils && Utils.AiMemoryManager && typeof Utils.AiMemoryManager.clear === 'function') {
        Utils.AiMemoryManager.clear();
      }
      
      const defLvl = lang === 'zh' ? ['zh_level_1'] : ['en_level_4'];
      setCurrentLevel(parseArrayStorage('fc_current_level_' + lang, defLvl));
      setCurrentTopic(parseArrayStorage('fc_current_topic_' + lang, []));
      
      prevLangRef.current = lang;
    }
  }, [lang, isDbReady]);

  // ĐỘNG CƠ "VÒI NƯỚC" - ĐỒNG BỘ DỮ LIỆU ĐA CHIỀU (MULTI-SELECT MATRIX)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStudyingNotebook || studySourceName) return;
    
    const storageKey = `fc_master_data_${lang}_${dataMode}`;
    const masterData = Utils.safeJsonParse(storageKey, null);
    
    let targetCards = [];
    if (masterData) {
      // Cưỡng chế Mảng, đề phòng lỗi State bất thường
      const levelsArr = Array.isArray(currentLevel) ? currentLevel : (currentLevel ? [currentLevel] : []);
      const topicsArr = Array.isArray(currentTopic) ? currentTopic : (currentTopic ? [currentTopic] : []);
      
      // BƯỚC 1: Lọc theo Level - Gộp các mảng lại với nhau
      if (levelsArr.length === 0) {
        Object.values(masterData).forEach(arr => {
          if (Array.isArray(arr)) targetCards = targetCards.concat(arr);
        });
      } else {
        levelsArr.forEach(lv => {
          if (masterData[lv] && Array.isArray(masterData[lv])) {
            targetCards = targetCards.concat(masterData[lv]);
          }
        });
      }
      
      // BƯỚC 2: Lọc theo Topic
      if (topicsArr.length > 0) {
        targetCards = targetCards.filter(c => topicsArr.includes(c.topic));
      }
    }
    
    // Bơm vào màn hình và đồng bộ Storage
    if (targetCards.length > 0) {
      setCards(targetCards);
      Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_data_' + lang, targetCards);
      setCurrentCardIndex(0);
    } else {
      setCards([]);
      Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_data_' + lang, []);
      setCurrentCardIndex(0);
    }
  }, [lang, dataMode, currentLevel, currentTopic, isStudyingNotebook, studySourceName]);

  // 4. Persistence Effects
  useEffect(() => { if (toast) { const t = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000); return () => clearTimeout(t); } }, [toast]);
  useEffect(() => { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SETTINGS || 'fc_settings', JSON.stringify(settings)); }, [settings]);
  useEffect(() => { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.API_KEY || 'fc_apikey', apiKey); }, [apiKey]);
  useEffect(() => { Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_game_sessions', globalGameSessions); }, [globalGameSessions]);
  
  // SYSTEM LOGS PERSISTENCE
  useEffect(() => { Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_system_logs', systemLogs); }, [systemLogs]);
  
  // AI CONFIG PERSISTENCE
  useEffect(() => { Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_ai_config', aiConfig); }, [aiConfig]);
  
  // AI MODEL PERSISTENCE
  useEffect(() => { localStorage.setItem('fc_ai_model', aiModel); }, [aiModel]);
  
  // LAYOUT ALIGN PERSISTENCE
  useEffect(() => { localStorage.setItem('fc_layout_align', layoutAlign); }, [layoutAlign]);

  // LƯU TRỮ TRÊN INDEXEDDB (ASYNC)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDbReady && FcDB) FcDB.set('fc_ai_harvest_pool', aiHarvestPool);
  }, [aiHarvestPool, isDbReady]);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDbReady && FcDB) FcDB.set('fc_global_retry_bag_' + lang, globalRetryBag);
  }, [globalRetryBag, isDbReady, lang]);

  useEffect(() => { Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_data_mode', dataMode); }, [dataMode]);
  useEffect(() => { Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_current_level_' + lang, currentLevel); }, [currentLevel, lang]);
  useEffect(() => { Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_current_topic_' + lang, currentTopic); }, [currentTopic, lang]);

  // 5. Shuffle Effect
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isShuffle && cards.length > 1) {
      setCards(prev => Utils.shuffleArray([...prev]));
      setCurrentCardIndex(0);
    }
  }, [isShuffle]);

  // 6. Auto-load API Key
  useEffect(() => {
    const savedSheetUrl = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.API_KEY_SHEET || 'fc_apikey_sheet');
    if (savedSheetUrl && savedSheetUrl.trim().length > 5) {
      Utils.fetchWithFallback(savedSheetUrl)
        .then(res => res.text())
        .then(text => {
          const keys = text.split(/[\n,]/).map(k => k.trim()).filter(k => k.length > 20 && !k.includes(' '));
          if (keys.length > 0) {
            Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_apikey_pool', keys);
            setApiKey(keys[0]);
            console.log(`[System] Auto-set API Key from Sheet (Pool size: ${keys.length})`);
            if (window.globalShowToast) window.globalShowToast(`Đã cập nhật ${keys.length} API Key từ Sheet`, "success");
          }
        })
        .catch(e => console.warn("Auto load API Key failed:", e));
    }
  }, []);

  return {
    // State
    viewMode, lang, uiLang, cards, notebook, mastered, masteredCount: mastered.length, isStudyingNotebook,
    incorrectList, studySourceName, apiKey, totalTokens, aiHarvestPool, globalRetryBag, systemLogs,
    isDbReady, aiConfig, aiModel, layoutAlign,
    
    // Multi-dimensional State
    dataMode, setDataMode,
    currentLevel, setCurrentLevel,
    currentTopic, setCurrentTopic,
    
    // UI Toggles
    showSettings, showApiKeyModal, showNotebook, showManual, showLinkManager, showWordSelect, showMastered, showIncorrectModal,
    showAiChat, showHelp, showSaveLoadModal, showHanziSelector, showHanziWriter, currentHanziChar, showExamPoolManager, showAiConfigModal,
    wordSelectTarget, toast, isAiLoading, isAiModeLearn, isAiModeGame, resetPending,
    importUrl, defaultUrl, exportUrl, apiKeySheetUrl,
    
    // Playback & Game State
    currentCardIndex, isFlipped, isAutoPlaying, isShuffle, isAutoMode, isFlipLocked,
    isMuted, isGamePlaying, settings, voices, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, isContentHidden, isBatterySaverMode, gameSessions,
    
    // Setters
    setViewMode, setLang, setUiLang, setCards, setNotebook, setMastered, setIsStudyingNotebook,
    setIncorrectList, setStudySourceName, setApiKey, setTotalTokens, setAiHarvestPool, setGlobalRetryBag, setSystemLogs, setAiConfig, setAiModel, setLayoutAlign,
    setShowSettings, setShowApiKeyModal, setShowNotebook, setShowManual, setShowLinkManager, setShowWordSelect, setShowMastered, setShowIncorrectModal,
    setShowAiChat, setShowHelp, setShowSaveLoadModal, setShowHanziSelector, setShowHanziWriter, setCurrentHanziChar, setShowExamPoolManager, setShowAiConfigModal,
    setWordSelectTarget, setToast, setIsAiLoading, setIsAiModeLearn, setIsAiModeGame, setResetPending,
    setImportUrl, setDefaultUrl, setExportUrl, setApiKeySheetUrl,
    setCurrentCardIndex, setIsFlipped, setIsAutoPlaying, setIsShuffle, setIsAutoMode, setIsFlipLocked,
    setIsMuted, setIsGamePlaying, setSettings, setIsContentHidden, setIsBatterySaverMode, setGameSessions,
    
    // Refs
    audioTimeoutRef, autoPlayTimeoutRef, processingCardsRef, resetTimeoutRef, aiQueueRef, isAiQueueProcessing
  };
};

FILE: src\hooks\useDataIO.js

/**
 * @file src/hooks/useDataIO.js
 * @description "Người vận chuyển" (The Porter). Chuyên trách nạp/xuất dữ liệu, quản lý file system và dọn rác bộ nhớ.
 * @origin Tầng 6 - Block 6.3 (Data I/O & Persistence)
 */

import React from 'react';
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import { Utils } from '@/utils/helpers';
import { FcDB } from '@/services/db';
import { STORAGE_KEYS, DEFAULT_SHEETS, DEFAULT_API_KEY_SHEET } from '@/config/constants';

export const useDataIO = (core, latestStateRef, callbacks) => {
  const { t, showToast } = callbacks;
  const { lang } = core;

  // ==================================================================================
  // 1. HỆ THỐNG DỌN RÁC BỘ NHỚ (GARBAGE COLLECTION)
  // ==================================================================================
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const runGarbageCollector = () => {
      try {
        const now = Date.now();
        const THREE_DAYS = 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        let hasChanges = false;
        let totalSize = 0;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
          const key = localStorage.key(i);
          totalSize += (localStorage.getItem(key) || '').length;
        }
        
        // Nếu dung lượng vượt ngưỡng 4MB, kích hoạt chế độ khẩn cấp
        const isEmergency = totalSize > 4 * 1024 * 1024;
        const sessionsStr = localStorage.getItem('fc_game_sessions');
        
        if (sessionsStr) {
          let sessions = JSON.parse(sessionsStr);
          let sessionChanged = false;
          
          if (isEmergency) {
            sessions = {};
            sessionChanged = true;
          } else {
            Object.keys(sessions).forEach(langKey => {
              const langSessions = sessions[langKey];
              Object.keys(langSessions).forEach(gameType => {
                const session = langSessions[gameType];
                if (now - session.timestamp > THREE_DAYS) {
                  delete langSessions[gameType];
                  sessionChanged = true;
                }
              });
              if (Object.keys(langSessions).length === 0) {
                delete sessions[langKey];
                sessionChanged = true;
              }
            });
          }
          if (sessionChanged) {
            localStorage.setItem('fc_game_sessions', JSON.stringify(sessions));
            hasChanges = true;
          }
        }
        
        const chatStr = localStorage.getItem('fc_ai_chat_history');
        if (chatStr) {
          let chatHistory = JSON.parse(chatStr);
          if (isEmergency) {
            chatHistory = chatHistory.slice(-1);
            localStorage.setItem('fc_ai_chat_history', JSON.stringify(chatHistory));
            hasChanges = true;
          } else if (chatHistory.length > 20) {
            chatHistory = chatHistory.slice(-20);
            localStorage.setItem('fc_ai_chat_history', JSON.stringify(chatHistory));
            hasChanges = true;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Garbage Collector Failed:", e);
      }
    };
    
    const gcTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      runGarbageCollector();
    }, 2000);
    
    return () => clearTimeout(gcTimer);
  }, []);

  // ==================================================================================
  // 2. CÁC HÀM TIỆN ÍCH FILE SYSTEM
  // ==================================================================================
  const secureCopy = (text) => {
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
        .then(() => showToast(t('syncSuccess')))
        .catch(() => fallbackCopy(text));
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(text);
    }
  };

  const fallbackCopy = (text) => {
    try {
      const textArea = document.createElement("textarea");
      textArea.value = text;
      textArea.style.position = "fixed";
      textArea.style.left = "-9999px";
      textArea.style.top = "0";
      document.body.appendChild(textArea);
      textArea.focus();
      textArea.select();
      const successful = document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textArea);
      
      if (successful) {
        showToast(t('syncSuccess'));
      } else {
        showToast("Trình duyệt chặn copy. Hãy copy thủ công.", "error");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("Lỗi copy: " + err, "error");
    }
  };

  // ==================================================================================
  // 3. ĐỘNG CƠ TẢI DỮ LIỆU GOOGLE SHEETS (PROXY & GVIZ)
  // ==================================================================================
  // Cách 1: Tải qua Proxy (Lấy toàn bộ file Excel nguyên khối)
  const safeFetchExcel = async (url) => {
    let cleanUrl = url.trim();
    const match = cleanUrl.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
    if (!match) throw new Error("Link không hợp lệ. Không tìm thấy ID của Google Sheet.");
    const sheetId = match[1];
    const exportUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetId}/export?format=xlsx`;
    const cacheBuster = `&cb=${Date.now()}`;
    
    // [V1.02 FIX] Mạng lưới 7 Node Proxy bọc thép xuyên thủng CORS file://
    const proxies = [
      { name: "Direct", url: exportUrl },
      { name: "AllOrigins", url: `https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=${encodeURIComponent(exportUrl + cacheBuster)}` },
      { name: "CorsProxyIO", url: `https://corsproxy.io/?${encodeURIComponent(exportUrl + cacheBuster)}` },
      { name: "ThingProxy", url: `https://thingproxy.freeboard.io/fetch/${exportUrl}` },
      { name: "CodeTabs", url: `https://api.codetabs.com/v1/proxy?quest=${encodeURIComponent(exportUrl)}` },
      { name: "CorsAnywhere", url: `https://cors-anywhere.herokuapp.com/${exportUrl}` },
      { name: "CorsSH", url: `https://proxy.cors.sh/${exportUrl}` }
    ];
    
    let lastErr = null;
    for (const proxy of proxies) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(proxy.url);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
        const buffer = await res.arrayBuffer();
        if (buffer.byteLength < 100) throw new Error("File quá nhỏ, lỗi chặn kết nối.");
        
        const header = new Uint8Array(buffer).subarray(0, 2);
        if (header[0] !== 0x50 || header[1] !== 0x4B) {
          throw new Error("LỖI QUYỀN TRUY CẬP: Hãy chắc chắn Link Google Sheet của bạn đã bật quyền 'Bất kỳ ai có liên kết' (Anyone with the link).");
        }
        return buffer;
      } catch (e) {
        lastErr = e;
        console.warn(`[Excel Proxy Fallback] ${proxy.name} thất bại, thử node tiếp theo...`);
        if (e.message.includes("LỖI QUYỀN TRUY CẬP")) throw e;
      }
    }
    throw new Error("Mạng bị chặn Proxy. Sẽ tự động chuyển sang GViz...");
  };

  // Cách 2 (Tuyệt chiêu): Quét từng Tab trực tiếp bằng Google GViz (Bỏ qua Proxy)
  const fetchDirectGvizTabs = async (sheetId, lang) => {
    let allNewItems = [];
    let masterDataObj = {};
    let total = 0;
    
    const levelPrefix = lang === 'zh' ? 'zh_level_' : 'en_level_';
    const fetchTab = async (sheetName) => {
      const encodedName = encodeURIComponent(sheetName);
      const gvizUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=${encodedName}`;
      try {
        const res = await Utils.fetchWithFallback(gvizUrl);
        if (!res) return null;
        const text = await res.text();
        if (text.trim().startsWith('<')) return null;
        return Utils.parseAndMapCSV(text);
      } catch(e) { return null; }
    };
    
    for (let i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
      const possibleNames = [`Level0${i}`, `Level ${i}`, `Level${i}`, `Sheet${i}`];
      for (const sheetName of possibleNames) {
        const parsedCards = await fetchTab(sheetName);
        if (parsedCards && parsedCards.length > 0) {
          masterDataObj[`${levelPrefix}${i}`] = parsedCards;
          total += parsedCards.length;
          allNewItems = allNewItems.concat(parsedCards);
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (total === 0) {
      const defaultTabs = ["Trang tính 1", "Sheet 1", "Sheet1", "Data"];
      for (const sheetName of defaultTabs) {
        const parsedCards = await fetchTab(sheetName);
        if (parsedCards && parsedCards.length > 0) {
          masterDataObj[`${levelPrefix}1`] = parsedCards;
          total += parsedCards.length;
          allNewItems = allNewItems.concat(parsedCards);
          break;
        }
      }
      
      if (total === 0) {
        const gvizUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv`;
        try {
          const res = await Utils.fetchWithFallback(gvizUrl);
          if (res) {
            const text = await res.text();
            if (!text.trim().startsWith('<')) {
              const parsedCards = Utils.parseAndMapCSV(text);
              if (parsedCards && parsedCards.length > 0) {
                masterDataObj[`${levelPrefix}1`] = parsedCards;
                total += parsedCards.length;
                allNewItems = allNewItems.concat(parsedCards);
              }
            }
          }
        } catch(e) {}
      }
    }
    
    return { masterData: masterDataObj, totalCards: total, flatItems: allNewItems };
  };

  // ==================================================================================
  // 4. IMPORT / EXPORT ĐA TẦNG (MULTI-DIMENSIONAL DATA SYNC)
  // ==================================================================================
  const handleImport = async (url, sourceType = 'vocab') => {
    if (!url) { showToast("Vui lòng nhập URL!", "error"); return; }
    core.setIsAiLoading(true);
    
    try {
      let masterData = {};
      let totalCards = 0;
      const levelPrefix = lang === 'zh' ? 'zh_level_' : 'en_level_';
      
      if (url.includes('docs.google.com')) {
        const match = url.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
        if (!match) throw new Error("Link không hợp lệ. Không tìm thấy ID của Google Sheet.");
        const sheetId = match[1];
        let useGvizFallback = false;
        
        try {
          const buffer = await safeFetchExcel(url);
          const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: 'array' });
          const numTabs = Math.min(workbook.SheetNames.length, 9);
          
          for (let i = 0; i < numTabs; i++) {
            const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[i];
            const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(workbook.Sheets[sheetName], { header: 1 });
            const parsedCards = Utils.convertRawRowsToCards(rows);
            if (parsedCards.length > 0) {
              const matchLvl = sheetName.match(/\d+/);
              const levelNum = matchLvl ? parseInt(matchLvl[0], 10) : (i + 1);
              masterData[`${levelPrefix}${levelNum}`] = parsedCards;
              totalCards += parsedCards.length;
            }
          }
        } catch (err) {
          if (err.message.includes("LỖI QUYỀN TRUY CẬP")) throw err;
          console.warn("Proxy XLSX Failed, fallback to GViz:", err.message);
          useGvizFallback = true;
        }
        
        if (useGvizFallback) {
          showToast("Mạng đang chặn Proxy, chuyển sang kết nối trực tiếp Google...", "info");
          const { masterData: gvizData, totalCards: gvizTotal } = await fetchDirectGvizTabs(sheetId, lang);
          if (gvizTotal > 0) {
            masterData = gvizData;
            totalCards = gvizTotal;
          } else {
            throw new Error("Không thể tải file (File chưa được chia sẻ Public).");
          }
        }
      } else if (url.endsWith('.xlsx')) {
        const res = await Utils.fetchWithFallback(url);
        const arrayBuffer = await res.arrayBuffer();
        const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });
        const numTabs = Math.min(workbook.SheetNames.length, 9);
        
        for (let i = 0; i < numTabs; i++) {
          const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[i];
          const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(workbook.Sheets[sheetName], { header: 1 });
          const parsedCards = Utils.convertRawRowsToCards(rows);
          if (parsedCards.length > 0) {
            const match = sheetName.match(/\d+/);
            const levelNum = match ? parseInt(match[0], 10) : (i + 1);
            masterData[`${levelPrefix}${levelNum}`] = parsedCards;
            totalCards += parsedCards.length;
          }
        }
      } else {
        const res = await Utils.fetchWithFallback(url);
        const text = await res.text();
        const parsedCards = Utils.parseAndMapCSV(text);
        if (parsedCards.length > 0) {
          masterData[`${levelPrefix}1`] = parsedCards;
          totalCards = parsedCards.length;
        }
      }
      
      if (totalCards > 0) {
        const storageKey = `fc_master_data_${lang}_${sourceType}`;
        Utils.safeLocalStorageSet(storageKey, masterData);
        const firstLevelKey = `${levelPrefix}1`;
        if (masterData[firstLevelKey]) {
          core.setCards(masterData[firstLevelKey]);
        }
        showToast(`Đã nạp thành công ${totalCards} thẻ!`, "success");
        core.setShowLinkManager(false);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Không tìm thấy dữ liệu hợp lệ");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      showToast("Lỗi nạp Dữ liệu: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      core.setIsAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleImportToNotebook = async (url) => {
    if (!url) { showToast("Vui lòng nhập URL!", "error"); return; }
    core.setIsAiLoading(true);
    
    try {
      let allNewItems = [];
      if (url.includes('docs.google.com')) {
        const match = url.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
        if (!match) throw new Error("Link không hợp lệ.");
        const sheetId = match[1];
        let useGvizFallback = false;
        
        try {
          const buffer = await safeFetchExcel(url);
          const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: 'array' });
          for (let i = 0; i < workbook.SheetNames.length; i++) {
            const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[i];
            const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(workbook.Sheets[sheetName], { header: 1 });
            const parsedCards = Utils.convertRawRowsToCards(rows);
            allNewItems = allNewItems.concat(parsedCards);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          if (err.message.includes("LỖI QUYỀN TRUY CẬP")) throw err;
          useGvizFallback = true;
        }
        
        if (useGvizFallback) {
          const { flatItems } = await fetchDirectGvizTabs(sheetId, lang);
          if (flatItems.length > 0) {
            allNewItems = flatItems;
          } else {
            throw new Error("Không thể tải file (File chưa được chia sẻ Public).");
          }
        }
      } else if (url.endsWith('.xlsx')) {
        const buffer = await safeFetchExcel(url);
        const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: 'array' });
        for (let i = 0; i < workbook.SheetNames.length; i++) {
          const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[i];
          const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(workbook.Sheets[sheetName], { header: 1 });
          const parsedCards = Utils.convertRawRowsToCards(rows);
          allNewItems = allNewItems.concat(parsedCards);
        }
      } else {
        const res = await Utils.fetchWithFallback(url);
        const text = await res.text();
        allNewItems = Utils.parseAndMapCSV(text);
      }
      
      if (allNewItems.length > 0) {
        core.setNotebook(prev => {
          const existingTerms = new Set(prev.map(i => i.term));
          const uniqueItems = allNewItems.filter(i => !existingTerms.has(i.term));
          if (uniqueItems.length === 0) {
            showToast("Tất cả từ trong link đã có trong sổ tay!", "info");
            return prev;
          }
          const updated = [...prev, ...uniqueItems];
          // Ghi ngầm Sổ tay xuống IndexedDB (Đã bỏ localStorage)
          if (FcDB) FcDB.set('fc_notebook_' + lang, updated);
          showToast(`Đã gộp ${uniqueItems.length} thẻ mới vào Sổ tay!`, "success");
          return updated;
        });
        core.setShowLinkManager(false);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Dữ liệu trống");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      showToast("Lỗi nhập vào sổ tay: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      core.setIsAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFileImport = (e, sourceType = 'vocab') => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    core.setIsAiLoading(true);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    
    reader.onload = (evt) => {
      try {
        const wb = XLSX.read(evt.target.result, { type: 'binary' });
        let masterData = {};
        let totalCards = 0;
        const levelPrefix = lang === 'zh' ? 'zh_level_' : 'en_level_';
        const numTabs = Math.min(wb.SheetNames.length, 9);
        
        for (let i = 0; i < numTabs; i++) {
          const sheetName = wb.SheetNames[i];
          const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[sheetName], { header: 1 });
          const parsedCards = Utils.convertRawRowsToCards(rows);
          if (parsedCards.length > 0) {
            const match = sheetName.match(/\d+/);
            const levelNum = match ? parseInt(match[0], 10) : (i + 1);
            masterData[`${levelPrefix}${levelNum}`] = parsedCards;
            totalCards += parsedCards.length;
          }
        }
        
        if (totalCards > 0) {
          const storageKey = `fc_master_data_${lang}_${sourceType}`;
          Utils.safeLocalStorageSet(storageKey, masterData);
          const firstLevelKey = `${levelPrefix}1`;
          if (masterData[firstLevelKey]) {
            core.setCards(masterData[firstLevelKey]);
          }
          showToast(`Đã tải lên thành công ${totalCards} thẻ từ ${numTabs} Tabs (.xlsx)!`, "success");
        } else {
          showToast("Tệp không chứa dữ liệu hợp lệ", "error");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showToast("Lỗi đọc file: " + err.message, "error");
      } finally {
        core.setIsAiLoading(false);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsBinaryString(file);
  };

  const handleManualImport = (textJson) => {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(textJson);
      handleAddCard(parsed);
    } catch (e) {
      showToast("Lỗi định dạng JSON: " + e.message, "error");
    }
  };

  const handleAddCard = (newInput) => {
    let items = Array.isArray(newInput) ? newInput : [newInput];
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    const updated = [...core.cards, ...items];
    core.setCards(updated);
    Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_data_' + lang, updated);
    showToast(`Thêm ${items.length} thẻ thành công!`, "success");
  };

  const handleExportExcel = () => {
    const { cards, notebook, isStudyingNotebook } = latestStateRef.current;
    if (!cards.length) return;
    
    const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(isStudyingNotebook ? notebook : cards);
    const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, "Flashcards");
    XLSX.writeFile(wb, `flashcards_${lang}_${Date.now()}.xlsx`);
  };

  const handleExportLink = () => {
    const { cards } = latestStateRef.current;
    const tsv = Utils.jsonToTsv(cards);
    if (!tsv) {
      showToast("Không có dữ liệu!", "warning");
      return;
    }
    secureCopy(tsv);
  };

  const handleCopyForSheet = (dataToCopy) => {
    const tsv = Utils.jsonToTsv(dataToCopy);
    if (!tsv) {
      showToast("Không có dữ liệu để copy!", "warning");
      return;
    }
    secureCopy(tsv);
  };

  // ==================================================================================
  // 5. CÁC HÀM TIỆN ÍCH HỆ THỐNG
  // ==================================================================================
  const handleFetchApiKey = async (url) => {
    if (!url) return;
    core.setIsAiLoading(true);
    
    try {
      let text = '';
      if (url.includes('docs.google.com')) {
        const match = url.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
        if (match) {
          const gvizUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${match[1]}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv`;
          try {
            const res = await Utils.fetchWithFallback(gvizUrl);
            if (res) {
              const fetchedText = await res.text();
              if (!fetchedText.trim().startsWith('<')) text = fetchedText;
            }
          } catch(e) {
            console.warn("GViz Proxy Fetch failed:", e);
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (!text) {
        const res = await Utils.fetchWithFallback(url);
        text = await res.text();
      }
      
      const keys = text.split(/[\n,]/).map(k => k.trim()).filter(k => k.length > 20 && !k.includes(' '));
      if (keys.length > 0) {
        Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_apikey_pool', keys);
        core.setApiKey(keys[0]);
        showToast(`Đã nạp ${keys.length} API Key!`, "success");
      } else {
        showToast("Không tìm thấy Key hợp lệ", "warning");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      showToast("Lỗi tải Key: " + e.message, "error");
    } finally {
      core.setIsAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadTemplate = () => window.open(DEFAULT_API_KEY_SHEET, '_blank');

  const handleResetSettings = () => {
    if (core.resetPending) {
      core.setSettings(core.DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SETTINGS, JSON.stringify(core.DEFAULT_SETTINGS));
      showToast("Đã khôi phục cài đặt mặc định!", "success");
      core.setShowSettings(false); core.setResetPending(false);
    } else {
      core.setResetPending(true); showToast("⚠️ Nhấn lần nữa để xác nhận!", "warning");
      if (core.resetTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(core.resetTimeoutRef.current);
      core.resetTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => core.setResetPending(false), 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleReloadDefault = () => {
    if (core.resetPending) {
      const linkToLoad = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.DEFAULT_URL + '_' + lang + '_vocab') || DEFAULT_SHEETS?.[lang]?.vocab;
      if (linkToLoad) handleImport(linkToLoad, 'vocab');
      else {
        core.setCards([]); Utils.safeLocalStorageSet('fc_data_' + lang, []);
        showToast("Đã làm trống dữ liệu!", "success");
      }
      core.setResetPending(false);
    } else {
      core.setResetPending(true); showToast("⚠️ Nhấn lần nữa để tải lại dữ liệu!", "warning");
      if (core.resetTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(core.resetTimeoutRef.current);
      core.resetTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => core.setResetPending(false), 3000);
    }
  };

  // ==================================================================================
  // 6. SAVE/LOAD STATE (Sao lưu & Phục hồi)
  // ==================================================================================
  const handleExportSaveFile = async () => {
    try {
      core.setIsAiLoading(true);
      const saveData = {};
      
      for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        const key = localStorage.key(i);
        if (key && key.startsWith('fc_')) {
          saveData[key] = localStorage.getItem(key);
        }
      }
      
      // Bổ sung dữ liệu từ IndexedDB vào chung file Backup. [V1.03] Đã gọt sạch các keys '_vi'
      if (FcDB) {
        const dbKeys = ['fc_ai_harvest_pool', 'fc_global_retry_bag', 'fc_notebook_en', 'fc_notebook_zh', 'fc_mastered_en', 'fc_mastered_zh', 'fc_incorrect_list_en', 'fc_incorrect_list_zh'];
        for (const key of dbKeys) {
          const data = await FcDB.get(key);
          if (data) {
            saveData[key] = JSON.stringify(data); // Stringify để đồng nhất với định dạng LocalStorage lúc phục hồi
          }
        }
      }
      
      const dataStr = JSON.stringify(saveData, null, 2);
      const blob = new Blob([dataStr], { type: "application/json" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      
      const now = new Date();
      const dateStr = `${now.getFullYear()}${(now.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}${now.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0')}_${now.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}${now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
      
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `flashcard_save_${dateStr}.json`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
      showToast("Đã tạo file sao lưu thành công!", "success");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Export save error:", e);
      showToast("Lỗi khi tạo file sao lưu!", "error");
    } finally {
      core.setIsAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleImportSaveFile = (file) => {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        try {
          const importedData = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
          let count = 0;
          for (const key in importedData) {
            if (key.startsWith('fc_')) {
              // Đổ tất cả vào LocalStorage. Khi reload lại trang, Block 2.1 (FcDB.init) sẽ tự động dọn dẹp và chuyển những gì cần thiết vào IndexedDB.
              localStorage.setItem(key, importedData[key]);
              count++;
            }
          }
          
          if (count > 0) {
            showToast(`Đã phục hồi ${count} mục. Đang khởi động lại...`, "success");
            // Gỡ bỏ confirm ở tầng này để không vi phạm hiến pháp, UI đã tự xử lý qua file input
            setTimeout(() => { window.location.reload(); }, 1500);
            resolve(true);
          } else {
            showToast("File không chứa dữ liệu hợp lệ!", "error");
            reject(new Error("Invalid save file"));
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Import save error:", err);
          showToast("File bị lỗi hoặc không đúng định dạng!", "error");
          reject(err);
        }
      };
      
      reader.onerror = (err) => {
        showToast("Lỗi đọc file!", "error");
        reject(err);
      };
      
      reader.readAsText(file);
    });
  };

  return {
    handleImport,
    handleImportToNotebook,
    handleFileImport,
    handleManualImport,
    handleAddCard,
    handleExportExcel,
    handleExportLink,
    handleCopyForSheet,
    handleFetchApiKey,
    handleDownloadTemplate,
    handleResetSettings,
    handleReloadDefault,
    handleExportSaveFile,
    handleImportSaveFile,
    secureCopy
  };
};

=========================================
FILE: src\hooks\useExamLogic.js
